meta.plot: Soldats américains et combattants somaliens racontent en détail la bataille de Mogadiscio de 1993 et la désormais célèbre chute de trois hélicoptères Black Hawk.

1.title: FR - Surviving Black Hawk Down - S01E01 - This Is Not New York
1.plot: Somalia, 1993. An effort to end famine and civil war turns violent when a US mission to take out a rebel leader ends in the death of multiple civilians.

1.title: FR - Surviving Black Hawk Down - S01E02 - A Wall of Lead
1.plot: A routine raid to capture two of Aidid's lieutenants turns into a chaotic rescue operation when the Army Rangers are met with fierce Somali counterfire.

1.title: FR - Surviving Black Hawk Down - S01E03 - No Way Out
1.plot: As news of the botched Black Hawk operation rattles America, video of a captive pilot shocks the globe. Will he be rescued?

meta.plot: Lorsque la sergente Rousseau perd de nouveau un agent double aux mains du crime organisé, elle n’a d’autre choix que d’essayer une nouvelle approche. Plutôt que d’engager des policiers recrus, elle se tourne vers deux acteurs maghrébins qui gagnent leur vie en interprétant des personnages à l’école de police. Adam et Mounir deviendront ainsi agents doubles d’une division ultra-secrète de la police où, grâce à leur talent de comédiens, ils pourront infiltrer différents milieux criminels et peut-être enfin découvrir qui est la taupe qui se cache au sein du service de police.

FR - Togetherness - S01E01 - Family Day
1.plot: After Alex, a struggling actor, is evicted from his apartment, his best friend, Brett, a sound designer who’s married and has two young kids, tries to convince him to stay in LA. Meanwhile, Brett’s wife, Michelle, deals with her directionless big sister, Tina, who’s visiting from Houston. Following a group outing at the beach, Michelle and Brett clash while Tina confronts an ex, with Alex’s help.

1.title: FR - Togetherness - S01E02 - Handcuffs
1.plot: Tina tries to shake Alex out of his funk by enlisting him to help with her business and vowing to help him get the career of his dreams. Brett gets in trouble at work when his creative instincts rub co-workers the wrong way. Tina convinces Michelle to spice things up in the bedroom.

1.title: FR - Togetherness - S01E03 - Insanity
1.plot: Brett’s invite to a movie premiere leads to an impromptu night on the town for everyone. Tina and Alex engage in a personal “mission,” Brett looks to mend a work relationship, and Michelle meets David, a divorced dad who wants to start a new charter school. Brett finds a way to cheer up Alex.

1.title: FR - Togetherness - S01E04 - Houston, We Have a Problem
1.plot: Alex and Tina fly back to Houston to pack up her things. During a night of drinks and dancing, Tina finds herself unexpectedly jealous of Alex. Back in LA, Brett whisks Michelle away for some much-needed intimacy.

1.title: FR - Togetherness - S01E05 - Kick the Can
1.plot: After an intense therapy session, Michelle organizes a day of fun with old friends, despite Brett’s lack of enthusiasm. When a group of hipsters looks to sour their plans, Michelle challenges them to a brutal game of “kick the can.”

1.title: FR - Togetherness - S01E06 - Ghost in Chains
1.plot: During a morning hike, Brett meets Linda, a new-age believer who encourages him to get in touch with himself. Tina tries to make up with Alex by getting him an audition, Michelle helps David with the charter school and Brett takes a stand at work and opens up about his feelings.

1.title: FR - Togetherness - S01E07 - Party Time
1.plot: Michelle throws a fundraising party for the charter school while Brett enters a new state of mind at Linda’s house. Still at odds with Alex, Tina struggles with her bouncy-castle business; later, a conversation with Larry makes her rethink the future. Brett has a chat with David and an honest conversation with Michelle.

1.title: FR - Togetherness - S01E08 - Not So Together
1.plot: When Alex gets big career news, he seeks out Tina, who is busy planning her future with Larry. On a trip to Sacramento, Michelle steps up to the plate in a big way. After a day at the beach with the kids, Brett decides to share his feelings with Michelle.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E01 - Hotels
2.plot: Alex receives a surprise birthday visit on the set of his new film in New Orleans.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E02 - Everybody Is Grownups
2.plot: Michelle attempts to make the charter school a reality. Tina falls out with Alex's new girlfriend at his welcome home party.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E03 - Advanced Pretend
2.plot: Brett and Alex get out of town while Michelle and Tina juggle the kids, and Christy.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E04 - Changetown
2.plot: Brett and Alex are busy with a new passion project. Michelle manages to bond with Anna. Alex does not like the major changes at work.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E05 - Just The Range
2.plot: Brett struggles with the challenges and unexpected perks of a new side gig. Tina and Larry discuss life goals. Alex bristles over an unstable new director but softens to him and finds the two have common ground. Anna proves herself indispensable to Michelle.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E06 - Geri-ina
2.plot: Alex decides to bring in somebody from Brett's past to help with their project. Tina feels proactive.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E07 - The Sand Situation
2.plot: Facing pressure to build the school she envisioned, Michelle turns to Brett and Alex for help. A midnight trip to the beach puts Brett in an awkward situation, while Alex worries about Tina's behavior.

2.title: FR - Togetherness - S02E08 - For The Kids
2.plot: Michelle is inspired by the kids as the foursome makes a last-ditch effort to save her charter school plans.

meta.plot: Brett et Michelle Pierson ont du mal à raviver l'étincelle dans leur relation, qui s'est enlisée depuis le stress du mariage et les enfants. Lorsque l'ami de Brett, Alex et la sœur de Michelle, Tina, les accompagnent en vacances, le quatuor s'engage dans une lutte tragi-comique pour suivre leurs rêves personnels, tout en restant bons amis.

La famille Gemstone, des télévangélistes connus mondialement : le patriarche Eli, un homme dur mais respecté par ses fidèles, et son fils Jesse, qui rêve de sortir de l'ombre de son père pour voler de ses propres ailes et devenir à son tour une célébrité.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E01 - The Righteous Gemstones
1.plot: Upon returning from a baptism marathon in China, Jesse receives a video from blackmailers seeking to sully his reputation. Eli moves forward with plans to expand the Gemstone empire as he continues to mourn his late wife.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E02 - Is This the Man Who Made the Earth Tremble
1.plot: After discovering Amber, Pontius and Abraham reminiscing about an estranged family member, Jesse tasks his friends with acquiring surveillance footage that could explain the strange events of the night before.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E03 - They Are Weak, But He Is Strong
1.plot: Aimee-Leigh's elderly brother Baby Billy returns to the Gemstone ministry, bringing along his much younger wife Tiffany. Jesse closes ranks on his co-conspirators to root out the identity of his blackmailers.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E04 - Wicked Lips
1.plot: Judy and Martin take Gideon behind-the scenes of the Gemstone enterprise. Eli tasks Kelvin with doing a “satanic sweep” for Dot, the rebellious teen daughter of the church’s biggest donors. Jesse and his friends are thrown for a loop when Chad’s wife finds some disturbing emails.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E05 - Interlude
1.plot: In 1989, young Jesse, Judy and Baby Billy each deal with the news that Aimee-Leigh is pregnant in their own unique way, while Eli looks to grow his family’s prospects.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E06 - Now the Sons of Eli Were Worthless Men
1.plot: Jealous of Kelvin’s rising star, Judy seeks her moment in the spotlight under Baby Billy’s tutelage. Jesse procures a key piece of evidence he hopes will lead to the blackmailers.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E07 - And Yet One of You is a Devil
1.plot: Eli informs Jesse, Kelvin and Judy that they’ll each need to be front and center for Easter Sunday service, their biggest telecast of the year. Judy’s deference to Baby Billy threatens her relationship with BJ and with her family.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E08 - But the Righteous Will See Their Fall
1.plot: Jesse deals with the fallout of the dramatic events of Easter Sunday. Judy attempts to win back BJ after receiving some harsh words from Baby Billy. Kelvin has a crisis of faith.

1.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S01E09 - Better is the End of a Thing Than Its Beginning
1.plot: Eli questions his children's future in the Gemstone ministry. Jesse struggles to keep his marriage together. Judy opens up to BJ about her past. A disillusioned Kelvin embraces his dark side. Season One Finale.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E01 - I Speak in the Tongues of Men and Angels
2.plot: As Jesse eyes a business opportunity with an Evangelical couple on the rise, the media cracks down on a fellow preacher. Meanwhile, Eli reconnects with a figure from his mysterious past.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E02 - After I Leave, Savage Wolves Will Come
2.plot: After doubling-down on their efforts to invest in Zion’s Landing, Jesse and Amber scramble for the cash. Meanwhile, Eli’s attempts to dodge a big-city reporter spell doom for the Gemstones.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E03 - For He Is a Liar and the Father of Lies
2.plot: The Gemstone siblings seek to pull back the curtain on their father’s past. Eli shares a hard truth, and Kelvin grapples with an unruly God Squad.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E04 - As to How They Might Destroy Him
2.plot: Still reeling from their father’s revelation, Kelvin and Jesse conspire to put Eli in his place. As BJ’s baptism approaches, Judy clashes with her in-laws, while Baby Billy struggles with his own growing family.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E05 - Interlude II
2.plot: Christmas, 1993. While Eli considers a tempting offer from an old friend, Baby Billy crashes the Gemstones’ celebrations.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E06 - Never Avenge Yourselves, But Leave It to the Wrath of God
2.plot: After surviving a harrowing attack, Jesse takes matters into his own hands. Eli attempts to make amends, while Kelvin struggles to control his flock.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E07 - And Infants Shall Rule Over Them
2.plot: With Eli temporarily out of the picture, the Gemstone siblings are left to quarrel over who’s in charge – until some wise words help pave a way forward. As Tiffany tracks down Baby Billy, Gideon faces his future.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E08 - The Prayer of a Righteous Man
2.plot: As the dust settles back at the compound, Jesse, Kelvin, and Judy consider where they stand. Baby Billy reconnects with a figure from his past.

2.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S02E09 - I Will Tell of All Your Deeds
2.plot: While the Gemstones celebrate the launch of Zion’s Landing, Baby Billy faces a chance to embrace fatherhood.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E01 - For I Know the Plans I Have for You
3.plot: In the wake of their father’s semi-retirement, Jesse, Judy, and Kelvin must deal with dwindling attendance – and donations. Later, Eli is visited by another figure from his past.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E02 - But Esau Ran to Meet Him
3.plot: Eli does his best to smooth over relations with the Montgomery boys after a visit to their doomsday prepper compound. Back at the Salvation Center, the siblings face off against the Board of Ministers.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E03 - For Their Nakedness Is Your Own Nakedness
3.plot: Tired of life in the lap of luxury, Baby Billy pursues a new vocation as gameshow host. The Gemstones host a cousins’ night for Karl and Chuck.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E04 - I Have Not Come to Bring Peace, But a Sword
3.plot: While Jesse prepares for his initiation into a prestigious secret society, Judy fends off unwanted attention, and Kelvin handles rumors about Keefe. Later, Baby Billy makes an impossible promise.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E05 - Interlude III
3.plot: 2000. After a Y2K doomsday fails to materialize, Eli and Aimee-Leigh find themselves flooded with criticism from their congregants…and the Montgomerys. Later, the arrival of Jesse’s girlfriend Amber throws an already fragile Judy for a loop.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E06 - For Out of the Heart Comes Evil Thoughts
3.plot: Threatened with blackmail, Judy turns to Amber for advice, while Jesse goads BJ into a long-simmering fight. As a despondent Kelvin tackles life without Keefe, Baby Billy works on bringing Jesse’s miracle to life… for a price.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E07 - Burn for Burn, Wound for Wound, Stripe for Stripe
3.plot: After decades of animosity, tensions between the Montgomerys and the Gemstones finally come to a head. As Eli faces an impossible decision, Jesse, Judy, and Kelvin prepare to meet their maker.

3.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S03E08 - I Will Take You by the Hand and Keep You
3.plot: The Gemstone siblings reconnect with their loved ones… and each other. As the Montgomery militia fractures from within, Chuck weighs his options, while Peter hatches a new plan.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E01 - Prelude
4.plot: 1862. A young scoundrel named Gemstone joins ranks with the Confederates as a preacher, but a case of divine intervention changes the sinner's path for good.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E02 - You Hurled Me Into the Depths, Into the Very Heart of the Seas
4.plot: While preparing for a Give-a-Thon in honor of their late mother, the Gemstones reunite with Aimee-Leigh's longtime best friend Lori.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E03 - To Grieve Like the Rest of Men Who Have No Hope
4.plot: When their archrivals encroach on Gemstone territory, Jesse prepares to strike back, while Kelvin receives an honor.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E04 - He Goeth Before You Into Galilee
4.plot: At the Gemstone family lake house, Baby Billy and the siblings plot to use Aimee-Leigh's memory to tear Eli's new relationship apart – by whatever means necessary.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E05 - You Shall Remember
4.plot: While Lori finds herself in a precarious position, Baby Billy tries to get the greenlight on his latest project. Later, Kelvin and Vance face off.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E06 - Interlude IV
4.plot: 2002. While recording an album together, Lori turns to Aimee-Leigh for help with her failing marriage.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E07 - For Jealousy Is the Rage of a Man
4.plot: Eli confronts a dangerous foe. Baby Billy struggles on the set of Teenjus. Judy has monkey problems. Keefe works to get Kelvin out of his tree house.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E08 - On Your Belly You Shall Go
4.plot: Judy looks to get rid of BJ's new companion as Eli looks for a new path forward.

4.title: FR - The Righteous Gemstones - S04E09 - That Man of God May Be Complete
4.plot: Still reeling from a brush with fate, the Gemstones head to Galilee Gulch, where their faith is put to the ultimate test.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E01 - A Master of Circumstance
1.plot: Stripped of aristocratic privilege, Count Alexander Rostov is sentenced to life imprisonment at the Metropol Hotel. Contending with allies and foes alike, it’s nine-year-old Nina and her unexpected friendship that changes his life.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E02 - An Invitation
1.plot: The Count reckons with his past when old friend Mishka turns up at the hotel; he meets Anna Urbanova for the first time, embarking on a passionate affair; his friendship with Nina deepens, but their time together may be cut short.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E03 - The Last Rostov
1.plot: As his old life crumbles, the Count receives some devastating news; blinded by hurt, he embroils his friends in a dangerous plan; his disregard for the state may have consequences; Nina makes a surprise return, as Anna's career takes a turn.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E04 - Good Times
1.plot: The Count must undertake a dangerous political mission to save a friend.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E05 - An Arrival
1.plot: The Count's life at the hotel is turned upside down by a startling arrival.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E06 - The Fall
1.plot: When someone close to him suffers a terrible accident, the Count resolves to save them at any cost, making a decision that endangers his life; as the hotel rallies to protect him, the crisis forces Anna to confront her true feelings about the Count.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E07 - An Assembly
1.plot: Russia stands on the brink of change in 1953, as someone close to the Count is granted a major opportunity. But when the return of an old friend makes the Count see clearly, he's confronted with a difficult choice about the future.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E08 - Adieu
1.plot: The Count and Anna devise an elaborate plan, with huge consequences should it fail. However, things quickly start to unravel. An inevitable showdown is set between the Count and an old enemy.

meta.plot: Au lendemain de la révolution russe, le comte Alexandre Rostov découvre que son statut de privilégié le place du mauvais côté de l'histoire. Même s’il échappe à une exécution immédiate, un tribunal soviétique le condamne à vivre retranché dans une chambre dans les combles du luxueux hôtel Metropol et le menace de mort si jamais il en sortait. Tandis que les années passent et que le pays traverse les décennies parmi les plus tumultueuses de son histoire, les conditions de vie restreintes de Rostov l’ouvrent sur un vaste monde de découverte émotionnelle. Alors qu'il se construit une nouvelle vie entre les murs de l'hôtel, il découvre la véritable valeur de l'amitié, de la famille et de l'amour.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Samantha and Jay throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a rundown country estate they inherited into a bed & breakfast – only to find it’s inhabited by the many opinionated spirits of deceased residents who now call it home.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E02 - Hello!
1.plot: When Sam thinks she’s crazy because she continues to see the ghosts of Woodstone Manor, she tries to ignore them, making them even more determined to get her to acknowledge they’re real.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E03 - Viking Funeral
1.plot: When Thorfinn’s bones are discovered on the Woodstone property, he asks Sam to conduct the traditional Viking funeral he’s always wanted. However, Sam and Jay are torn when they learn that the bones could be sold to a museum for a lot of much-needed cash. Also, the ghosts conduct an election for a “ghost representative” to bring issues to Sam.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E04 - Dinner Party
1.plot: When Sam and Jay invite the nosy neighbors Henry and Margaret to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E05 - Halloween
1.plot: On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who annually vandalize the house.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E06 - Pete's Wife
1.plot: Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she’s been keeping a dark secret from him for many years. Also, Sassapis gets angry with Thorfinn for binge-cheating their favorite show without him, and Trevor learns he may have a daughter.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E07 - Flower's Article
1.plot: When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she’s embarrassed about a part of the story she’s never revealed.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E08 - D&D
1.plot: After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts. Also, Isaac confronts his feelings for Nigel, a British soldier ghost from whom he’s been keeping a gigantic secret.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E09 - Alberta's Fan
1.plot: Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go on a walk with him in hopes that it will spark a special memory.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E10 - Possession
1.plot: Hetty accidentally possesses Jay’s body just as he and Sam are to about show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E11 - Sam's Mom
1.plot: Sam and Jay travel to where Sam’s mother, Sheryl, died to see if she’s now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret to his fellow ghosts that he overheard Sam and Jay discussing.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E12 - Jay's Sister
1.plot: When Jay’s sister, Bela, comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they’re shocked to discover that she’s communicating with someone they know on a dating app.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E13 - The Vault
1.plot: Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend’s wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty’s husband, Elias Woodstone, tries to ruin it.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E14 - Ghostwriter
1.plot: When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over the creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a new living friend, and Flower attempts to be Pete’s new basketball buddy.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E15 - Thorapy
1.plot: When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him. Also, Isaac makes a big, personal revelation after he’s compelled to seduce his new roommate, Hetty.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E16 - Trevor's Pants
1.plot: The secret about Trevor’s missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone’s corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E17 - Attic Girl
1.plot: An ‘80s “mean girl” ghost named Stephanie, who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E18 - Farnsby & B
1.plot: As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official B&B guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn. Also, Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E01 - Spies
2.plot: Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to integrate Nigel into his friend group.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E02 - Alberta's Podcast
2.plot: Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta’s death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E03 - Jay's Friends
2.plot: Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay’s new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah. Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E04 - The Tree
2.plot: Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try and save an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower’s attention.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E05 - Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
2.plot: A séance at Sam and Jay’s last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty’s past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E06 - The Baby Bjorn
2.plot: Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys’ house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E07 - Dumb Deaths
2.plot: When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E08 - The Liquor License
2.plot: Alberta’s expertise from her past comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into some complications during their Woodstone whiskey tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac’s past.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E09 - The Christmas Spirit (1)
2.plot: Jay’s sister, Bela, visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves. Meanwhile, the ghosts have conjured up a very different holiday plan for Trevor and Bela. Also, Isaac has an awkward encounter with Nigel that forces him to look back on events in his life.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E10 - The Christmas Spirit (2)
2.plot: Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay’s sister, Bela, and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Also, Isaac’s marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E11 - The Perfect Assistant
2.plot: Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B – however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E12 - The Family Business
2.plot: Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay’s assistant, Freddie, ignoring Hetty’s warning not to get too close to “the help.” Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica, the ghost who lives in Freddie’s car.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E13 - Ghost Hunter
2.plot: Sam and Jay’s assistant, Freddie, purchases ghost-hunting equipment when suspicious activity leads him to theorize the B&B is haunted. Also, Sasappis risks losing his relationship with Jessica when Freddie sells his car.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E14 - Trevor's Body
2.plot: Trevor receives disturbing news about his parents when they come to Woodstone B&B to collect his newly discovered remains. Also, Isaac and Nigel’s relationship hits a roadblock.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E15 - A Date to Remember
2.plot: Sam and Jay help Thorfinn create a perfect first date with Flower. Also, Hetty feels slighted by the ghosts’ new housemate, Nigel.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E16 - Isaac's Book
2.plot: Sam struggles to keep Isaac’s spirits up after she hits a wall trying to publish a biography about him. Also, Trevor and Hetty conspire to keep their relationship hidden and Thor tries to prove to Flower that he can control his anger.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E17 - Weekend from Hell
2.plot: Elias Woodstone returns to Woodstone seeking Hetty’s forgiveness so he can stay out of hell for good. Also, Jay struggles to repeat an inspired culinary creation that he came up with after walking through Flower.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E18 - Alberta's Descendant

FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E01 - Solitude
1.plot: June 1940. In London De Gaulle negotiates with Churchill to unify the two countries. But, an ultimate betrayal for the general, France asks for an armistice and Pétain takes power. 18 June, he broadcasts a radio appeal to continue the combat. 3 July, the Royal Navy attacks the French fleet.

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E02 - Tous les combats du monde
1.plot: September 1940. In Dakar, Pétain's French fleet machine-guns the Free French Forces. Additional suffering for De Gaulle, beset by doubts. All the more so as he is increasingly opposed to Churchill and has to face the hostility of Roosevelt. Spring 1943, the general and his family move to Algiers

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E03 - Liberté, liberté chérie
1.plot: August 1944. Paris is liberated but the wounds are deep. On her return from deportation, Geneviève, the general's niece, recounts the Nazi horrors. A provisional government is established, led by De Gaulle. The time has come for reconstruction. January 1946. Refusing to play party politics, De Gaulle leaves power.

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E04 - Premier des Français
1.plot: May 1958. The Algerian crisis risks dragging France into civil war. The President of the Republic René Coty appealed to de Gaulle. The constitution of the Fifth Republic was born, Charles de Gaulle entered the Elysee Palace in January 59. Putsch of the generals in 1961, multiple attempted attacks against de Gaulle… the question of Algeria remained burning. When the year 1965 opens, de Gaulle suggests that he might not stand for the presidential election in December. Yvonne, who has linked her fate to his, discreetly encourages a few relatives to dissuade the General from being a candidate. But how to abandon France?

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E05 - Le chagrin des hommes
1.plot: May 1968. With France in turmoil De Gaulle doesn't understand what is in play. Increasingly, those around Prime Minister Pompidou call for De Gaulle to go. With no sign of events calming down, a general strike and student rebellion are launched. De Gaulle secretly joins General Massu in Baden-Baden.

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E06 - Crépuscule
1.plot: Late 1968. Pompidou is no longer Prime Minister. De Gaulle launches a referendum, an ultimate battle he will lose. 25 April 1969. He records his televised speech and leaves the Élysée Palace, never to return. André Malraux visits him in the solitude of Colombey. The end of the road approaches.

meta.plot: Une série qui nous plonge dans l’intimité de Charles de Gaulle et nous fait revivre plusieurs épisodes de l’Histoire de France, de l’appel du 18 juin 1940 à son départ du pouvoir en 1969, ces grands moments que le général a incarnés et façonnés.

1.plot: Dexter adjusts to his new job as a forensics intern at Miami Metro, as Harry returns to work after his medical leave. Deb lashes out at her dad by engaging in petty criminal behavior.

1.title: FR - Dexter : Les Origines - S01E03 - Miami Vice
1.plot: Dexter goes after a loan shark with ties to Batista, as Harry is told to keep an eye on Maria Laguerta, Miami Metro's newest homicide detective. Deb throws a party to win the favor of her volleyball teammates.

1.title: FR - Dexter : Les Origines - S01E04 - Fender Bender
1.plot: Dexter targets a retired mob hitman (who may still be killing), as Harry works the gruesome murder case of a 10-year-old boy. Deb sneaks into a nightclub with Sofia and meets an exciting new friend.

1.title: FR - Dexter : Les Origines - S01E05 - F Is for Fuck-Up
1.plot: After a kill goes wrong, Dexter is grounded by Harry. Deb deepens her relationship with Gio, and bonds with her brother on the anniversary of their mother's death.

1.title: FR - Dexter : Les Origines - S01E08 - Business and Pleasure
1.plot: Deb sneaks away for a trip with her mysterious boyfriend. Dexter is tasked with finding her. Harry and LaGuerta travel to Tampa to look into a potential serial killer on the loose, while Miami Metro closes in on suspects in the child kidnapping.

1.title: FR - Dexter : Les Origines - S01E09 - Blood Drive

1.title: FR - Dexter : Les Origines - S01E10 - Code Blues
1.plot: Dexter races to find the missing kidnapped child before it's too late. Deb visits her godfather in the hospital and rethinks her future. Harry comes face-to-face with a serial killer... leading to a shocking result.

meta.plot: En 1991 à Miami, Dexter est un étudiant en passe de devenir un tueur en série. Lorsque ses pulsions sanguinaires ne peuvent plus être ignorées, le jeune homme trouve réconfort et compréhension auprès de Harry, son père adoptif. Celui-ci lui enseigne des règles pour l’aider à repérer et à tuer des personnes qui méritent de mourir, tout en évitant de se faire coincer par les forces de l’ordre. C’est un défi particulier pour le stagiaire débutant en médecine légale au département de police de Miami.

2.plot: When a renowned retired astronaut is murdered in plain sight, Morgan and the team uncover some of his mysterious entanglements. Soto travels to New York City to meet a high-profile political fixer connected to Roman’s disappearance.

2.title: FR - High Potential - S02E16 - Turn, Up the Heat
2.plot: Morgan relies on old friends to help with a case involving street artists, while Karadec leans on the women in his life during a time of need.

Série éducative présentant un certain nombre de sujets scientifiques au jeune public.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E01 - Social Media
1.plot: Why is social media so addictive? Turns out, it's by design. We'll also explore the science of selfies and why people can be so cruel online.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E02 - Germs
1.plot: What's the difference between good and bad germs? And how real is the "Five-Second Rule"? It's a dirty topic, but someone's got to cover it.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E03 - Superheroes
1.plot: Super vision, super hearing and super strength aren't just for mythical heroes. These amazing powers are real -- and, believe it or not, you have them!

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E04 - Dreams
1.plot: Whether they're good or bad, we all have them. But what do dreams mean -- and is it possible to control them? Let's drift off to dreamland to find out.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E05 - Space
1.plot: Let's zoom to the farthest reaches of the galaxy to discover what stars are made of, whether aliens could exist and how space affects the human body.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E06 - Emotions
1.plot: When it comes to your emotions, who's in charge: you or them? We'll dig into feelings, what grosses you out and whether laughter is actually contagious.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E07 - Motivation
1.plot: Need a boost? Discover how motivation works -- and how to master it -- by learning the key to getting things done that you’d much rather skip.

1.plot: Join Sahana for a journey under the sea to learn about ocean layers, discover how fish can drown and meet some of the strangest creatures on the planet!

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E09 - Thinking
1.plot: Ever wonder where thoughts come from, how to think faster or how to overcome irrational thinking? Good news: We think we've got the answers.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E10 - Hidden Forces
1.plot: You can't see them ... but they're there. Learn how hidden forces like gravity, magnetism and electricity hold the world as we know it together.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E11 - Creativity
1.plot: Creativity is your friend. But what do you do when it's blocked? Learn how to unlock the secrets to becoming more creative -- no matter who you are.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E12 - Memories
1.plot: Want to get better at remembering? We'll learn what memory is, how memories are formed and how to improve your recall with some very cool hacks.

1.title: FR - Brainchild - S01E13 - Beat the Parents
1.plot: We're pitting kids against their parents in an epic battle of the ages with both mental and physical challenges. Who will win? It's anyone's guess.

Un enthousiasme communicatif, une sympathie naturelle, une vie privée chaotique qu’il convoque à tout bout de champ, le tout allié à certains clichés inévitablement attachés à sa couleur de peau, lui donnent un aspect absolument inoffensif. C’est particulièrement utile quand, comme Joseph, on est chargé d’élucider des meurtres…
