1.title: FR - Le Guépard - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Hoping to obtain a travel permit to Donnafugata, the Salinas attend Garibaldi's Liberation Ball, where Tancredi sees others vie for Concetta's affection.

1.title: FR - Le Guépard - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Tancredi's attraction to Angelica pulls him away from Concetta. Despite his distaste for Mayor Sedara, Don Fabrizio considers joint future prospects.

1.title: FR - Le Guépard - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While Concetta distances herself from her family, the Leopard entrusts more responsibilities to Paolo, whom Sedara informs of an enticing venture.

1.title: FR - Le Guépard - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Still grieving, the Prince and Concetta travel to Turin, where a role in Italy's future awaits him. Tancredi and Angelica expose their ambitions.

1.title: FR - Le Guépard - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As Concetta makes her wish to leave Sicily clear, the Leopard silently endures health troubles. The Salinas attend the final ball of the season.

meta.plot: À l'aube de l'unification de l'Italie en 1860, un prince sicilien doit s'adapter aux changements révolutionnaires qui menacent les privilèges séculaires de sa famille.
After learning heretical teachings about the Earth and the Sun, a child prodigy searches for his master's hidden research while evading the Inquisition.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Heliocentrism. How About That?
1.plot: A gifted young student plans to study theology at university, but his true passion is astronomy. One day, he meets a mysterious scholar named Hubert.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - And Now... I'm Going to Move the Earth
1.plot: Rafał is intrigued by Hubert’s heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafał a pendant before being whisked away.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - I... Believe in Heliocentrism
1.plot: Nowak convinces Potocki to admit to Rafał's heresy. Once arrested, Rafał is given a choice: recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
1.plot: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Even If I Die... This World Will Continue
1.plot: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee for the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Move... The World
1.plot: Oczy seeks the help of Badeni, the demoted monk who incurred the Church's wrath by turning his curiosity to the riddles of the sky.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Matters of the Truth
1.plot: Gifted scholar Jolenta suffers discrimination as the only girl at an astronomy institute. Badeni seeks resources to prove the heliocentric theory.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - We Must Become Icarus
1.plot: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - This Is What It Means... To Learn Something, I Think
1.plot: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Truth
1.plot: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Terror
1.plot: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Heliocentrism Is My Faith
1.plot: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni's premises but doesn't find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Freedom
1.plot: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Tonight's Sky...
1.plot: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents on heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy's torture at Nowak's hands.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Is It... My Turn?
1.plot: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - It's Time to Begin the Operation
1.plot: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - I Could Make a Lot of Money with This Book… Maybe
1.plot: A young nomad woman haunted by poverty devotes her life to obtaining wealth. One night, she discovers the book that Frei hid in the abandoned village.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - To Liberate Information
1.plot: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt’s men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Wandering Is How You Find What's Right
1.plot: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - I Love Heliocentrism
1.plot: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - The Times Are Changing
1.plot: Schmidt and the others regroup with their Liberation Front comrades and begin printing the book. However, a traitor brings their operation to a halt.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Neither of You Will Be Known to History
1.plot: As Nowak's group attacks the Liberation Front, Draka and Schmidt begin their escape. Upon reaching town, Draka makes a proposition to Bishop Antoni.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Comrades
1.plot: A deluded Nowak turns against Antoni and attempts to burn down the church. Draka fights back and escapes but incurs a terrible wound.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Thaumazein
1.plot: Albert goes to deliver an order of bread to a church. While there, he encounters a mysterious priest who encourages him to confess his sins.

1.title: EN - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - 『?』
1.plot: Albert leaves the academic gathering and returns home to an awful sight. In the present, the priest gives Albert advice and makes his own confession.

meta.plot: After a series of misfortunes, Fleur — mourning a deep loss — takes her daughter and returns to her hometown in search of a renewed sense of purpose.

1.title: EN - Tuiskoms [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Fleur and the Seagull
1.plot: Fleur's life takes a turn when a low moment becomes a viral meme, forcing her to pack up her life with her daughter and move back in with her parents.

1.title: EN - Tuiskoms [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Fleur and the Labour Strike
1.plot: Abigail finds herself swept up in a surprise romantic encounter. Fleur agrees to take on managing the Bloom & Bean, much to Werner's delight.

1.title: EN - Tuiskoms [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Fleur and the Missing Goat
1.plot: Fleur's sudden interest in flower arranging blossoms into an obsession as she searches for the passion her bouquets desperately need.

1.title: EN - Tuiskoms [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Fleur and the Storm
1.plot: Werner and Fleur head off to a local farm for the shop, finding unexpected common ground. Meanwhile, Abigail cultivates Kelly's natural talent for art.

1.title: EN - Tuiskoms [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Fleur and the Protea
1.plot: Kelly takes her passion project to a comic book fair, hoping to meet her hero. Fleur gives love a chance for the first time since losing André.

1.title: EN - Tuiskoms [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Fleur and the Churchbells
1.plot: Romance is blossoming for all three generations of Smit women, but can they embrace the wild rollercoaster of love without trying to self-sabotage?

1.title: EN - Tuiskoms [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Fleur and the Persistence of Memory
1.plot: When tragedy hits Wilderness, Fleur must confront her relationships with both the living and the dead, as she makes the biggest decision of her life.

meta.plot: Le jour, Josh Futterman est un gardien sans histoires. La nuit, il est un joueur de jeux vidéo de classe mondiale. Lorsque des mystérieux visiteurs venus du futur viennent le voir pour le prévenir de l'extinction programmée des terriens, il se transforme en sauveur de la planète...

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Josh Futturman feels stuck in his dead-end job as a janitor so all he really does is play Biotic Wars, an unbeatable videogame the rest of the world has given up on. But when Josh beats the game, mysterious visitors from the future appear: the world is in danger, and Josh is the only one who can save it.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E02 - Herpe: Fully Loaded
1.plot: In 1969, Josh, Tiger, and Wolf launch a mission to infiltrate a fraternity party and prevent Dr. Kronish from contracting herpes—but the destruction they’ve left in their wake quickly catches up with them.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E03 - A Riphole in Time
1.plot: Tiger and Wolf decide it’s time for Dr. Kronish to die. Josh reluctantly agrees to help—but when he realizes he can’t go through with it, he finds himself caught in Tiger and Wolf’s sights instead.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E04 - A Fuel's Errand
1.plot: In the wake of the disastrous attempt to assassinate Dr. Kronish, Tiger and Wolf kick Josh off the mission. When they realize their Time Travel Device is compromised, Josh makes a deal: if he can get them more fuel, they’ll let him back on the team.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E05 - Justice Desserts
1.plot: Tiger, Wolf, and Josh work to unmask the Biotics undercover at the Kronish Labs Christmas party. Meanwhile, Josh grows closer to his coworker Jeri as she helps him avoid the obsessed policeman hot on Josh’s tail.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E06 - A Blowjob Before Dying
1.plot: With just twenty-seven minutes before a bomb explodes in the head of their captured Biotic, Josh, Tiger, and Wolf hold a high-stakes interrogation in Josh's bedroom while Josh’s unwitting parents host a holiday dinner party downstairs.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E07 - Pandora's Mailbox
1.plot: Josh, Tiger, and Wolf jump into the future to steal the fuel they desperately need to continue their mission. But when they arrive at their destination, they are confronted by an unexpected enemy.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E08 - Girth, Wind & Fire
1.plot: The end of the mission is in sight as Tiger and Wolf prepare for one final jump into the past. But when Josh’s mom is kidnapped, Josh refuses to let Tiger and Wolf leave before they mount a daring rescue to save her.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E09 - Operation: Fatal Attraction
1.plot: Convinced he knows how to stop Dr. Kronish once and for all, Josh commandeers the TTD and leads the team on a mission into the past. But when Wolf goes missing, they have to spilt up, forcing Josh to carry out his insane plan alone.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E10 - Operation: Natal Attraction
1.plot: Still in the past, Josh desperately tries to change Dr. Kronish’s future while not messing up his own. Meanwhile, Tiger and Wolf confront each other over Wolf's wavering dedication to the cause.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E11 - Beyond the TruffleDome
1.plot: Torn apart by internal divisions, the team is scattered throughout history, as Tiger and Wolf reckon with the way the mission has changed them and the possibility that they might fail.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E12 - Prelude to an Apocalypse
1.plot: Josh discovers that his interference in the past has completely transformed his life…for the better. Wolf and Tiger deal with the aftermath of their failed mission to the past.

1.title: FR - Future Man - S01E13 - A Date With Destiny
1.plot: Out of time and options, the team reconciles that their actions have made everything much, much worse and plan one final mission to put an end to Dr. Kronish and the Cure forever.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E01 - Countdown to a Prologue
2.plot: Josh is confused to discover that he’s been released from jail. As he tries to make sense of this, he quickly realizes that all is not as it seems in his world. A new nefarious plan is afoot and Josh is being pulled into it whether he likes it or not.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E02 - The i of the Tiger
2.plot: Tiger and Wolf arrive in the future they created. Tiger is not welcome in The NAG (The New Above Ground) so she heads to The Mons where she learns humanity is moving to Mars, her DNA created the cure, and Stu Camillo is alive and well in hologram form.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E03 - A Wolf in the Torque House
2.plot: Wolf is mistaken for Torque (the Wolf in this timeline) and he goes with it – learning about the NAG, and its 6-parent families and hatred of technology. Wolf tries to escape but the appeal of this new, strange world makes it hard for him to leave.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E04 - Guess Who's Coming to Lunch
2.plot: As Tiger gets to know her doppelganger Ty-Anne, Wolf acclimates to the NAG, and Josh wanders the desert. Josh is brought to the NAG and remanded to indentured servitude as a technology smasher.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E05 - J1: Judgment Day
2.plot: Josh, Tiger, and Wolf go on a mission to find their TTD and take down the Pointed Circle.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E06 - The Binx Ultimatum
2.plot: Tiger uses Stu’s fondness for her to help her track down Athena. Meanwhile, Josh is now a “Smasher” remanded to a labor camp, where the Pointed Circle comes after him. Wolf, vowing to improve the NAG, faces off against Supreme Overlord Vice.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E07 - Homicide: Life in the Mons
2.plot: Wolf, ignoring warnings about the Pointed Circle, brings Josh to live outside his Clusternest. Tiger reaches a dead end in her quest for the TTD.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E08 - The Last Horchata
2.plot: Stu introduces a depressed Tiger to his simulation – where anything can be reality, drawing them closer than ever before.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E09 - The Ballad of PUP-E Q. Barkington
2.plot: Stu sends commandos to abduct Josh in the NAG – chaos and bloodshed ensue. Josh and Wolf learn the identity of Achilles, the elusive leader of the Pointed Circle.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E10 - Exes and OS
2.plot: Ty-Anne shares the story of growing up with Stu as her father and her early exposure to The Pointed Circle. Josh believes he’s the key to stopping Stu once and for all.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E11 - Dia De Los Robots
2.plot: It’s the day of the MARS launch. Josh goes on a suicide mission to sneak into Stu’s upload machine to shut him down for good.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E12 - The Brain Job
2.plot: Armed with the newly discovered TTD, our team uses an 11-second window to jump back in time over and over to reach Stu’s brain and destroy it.

2.title: FR - Future Man - S02E13 - Ultra-Max
2.plot: Having messed with time travel one too many times, Josh, Tiger, and Wolf land in jail in the year 3491. Facing a death sentence for their crimes, their loyalty to each other is tested by their cruel and unusual jailer, Susan.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E01 - The Precipice of Yesterday
3.plot: Josh, Tiger, and Wolf are forced to compete in the Diecathalon, but a complication arises that puts them at odds with each other.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E02 - There Will Be Borscht
3.plot: Josh puts his faith in The Voice while Wolf basks in his element and Tiger struggles to adapt.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E03 - Trapper's Delight
3.plot: Josh’s crisis of faith comes to a head as Tiger connects with her killer instincts, and Wolf struggles to lay low.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E04 - The Outlaw Wild Sam Bladden
3.plot: Tiger and Wolf come to terms with their true selves as Josh is forced to confront what and who he truly believes.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E05 - Haven Is for Real
3.plot: Josh makes a risky deal. Tiger and Wolf let Josh take command.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E06 - The Land After Time
3.plot: Josh discovers a new happiness as Wolf loses his mind and Tiger embarks on an unexpected journey.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E07 - Time Rogues III: Escape From Forever
3.plot: Josh and Wolf reunite and make a desperate move to escape while Tiger reconciles her past and present selves.

3.title: FR - Future Man - S03E08 - Return of the Present
3.plot: The universe is about to end. For real this time.

1.title: FR - Tuiskoms - S01E01 - Fleur and the Seagull
1.plot: Fleur's life takes a turn when a low moment becomes a viral meme, forcing her to pack up her life with her daughter and move back in with her parents.

1.title: FR - Tuiskoms - S01E02 - Fleur and the Labour Strike
1.plot: Abigail finds herself swept up in a surprise romantic encounter. Fleur agrees to take on managing the Bloom & Bean, much to Werner's delight.

1.title: FR - Tuiskoms - S01E03 - Fleur and the Missing Goat
1.plot: Fleur's sudden interest in flower arranging blossoms into an obsession as she searches for the passion her bouquets desperately need.

1.title: FR - Tuiskoms - S01E04 - Fleur and the Storm
1.plot: Werner and Fleur head off to a local farm for the shop, finding unexpected common ground. Meanwhile, Abigail cultivates Kelly's natural talent for art.

1.title: FR - Tuiskoms - S01E05 - Fleur and the Protea
1.plot: Kelly takes her passion project to a comic book fair, hoping to meet her hero. Fleur gives love a chance for the first time since losing André.

1.title: FR - Tuiskoms - S01E06 - Fleur and the Churchbells
1.plot: Romance is blossoming for all three generations of Smit women, but can they embrace the wild rollercoaster of love without trying to self-sabotage?

1.title: FR - Tuiskoms - S01E07 - Fleur and the Persistence of Memory
1.plot: When tragedy hits Wilderness, Fleur must confront her relationships with both the living and the dead, as she makes the biggest decision of her life.

meta.plot: Après une avalanche de malheurs, Fleur, accablée par le deuil, embarque sa fille et retourne dans sa ville natale à la recherche d'une nouvelle raison d'être.

Seth Rogen joue le nouveau directeur d'un studio de cinéma. Cherchant désespérément l'approbation des plus grands, lui et ses exécutifs de chez Continental Studios jonglent entre pression commerciale et désirs créatifs tout en essayant de continuer de faire vivre le cinéma.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E01 - The Promotion
1.plot: Matt Remick is named the new head of Continental Studios—and put in charge of a project that threatens public humiliation.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E02 - The Oner
1.plot: The filming of an intricate sunset shot becomes complicated by Matt's set visit.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E03 - The Note
1.plot: Matt feels nervous about giving legendary director Ron Howard a difficult piece of feedback.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E04 - The Missing Reel
1.plot: A reel of film goes missing, sending Matt and Sal on a race against the clock to find it.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E05 - The War
1.plot: Frustrated by her position in the office hierarchy, Quinn wages a war against Sal.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E06 - The Pediatric Oncologist
1.plot: Matt’s ego is put to the test when his new doctor girlfriend brings him to a charity gala.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E07 - Casting
1.plot: The Continental team scrambles to come up with a movie cast that won't offend anyone.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E08 - The Golden Globes
1.plot: Matt tries to get Zoë Kravitz to thank him in her award acceptance speech.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E09 - CinemaCon
1.plot: When Matt sets out to throw the coolest party at CinemaCon, it backfires in psychedelic fashion.

1.title: FR - The Studio - S01E10 - The Presentation (2)
1.plot: If Matt’s team doesn't pull off an amazing CinemaCon presentation, the studio will be sold...to a tech company.

meta.plot: Parcourez l'univers de Mythic Quest avec ces quatre histoires individuelles. Suivez les vies d'employés, propriétaires de magasins de comics, musiciens d'orchestre itinérant et membres du département artistique qui cherchent le succès, l'amour et leur communauté.

1.title: FR - Side Quest - S01E01 - Song and Dance
1.plot: Phil, the art director of MQ, attempts to enjoy a Hawaiian vacation with his girlfriend while dealing with increasingly invasive calls from Ian Grimm.

1.title: FR - Side Quest - S01E02 - Pull List
1.plot: When a Black-owned comic book shop receives only one copy of the latest MQ comic, five superfans fight over who deserves it the most.

1.title: FR - Side Quest - S01E03 - Fugue
1.plot: A young cellist joins a touring video game orchestra, only to discover what happens when your dream job becomes a nightmare.

1.title: FR - Side Quest - S01E04 - The Last Raid
1.plot: Five high school friends in a long-running MQ guild discover a glitch that might break the game—or their friendship.

meta.plot: Découvrez un univers microscopique où des héros miniatures utilisent des super-pouvoirs extraordinaires pour survivre dans un cadre envoûtant.

1.title: FR - A Real Bug's Life - S01E01 - The Big City
1.plot: In the big city, only the most daring and streetwise bugs survive.

1.title: FR - A Real Bug's Life - S01E02 - Welcome to the Jungle
1.plot: In Costa Rica, a shiny bee and a tiny ant begin their first day on the job!

1.title: FR - A Real Bug's Life - S01E03 - Braving the Backyard
1.plot: Only the most adaptable bugs can thrive in an ever-changing Texan backyard.

1.title: FR - A Real Bug's Life - S01E04 - Land of Giants
1.plot: In the African savanna, two heroic bugs face mammoth challenges in a land of giants.

1.title: FR - A Real Bug's Life - S01E05 - The Busy Farm
1.plot: On a British farm, busy bugs join the farmer to lend a hand - or six!

meta.plot: Journée après journée, match après match, les meilleures équipes européennes s'affrontent pour remporter le trophée du tournoi des Six Nations.

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E01 - Let Battle Commence
1.plot: Scotland warm up for their opening match at Twickenham, where they haven't won against England in over a century. Is this the year they defy the odds?

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E02 - Hard Knock Life
1.plot: Italy's under pressure to perform in the England game. With last year's injury at the front of his mind, Sebastian Negri faces up to the challenge.

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E03 - On the Edge
1.plot: It's only round two but the stakes couldn't be higher as France, last year's reigning champions, face the world number one — Ireland.

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E04 - The Second Coming
1.plot: With the Wales team in turmoil on and off the pitch, their old coach returns to shake things up. Will his gamble pay off in the match against England?

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E05 - La Défense
1.plot: Following a rocky start, everything depends on the next game for last year's champions, France. Will they find their form, or is the title gone for good?

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E06 - Pressure Cooker
1.plot: With two teams in the championship on a losing streak, more than a wooden spoon is at stake as they prepare to face each other in the next round.

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E07 - The Last Dance
1.plot: All of the Scottish team are keen to be picked for the next round. But their coach has a hard choice to make, as his best players are plagued by injury.

1.title: FR - Six Nations: Full Contact - S01E08 - Agony or Ecstasy
1.plot: It's Super Saturday, the epic conclusion of rugby's biggest championship. As all six teams take to the pitch, there can only be one winner.

1.title: FR - Get Gotti - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When Paul Castellano, the head of the Gambino crime family, is murdered on a busy street, there's only one suspect: his former protege John Gotti.

1.title: FR - Get Gotti - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As the FBI and OCTF race to bring Gotti to trial, someone else gets there first. But will any charges stick to the slickest criminal in the city?

1.title: FR - Get Gotti - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Even when threatened with a potential life sentence, the "Dapper Don" keeps his cool — unaware of the bugs in his office recording his every word.

meta.plot:
Meurtre. Extorsion. Trafic de drogue. Racket... Les accusations contre John Gotti s'accumulent, mais est-ce que l'une d'entre elles restera fidèle à celui qui est surnommé « Don Teflon » ?

Racontée des deux côtés de la loi, en donnant la parole aux deux parties, cette docu-série des réalisateurs de « Fear City » suit et décrit la bataille du FBI pour faire tomber le tristement célèbre chef de la mafia John Gotti.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Maya attends the funeral of her murdered husband Joe at his family's stately home — then thinks she sees him, days later, on a hidden nanny cam.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: News about the murder weapon sets the investigation on a new course. Maya goes searching for answers and learns something surprising about her sister.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Maya chases the car that's been following her. With the adults distracted, Claire's children investigate the mystery of their mother's old photo.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The detectives question the owner of the motorbike from the crime scene. Kierce's condition catches up with him at a critical moment.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Maya sees an unexpected face when she takes Lily to see her grandmother. Kierce struggles to come to terms with his test results.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Suspicion falls on Maya when she's found at a crime scene — but she's the one who makes an accusation. McGreggor discovers something new about Kierce.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: As the police close in on a suspect, Maya decides to take drastic action. Shane begs her for answers — and learns the truth about their shared past.

1.title: FR - Fool Me Once - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: With the last pieces of the puzzle starting to fall into place, Maya confronts her husband's family one last time, and Kierce seeks help from Corey.

meta.plot: Quand Maya, une ancienne soldate, aperçoit sur une caméra espion son mari qu'elle pensait assassiné, elle découvre un complot meurtrier ancré au plus profond du passé.
Sur fond de témoignages et d'entretiens avec des experts, cette série documentaire explore les nombreux ovnis repérés durant les 50 dernières années et dévoile de nouvelles preuves.

1.title: FR - Encounters - S01E01 - Messengers
1.plot: In 2008, sightings of strange lights in the sky over Central Texas attract media attention and ridicule. New radar data supports eyewitnesses' claims.

1.title: FR - Encounters - S01E02 - Believers
1.plot: In 1994, over 60 children at a Zimbabwe school claimed to have seen aliens. Years later, witnesses maintain their accounts, while others are skeptical.

1.title: FR - Encounters - S01E03 - The Broad Haven Triangle
1.plot: A close encounter at a children's school in a tiny Welsh village spurs a series of sightings. An astrophysicist theorizes about aliens and water.

1.title: FR - Encounters - S01E04 - Lights Over Fukushima
1.plot: After the 2011 Fukushima nuclear disaster, survivors reported seeing bright lights above the power plant. For some, the event upholds a long-held belief.

meta.plot: Un journaliste d'investigation enquêtant sur la conspiration de la Pieuvre est retrouvé mort dans sa chambre d'hôtel. Des décennies plus tard, de nouveaux détails émergent.

1.title: FR - American Conspiracy: The Octopus Murders - S01E01 - The End
1.plot: Photojournalist Christian Hansen continues the work of Danny Casolaro, a reporter who mysteriously died while investigating a major political conspiracy.

1.title: FR - American Conspiracy: The Octopus Murders - S01E02 - The Trap Door
1.plot: Through Danny's research, details surface of an alleged global government surveillance network. In 1981, a triple murder fuels suspicions.

1.title: FR - American Conspiracy: The Octopus Murders - S01E03 - The Game
1.plot: Danny's investigation takes a turn when he uncovers a twisted web of organized crime that implicates the US intelligence community.

1.title: FR - American Conspiracy: The Octopus Murders - S01E04 - The Monster
1.plot: In his final days, Danny inches closer to answers — but his death raises more questions. Years later, Christian makes discoveries of his own.

meta.plot: Steve Martin est l'une des personnalités les plus appréciées et énigmatiques du monde du spectacle. À travers son histoire extraordinaire vue sous les angles du passé et du présent, vous découvrirez comment les débuts de Martin l'ont conduit, étonnamment, à la vie épanouissante qu'il mène aujourd'hui.

1.title: FR - STEVE! (martin) a documentary in 2 pieces - S01E01 - Then
1.plot: Steve Martin's meteoric rise was no easy feat. After early struggles, he went on to revolutionize standup—then walked away at 35.

1.title: FR - STEVE! (martin) a documentary in 2 pieces - S01E02 - Now
1.plot: Now in the golden years of his career, Martin is busier than ever. He retraces the transformation that led to happiness in his art and personal life.

meta.plot: Par la volonté de son oncle mort assassiné, Sandra Paoli, 30 ans, est propulsée à la tête d'un puissant clan mafieux . Une femme isolée, haïe et respectée à la fois dans un monde d'hommes, de violence, de meurtres, de racket et de mises à mort politiques. Pour se montrer à la hauteur, la jeune femme va devoir séduire, manipuler, réinventer le clan à sa manière !

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Lawyer Sandra Paoli discovers that her uncle, who rules a crime clan on the island of Corsica, has appointed her as his successor but the decision generates an angry backlash from many clan members.

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Sandra and her brother Jean-Michel, her right-hand man, take on their first official business as clan leaders when a rich local official named Zamponi tips them off about a potential jewellery heist.

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Sandra discovers a human trafficking ring is smuggling underage Albanian girls into Corsica to work as prostitutes. She vows to dismantle their network, even if it means collaborating with the police.

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: After an explosion in a building belonging to the Paoli clan, Sandra is tasked with finding the person responsible for the attack. Carmen, Jean-Michel's daughter, is kidnapped from outside her school.

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: An illegal distillery belonging to the Paolis is attacked and a crisis meeting is called. Who is trying to destabilise the clan? Sandra pays a visit to Jean-Michel's regular side-kick Martial Santoni.

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: In a rigged boxing match organised by the Paoli clan, the crime family's champion, Tino, is told to last nine rounds but unexpectedly collapses in the seventh and is shot down in the street afterwards.

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The Paoli clan await the arrival of a cargo boat loaded with illegal weapons, but they have unwittingly fallen into a police trap. Sandra seizes a moment of unrest to launch her political career.

1.title: FR - Mafiosa - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Sandra secures her election victory and tells Jean-Michel she will continue to pull strings for the clan but won't be getting her hands dirty in future. However, the authorities are slowly closing in.

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: L'arrestation de Jean-Michel, de Mattei, et de plusieurs hommes de mains a fragilisé le Clan. Venus d'horizons différents, de petits malfrats sans envergures pensent pouvoir secouer l'ordre établi en s'en prenant aux intérêts des Paoli. Sandra doit faire face et recruter pour parer à toutes éventualités. Mais le danger ne vient pas seulement de l'extérieur. Entendu par la Juge Morel, Jean-Michel découvre que sa soeur était informée de son arrestation et qu'elle n'a rien fait pour l'empêcher. La magistrate propose à Jean-Michel de bénéficier des mesures d'assouplissement de peines accordées aux repentis s'il consent à mettre officiellement sa soeur en cause dans les affaires de la famille...

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Destituée de son rôle de chef, Sandra veut reprendre le contrôle de la famille Paoli et se venger de ceux qui l'ont trahie. Seule et isolée, elle peut toutefois compter sur le soutien infaillible d'Andréani qui, pour elle, est prêt à courir tous les dangers... Lorsqu'il apprend par Agop Juherian surnommé le "Marseillais" que Jean-Michel Paoli offre deux millions d'euros à l'équipe qui le fera s'évader de prison, Léandri prend peur...

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Alertée par Agop Juherian du plan d'évasion de son frère, Sandra fait capoter l'opération de Léandri. Plusieurs membres du commando sont arrêtés, mais Hyacinthe parvient à prendre la fuite. Désespérée, persuadée qu'elle ne parviendra plus jamais à faire sortir son frère de prison, Sandra décide de se rendre. Elle propose au Président Larcher d'assumer toutes ses responsabilités en échange de la remise en liberté de son frère...

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Informé de la promesse faite à Larcher, Jean-Michel s'oppose ouvertement à l'assassinat du nationaliste corse, Paul Bonafedi. A quelques jours de l'ouverture de la table ronde qui doit réunir les mouvances nationalistes corses, Sandra donne ordre à Andréani, avec lequel elle entretient désormais une relation amoureuse complexe, d'abattre... Larcher ! A Marseille, Sandra retrouve Coco Casanova qui a maintenant toute confiance en elle puisqu'elle a relevé le défi haut la main. Coco propose aux Paoli de récupérer le territoire de son ami et associé Serge Ben Mussa, détenu aux Baumettes depuis plusieurs mois...

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Lors de la consulte provoquée par Sandra, les hommes du clan sont contraints de choisir entre Jean-Michel et sa soeur. Si les fidèles de l'un et de l'autre choisissent logiquement leurs camps, en revanche, Toussaint quitte Sandra pour Jean-Michel. Sandra ne tient pas à se laisser faire pour autant. Débute alors la guerre des clans : frère contre soeur ! Jean-Michel fait main basse sur les machines à sous que sa soeur s'apprêtait à installer dans les quartiers Nord de Marseille, machines dont la gestion leur incombait à tous deux...

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: La première livraison de drogue est un succès. Sandra ne laisse pas pour autant Jean-Michel profiter de sa "prise de pouvoir" sur les machines à sous. Et pour bien lui prouver qu'elle n'acceptera jamais d'avoir dû "scinder" la famille, elle fait détruire les machines fraîchement installées. Les paiements dont Jean-Michel doit s'acquitter prennant du retard, Coco se montre impitoyable. Jean-Michel a voulu s'occuper des machines à sous, maintenant il doit faire "rentrer" l'argent et donner sa part à Coco...

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Sandra met un terme à sa collaboration avec Patrick Ben Mussa après que celui-ci ait échafaudé un deal dangereux avec deux croates. Andréani est obligé de supprimer les deux hommes. Furieux d'être ainsi renvoyé d'un business dont il est l'initiateur, Patrick Ben Mussa rend visite à son père à la prison des Baumettes et lui raconte tout... La découverte du corps de Marie-Luce dans les toilettes de l'aéroport met à mal le dossier que Keller était en train de monter contre les Paoli. Persuadée qu'il a commis une faute grave en ne protégeant pas son témoin, la Juge Morel dessaisit le Commissaire de l'enquête. Keller décide de se venger...

2.title: FR - Mafiosa - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: Coco n'apprécie pas du tout de voir le frère et la soeur se livrer à une guerre fratricide en plein Marseille. La guerre, c'est mauvais pour les affaires. Il redoute que certains de ses associés lui reprochent de ne plus contrôler la situation. Coco exhorte alors Sandra d'accepter un compromis avec son frère. Mais la jeune femme ne veut rien entendre ce qui est ressenti par celui-ci comme un affront. Et lorsqu'il apprend par Patrick Ben Mussa que Sandra le "double" depuis plusieurs mois en se livrant à un trafic d'héroïne sur son territoire sans lui reverser le moindre subside, Coco décide de frapper fort...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: De retour à Bastia, Sandra Paoli se heurte au maire de Capu Biancu qui s'oppose à son projet de construction d'un complexe hôtelier sur le littoral. Craignant les représailles de la Mafiosa, celui-ci se met sous la protection de Grimaldi, un nationaliste affairiste. A l'hôpital, plongé dans le coma, Jean-Michel Paoli lutte contre la mort...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: Malgré les menaces des nationalistes, Sandra maintient la pression sur le maire et finit par obtenir son permis de construire. Furieux, Grimaldi lui déclare une guerre ouverte. Enfin sorti du coma, Jean-Michel promet à sa sœur qu'il fera en sorte de ne plus jamais se trouver sur sa route. Il propose à Mikael, le petit ami de sa fille, d'intégrer la nouvelle équipe qu'il est en train de former. Ensemble, ils font main basse sur un night-club, le Bellagio. A Marseille, Moktar demande à Sandra d'héberger son neveu Nader, en cavale après avoir abattu deux hommes qui maltraitaient une femme...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Furieux de voir le Bellagio repris par Jean-Michel, Tony et Manu, les deux lieutenants de la Mafiosa, font sauter le night-club. Se satisfaisant de moins en moins de sa place de lieutenant au sein de la famille Paoli, Tony veut s'affranchir et monter sa propre affaire. Sandra se rapproche de Manu afin qu'il ramène Tony à la raison...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Alors que Tony joue un jeu dangereux en incitant sournoisement Jean Santini à venger son frère, Jean-Michel, Mikael et leur bande braquent un fourgon bancaire et dérobent 5 millions d'euros. Côté nationaliste, Grimaldi cherche à rallier tous les groupuscules nationalistes dans son affrontement avec Sandra. Sandra, elle, succombe au charme de Nader contre lequel les policiers marseillais viennent de lancer un mandat...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Depuis Marseille, Moktar tente de mettre un terme à l'idylle entre son neveu et Sandra. A Bastia, les nationalistes s'organisent. Sous l'égide de Grimaldi, ils donnent une conférence de presse au cours de laquelle ils désignent officiellement Sandra comme leur ennemie. Grimaldi offre à Sandra de racheter ses terrains, mais celle-ci refuse...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: Grimaldi fait une offre à Tony : quitter le clan Paoli et éliminer Sandra...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot: Rongé par le remords après avoir donné Sandra à la police, Nader finit par tout lui avouer, tout en sachant que cette confidence risque de lui coûter cher. Trahie par l'homme qu'elle aime, Sandra l'abandonne à la colère de son oncle avant de retourner s'occuper de ses autres affaires urgentes. A Paris, Grimaldi fait pression sur le patron d'un cercle de jeu parisien, qui devait s'associer avec la Mafiosa. Persuadé qu'elle va enfin lui céder, le leader nationaliste réitère sa proposition d'achat. Sandra semble prête à accepter son offre, mais rien n'est encore décidé. Elle envisage des mesures radicales à l'encontre de Grimaldi...

3.title: FR - Mafiosa - S03E08 - Episode 8

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E01 - So Then a Bat or a Monkey
1.plot: Joel and Sheila's marriage gets a jumpstart when Sheila debuts a truly killer new personality and an anything-goes menu. And they used to be so normal.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E02 - We Can't Kill People!
1.plot: The Hammonds try to live their new truth, Abby comes to a hard realization while browsing comics, and Joel treats Sheila to a very expensive meal.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E03 - We Can Kill People
1.plot: Sheila's tummy is growling and Joel needs to find her someone tasty ASAP. Meanwhile, Abby embraces her inner badass and helps out a friend in need.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E04 - The Farting Sex Tourist
1.plot: Sheila inspires her friends and insults the principal. Joel bonds with Abby, and Dan makes a damning discovery while spraying for ants.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E05 - Man Eat Man
1.plot: Abby discovers that parents can't be trusted (especially hers). Joel learns there might be a cure for Sheila, and Dan puts his cards on the table.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E06 - Attention to Detail
1.plot: Joel and Sheila try dividing up the tasks, Eric and Abby stumble onto something big, and Dan learns that a realtor can only be pushed so far.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E07 - Strange or Just Inconsiderate?
1.plot: With the cops looking for Dan, Sheila dines on the evidence. But that's a lot of evidence. Meanwhile, Joel stops to smell the coffee.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E08 - How Much Vomit?
1.plot: A new-look Loki takes Joel and Sheila by surprise while Abby and Eric learn the fine art of leaving well enough alone.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E09 - The Book!
1.plot: Joel and Eric seek out the mysterious Anton at a paranormal convention while Sheila and Abby bond over their shared love of bad behavior.

1.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S01E10 - Baka, Bile and Baseball Bats
1.plot: Dr. Wolf is ready to get down to work, but with Sheila growing more aggressive by the minute, Joel worries it may be too late.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E01 - No Family is Perfect
2.plot: OK, let’s see here: Joel’s stuck in an asylum, Sheila’s chained to a pole, and Abby’s on the hunt for Serbian bile. Yep, sounds about right.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E02 - Coyote in Yoga Pants
2.plot: Eager to secure a lucrative new listing, Joel and Sheila brainstorm how to knock rival realtors out of contention ... without resorting to murder.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E03 - Moral Gray Area
2.plot: After an old nemesis asks for a favor, Joel and Sheila find themselves neck deep in Nazis, raffle tickets and surprisingly stunning woodwork.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E04 - The Queen of England
2.plot: Eric's having girl problems, Abby's rage is showing, there's a talking head in the basement, and now -- sheesh -- the neighbor wants lasagna.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E05 - Going Pre-med
2.plot: A snarky online review comes back to haunt Joel. Meanwhile, Sheila's new friendship proves problematic, and Abby leans into her new persona.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E06 - Pasión
2.plot: Is a colonel the clam connection? Joel’s on a stakeout to find out. Also, Abby has a date, and Sheila doesn't see eye to eye with her boss.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E07 - A Change of Heart
2.plot: 007, he ain’t. Eric’s plan to go undercover as a seafood distributor hits a snag. Meanwhile, Joel and Sheila worry Abby is getting out of control.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E08 - Easels and War Paint
2.plot: Sheila and Joel piece together the previous night's events while dealing with a professional setback. Abby gets a bold new look, courtesy of Lisa.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E09 - Suspicious Objects
2.plot: Joel and Sheila learn that the clampocalypse may hit sooner than they thought. Anne accepts constructive criticism like a pro.

2.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S02E10 - Halibut!
2.plot: With their options dwindling and their paranoia rising, Joel and Sheila consider making a move. Eric and Abby come up with a fracking good plan.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E01 - Wuffenloaf
3.plot: God, why me? That's what Sheila wants to know. Meanwhile, Joel feels a smidge threatened, Anne spreads the gospel, and Abby and Eric pretend to date.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E02 - Knighttime
3.plot: Sheila and Joel meet a knight and Anne lays down the law. Plus, there's a rumor going 'round that Eric and Abby are k-i-s-s-i-n-g. Ooooooh!

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E03 - We Let People Die Every Day
3.plot: Sheila and Joel want Anne out of their business. Hey, good luck with that. Also, Eric laments his heroics, and a woman's life hinges on potato salad.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E04 - More of a Cat Person
3.plot: Joel's feeling pressured to join the undead club. Meanwhile, Ramona wants Eric, the FBI wants answers, and poor Mr. Ball Legs wants some attention.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E05 - Belle and Sebastian Protect the Head
3.plot: Joel and Sheila engage in a battle of wits (well, kind of) with Tommy. Ron shares his plans. Lisa is forced to -- ugh -- get serious.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E06 - The Chicken and the Pear
3.plot: To stop the Knights of Serbia, one must become a Knight of Serbia. That's Joel's logic, anyway. Meanwhile, Sheila and Abby see another side of Jean.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E07 - A Specific Form of Recklessness
3.plot: Sheila's got a plan: turn Jean undead so she'll be around to meet her grandkid. Joel's not on board, but this train has already left the station.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E08 - Forever!
3.plot: A twist in the FBI's investigation takes Eric and Abby by surprise. Sheila introduces Jean to a new diet. Joel tries to trick the ever-elusive Ron.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E09 - Zombody
3.plot: Joel's eager to nail his interview and become a Knight of Serbia, but Sheila keeps salting his game. Meanwhile, Abby hits the town with a new friend.

3.title: FR - Santa Clarita Diet - S03E10 - The Cult of Sheila
3.plot: Joel and Sheila have a scary man's undivided attention. Abby and Eric are surprised by hungry visitors. A troublesome trio crashes the Hammonds' party.

1.title: FR - Divorce avec assurance - S01E01 - Episode 1

Determined to turn it into an insurance product, he forms a team with his recently divorced neighbor, Han-deul, as an underwriter, and his ex-ex-ex-wife, Na-rae, as a quant. Thus, the divorce insurance project officially begins.

1.title: FR - Divorce avec assurance - S01E02 - Episode 2

As the team pairs up to gather data for the divorce insurance policy, Ki-jun takes Han-deul to an unexpected place seemingly unrelated to their research.

meta.plot: Lorsque Ki-jun, un actuaire de Plus General Insurance, décide de développer une nouvelle police d'assurance divorce, une équipe se forme autour de lui, composée d'une souscriptrice, d'une quantificatrice, d'un évaluateur des risques, d'une experte en sinistres et d'un ancien agent d'assurance. Cette comédie romantique suit l'évolution de leurs relations amicales et amoureuses.

Après avoir été assassiné, le chasseur de primes Hub Halloran est ressuscité par le Diable et forcé à pourchasser des démons échappés de la prison de l'Enfer. En traquant ces démons, tour à tour aidé et entravé par sa famille qui a pris ses distances avec lui, Hub découvre l'origine des péchés qui ont damné son âme et aspire à une seconde chance dans la vie, l'amour et le monde de la country.

1.title: FR - The Bondsman - S01E01 - Pot O'Gold

1.title: FR - The Bondsman - S01E07 - Pyralis

1.plot: Transplant patient and now doctor, Frankie starts her first day in Renal rotation; best friend Lou battles surgery's boys' club; and flatmate Tabb starts as an intern.

1.title: FR - Pulse - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Frankie takes on the system to save a patient, and lands in trouble. Lou finds out it’s not always wise to have an affair with a boss; and Tabb questions his ability as a doctor.

1.title: FR - Pulse - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: When a heart transplant patient dies, Frankie fears the surgeons will close ranks to cover up a medical error. Lou realises she and best friend Frankie may be on different sides.

1.title: FR - Pulse - S01E07 - Episode 7

1.title: FR - Pulse - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Chad Berger's days as a doctor are coming to an end, but he is determined to see through a complex set of paired kidney exchange transplants. Will he be able to do so, or will his own condition get to him?

1.title: FR - Pulse - S01E09 -
FR - Pulse - S01E10 -

meta.plot: When successful high-flier Frankie Bell is brought crashing to earth by chronic kidney failure she targets an alternate future. Eight years on she is in her second year as a practicing doctor starting her first day in a Renal rotation. Driven to use her second chance to save others, Frankie must confront an ailing health system, and face her toughest challenge - learning to let go.

1.title: FR - David Blaine : Aux frontières de l'impossible - S01E01 - Brazil
1.plot: In Brazil, David Blaine seeks inspiration by immersing himself in his hosts' vibrant energy, passion and spontaneity. The exceptional daredevils, artists, explorers and athletes he encounters unite to help him bring an audacious feat to life that's lingered in his dreams for years.

1.title: FR - David Blaine : Aux frontières de l'impossible - S01E02 - Southeast Asia
1.plot: In Southeast Asia, David Blaine explores fascinating relationships with wildlife and how pain endurance can transform fear into magic. He meets practitioners who appear impenetrable by sharp objects and performers who can endure the stings of venomous creatures. David unpacks how people exploit fear in order to create wonder.

1.title: FR - David Blaine : Aux frontières de l'impossible - S01E03 - India
1.plot: Growing up, David Blaine was fascinated by images from India of extraordinary physical feats. This evolved into a life-long obsession with real acts that are so extreme they look like magic. Using secrets passed down over hundreds of years, people still perform these acts today. In India, David unearths these modern practitioners to explore how belief and performance intersect to make magic.

1.title: FR - David Blaine : Aux frontières de l'impossible - S01E04 - Arctic Circle
1.plot: In the stunning frozen landscape of the Arctic Circle, David Blaine explores humanity's curiously extreme ability to endure freezing temperatures. He meets and learns from people who reach beyond their limits to transform barriers into new frontiers and embody a sense of resilience, perseverance and grit that is unique to the region.

meta.plot: À la recherche de personnes incroyables qui accomplissent des exploits qui ressemblent à de la magie, David Blaine emmène les téléspectateurs dans un voyage époustouflant à travers certaines des cultures les plus extraordinaires du monde. Il cherche des âmes sœurs, trouve l'inspiration et acquiert des compétences vraiment exceptionnelles.

Au lycée Fûrin, on n'a pas la moyenne, mais on sait se battre ! Cet établissement a le pire taux de délinquance du pays. Fraîchement débarqué en ville, Haruka Sakura arrive avec l’intention de se mesurer aux meilleurs bagarreurs afin de devenir le meilleur de tous ! Cependant, il découvre rapidement que le lycée a changé depuis quelques années lorsqu’il est confronté à un groupe, Wind Breaker, qui protège la ville…

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - SAKURA ARRIVES AT FURIN
1.plot: An admirer of strong people with a complete disinterest in the weak, Haruka Sakura, a loner and delinquent high school student, aims to be a fighter at the top of Furin High School. Coming from outside the city, Sakura enrolls in Furin High School, infamous for its delinquents.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - THE HERO OF MY DREAMS
1.plot: It is the morning of the school entrance ceremony, and Furin High School has transformed into a group that protects the town now known as the "Chime of the Wind Breaker" — Bofurin.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - THE MAN WHO STANDS AT THE TOP
1.plot:
Furin High School's first-year Class 1 is infamous for its group of strong fighters.

One of the students in the class, Kyotaro Sugishita, becomes furious with what Sakura said and throws a punch at him. The two begin a spectacular fight, ignoring an aloof Hayato Suo, who's carefully watching the fight, and Nirei, who's now panicking.

A tremendously loud voice echoes throughout the school, interrupting the fight between the two young men. The owner of that voice that instantly changed the mood of the entire school is none other than Umemiya, the Representative of Bofurin. Sakura and the rest look nervously up at the speakers to hear Umemiya say something completely unexpected.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - CLASH
1.plot: A fight breaks out between Bofurin and Shishitoren as Bofurin tries to protect the town's middle schoolers. Sakura receives a declaration of war from the group's second-in-command, Jo Togame. Sakura and one of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Toma Hiragi, tell Umemiya what happened.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - A GENTLEMAN
1.plot: "That’s why I'm going to take all of Furin…and you for myself!" declares Shishitoren's leader, Choji Tomiyama, as he makes his way onto Furin High School grounds. Finally, it's a one-on-one showdown between Bofurin and Shishitoren!

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - VOW TO FOLLOW
1.plot: Tomiyama and Togame, far from worrying about their teammate who lost the battle, expel him from their team. While this peculiar spectacle shakes Sakura and the rest, Suo becomes unexpectedly emotional and wins against Minoru Kanuma, earning another win for Bofurin.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - FIGHT TO WIN
1.plot: It’s now time for the battle of those second-in-command: Sakura versus Togame — a fight that will set things on fire!

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - SUCCEEDING THE PAST
1.plot: Togame can no longer hide the fact he's feeling lost. He remembers when he met Tomiyama, the fun days he had with Shishitoren, how the team changed when Tomiyama became the leader, and the things he's done himself.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - UMEMIYA'S STYLE
1.plot: It's now time for a one-on-one fight between Umemiya and Tomiyama. Tomiyama believed that by winning against Umemiya, he would obtain Furin High School, freedom, and a sense of fun that would rival no other.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - DIALOGUE
1.plot: Admitting defeat, Tomiyama tries to pass Shishitoren on to Umemiya — to which Umemiya declares, "Instead of taking over your team, we'll be friends!" Bofurin and Shishitoren are dumbfounded at this turn of events but talks progress, food is brought, and a celebratory afterparty starts.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - NEW CLASSMATES
1.plot: With the fights against Shishitoren over, Class 1 enthusiastically welcomes Sakura, Nirei, and Suo's return. Their classmates, brimming with interest in the details of the fights, surround them, asking questions. Sakura can't hide his bashfulness.

1.title: FR - Wind Breaker [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - THE DEPENDABLE ONE

meta.plot: With the aid of unexpected friends, a gifted but introverted student confronts bullies and violent foes — unaware of how dangerous his world will become.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Si-eun is a model student who is always at the top of his school. Because he only cares about his studies, he has no friends at school. Young-bin, a boy in Si-eun's class, is annoyed by Si-eun's cynical attitude. On a mock test day, Young-bin decides to use Bum-seok, a new student, to mess with Si-eun's test.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Young-bin wants revenge on Si-eun for putting him in the hospital by hiring a couple of thugs he knows. Meanwhile, Si-eun gets closer to Soo-ho and becomes friends. Later, Soo-ho comes to Si-eun's rescue when he gets confronted by Young-bin and his thugs.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: When Gil-su sees his boys beaten up to a pulp, he gets furious and asks who did it. Young-bin lures Si-eun, Bum-seok, and Soo-ho and takes them to Gil-su. Gil-su threatens them to bring him 15 million won in three days. Si-eun asks Young for advice and information on Gil-su.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Si-eun sees Soo-ho's blood on the floor and calls Young-yi for help. Gil-su tells Seok-dae to come, so Young-yi follows him with her GPS tracking app on. Meanwhile, Soo-ho and Bum-seok are tied up by Gil-su's gang.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: While hanging out in a karaoke room with his friends, Bum-seok runs into the bullies from his previous school. Soo-ho makes them apologize, but Bum-seok isn't happy with Soo-ho ordering him around. Si-eun becomes more worried about Bum-seok who seems to be getting more unstable.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Bum-seok befriends with Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon, he reeks of alcohol every day. Si-eun thinks Bum-seok is being used by Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon. He also thinks Bum-seok is behaving that way because he is lonely. Si-eun wants to help Bum-seok, but Soo-ho thinks he's done enough. Meanwhile, Bum-seok pays Woo-young to beat Soo-ho on his birthday.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Si-eun gets beaten up by the guys Bum-seok paid to beat up Soo-ho. Si-eun gets seriously injured, but he doesn't tell Soo-ho about it to protect Bum-seok. Soo-ho finds out later and decides to confront Bum-seok. Bum-seok pays Woo-young again to beat up Soo-ho.

1.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Si-eun and Young-yi get anxious as they can't get hold of Soo-ho for too long. After Si-eun finishes his exams, he hears the shocking news. Meanwhile, Bum-seok's dad tries to make Bum-seok go study abroad.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Still affected by what happened to Su-ho, Si-eun withdraws from others. Seo Jun-tae contemplates taking a stand against the bullies — despite the risks.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: After being saved by Si-eun, Jun-tae attempts to befriend him — but both are soon dragged into Choi Hyo-man's revenge plot involving Go Hyun-tak.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: While doing volunteer work as punishment for fighting, Si-eun begins to form a bond with new friends — but trouble continues to find him.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: After Geum Seong-je crosses the line, Si-eun strikes a deal with Na Baek-jin — leaving Park Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Jun-tae alone in the violent crosshairs.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Worried for his father and backed into a corner, Hu-min confronts Baek-jin. Si-eun considers studying abroad after clashing with his distressed mother.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Si-eun, Jun-tae, and Hyun-tak seek out Hu-min, who has decided to work with Baek-jin to keep the peace. Still, Hu-min finds it difficult to comply.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: As Si-eun's absence leaves a gap, Baek-jin presses on with his violent mission. In response, Hu-min rallies his school and challenges him to a showdown.

2.title: EN - Weak Hero [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Eunjang students gather to engage in a final confrontation against Baek-jin's gang. In the end, who will prevail?

meta.plot: Trois meilleurs amis d'enfance se lancent dans une quête pour tirer le meilleur parti de leurs deux dernières années de collège en faisant une liste de 100 choses à atteindre avant qu'ils ne partent au lycée. Avec la liste et l'aide de leur conseiller d'éducation , ils le font à travers les hauts et les bas de l'école intermédiaire. Cela peut tourner mal....

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E01 - 100 Things to Do Before High School
1.plot: With the pressures of high school in their near future, CJ and her two best friends decide to embark on a series of middle school adventures while they can still take risks and have fun.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E02 - Start a Garage Band Thing!
1.plot: CJ, Fen and Crispo start a garage band with hopes of winning top prize at the school's music festival. But when creative differences break up the band, CJ must find a way to reunite the team in time for their big performance.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E03 - Run with the Bears Thing!
1.plot: The gang each sets out to conquer their fears, but when CJ is faced with talking to her 8th grade crush, she needs the help of Fenwick & Crispo to cross this item off the list.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E04 - Say Yes to Everything for a Day Thing!
1.plot: CJ notices how many times Fenwick says the word "no" so she convinces the guys to say yes for the day. But while agreeing to everything that is asked of you opens new doors, it also creates unanticipated problems.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E05 - Be a Fairy Godmother Thing!
1.plot: Hoping to insert a little magic into their middle school routine, CJ, Fen and Crispo set out to grant the wishes of some people in their lives.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E06 - Stay Up All Night Thing!
1.plot: A sleepover fund-raiser is held at school, and CJ and her pals want to stay awake for the event, but it's no easy task.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E07 - Adopt a Flour Baby Thing!
1.plot: CJ longs for a pet, but her mom is unsure she's ready, so she makes CJ look after a flour baby to prove she's responsible.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E08 - Change Your Look and See What Happens Thing!
1.plot: CJ and her pals experiment with their wardrobes and learn about the effects clothes can have.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E09 - Find Your Super Power Thing!
1.plot: CJ works with Fen and Crispo to find out their "special thing".

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E10 - Scavenger Hunt Thing!
1.plot: Crispo lacks funds for a concert ticket, so his pals scheme to get him one without him knowing they paid for it.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E11 - Make a New Friend Thing!
1.plot: CJ and the boys decide to expand their group, but making new friends throws each of them into unexpected situations.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E12 - Be a Mad Scientist Thing!
1.plot: The group decides to enter the science fair, but CJ cannot figure out what she wants to do and starts losing her spirit; however, Ronbie raises her spirits back up with a pep talk. Meanwhile, Fenwick builds a robot that is beaten by Mindy's better robot. Crispo tries multiple things to impress one of the judges, but repeatedly fails. Eventually, CJ figures out that she can enter her list of 100 things to do before high school because of the science of whether or not things on the list prepare someone for high school and Fenwick builds a robot that highly surpasses Mindy's, but it goes haywire and wrecks everyone's science fair projects, except Crispo's, whose science fair project ended up being himself because of what his body can do.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E13 - Join a Club Thing!
1.plot: When Crispo joins the Save the Baboons club, which is ran by Mindy and Blake, CJ and Fenwick, who were not allowed to join, try to find their own clubs. Fenwick joins the Super Genius club and CJ joins the Club club, which is boring. CJ and the other club members attempt to make it cooler, but it gets taken over by Mindy and Blake's club, so CJ tries one more time in a bigger room. When Crispo discovers that the money donations for the Save the Baboons club is going toward the club's expenses rather than saving the baboons, he leaves and join CJ's Club Awesome club, which becomes a huge success. However, it becomes too much of a success after Mindy's not able to go in, despite everyone being able to join, and CJ, Fenwick, and Crispo not even being allowed to go back in due to the club reaching capacity.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E14 - Have the Best Halloween Ever Thing!
1.plot: Due to a bad childhood experience, Principal Hader cancels the Halloween carnival. CJ, Fenwick, and Crispo make it their thing to figure out why Principal Hader hates Halloween and fix it. Meanwhile, Crispo is made fun of for wearing what others perceive as a costume for little children. He then changes to a more dark costume to be cool, but later realizes that he should not change simply because somebody doesn't like a particular feature about him.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E15 - Get the Most Out of a Sick Day Thing!
1.plot: CJ, Fenwick, and Crispo are all sick; CJ and Fenwick are both home while Crispo wants to know what it's like to have a sick day, but his parents don't ever allow him to stay home, no matter how sick he is. Meanwhile, to keep his perfect attendance record, Fenwick has Crispo walk around with Fenwick on an iPad. Later, Fenwick gives Crispo the idea to get on a bike and go over to CJ's house to make the best of his sick day, but when Crispo gets over there, CJ's not there because she came back to school since she was feeling a lot better thanks to some disgusting green liquid medicine her parents forced her to take earlier.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E16 - Sit at a Different Lunch Table Thing!
1.plot: CJ challenges her friends to sit at another lunch table during lunchtime and see how events occur differently.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E17 - Survive the Virus Attack Trapped in the Last Home Base Station on Earth Thing!
1.plot: CJ and her friends discover the challenges of taking care of themselves when they find that they are home alone for the night

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E18 - Run for Office Thing!
1.plot: CJ and the boys decide to make their voices heard during the 7th grade elections; a friendly competition turns negative

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E19 - Always Tell the Truth (But Not Always) Thing!
1.plot: When a simple lie morphs into an out of control event, CJ and the boys discover the power of words and the messy business surrounding lies, truths and the consequences of telling both.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E20 - Become a Millionaire and Give It All Away Thing!
1.plot: The children are ready to redeem their rewards for a school achievement trip to the water park, but their "pootybucks" go missing.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E21 - Leave Your Mark Thing!
1.plot: CJ, Fen and Crispo try to find their own unique ways of creating lasting memories of their time at Pootatuck.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E22 - Meet Your Idol Thing!
1.plot: The friends plan to meet their idols, but when their carefully laid plans begin to unravel they realize the importance of patience.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E23 - Master a Thing Thing!
1.plot: The gang becomes inspired by the fact that it takes 10,000 hours to master something, so they decide to master their own things.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E24 - Raise Your Hand Thing!
1.plot: Crispo attempts to overcome his fear of asking for help in class; CJ volunteers to escort fifth grade students through the school; Fenwick tries to become the high five king of middle school.

1.title: FR - 100 choses à faire avant le lycée - S01E25 - Get Your Heart Pre-Broken Thing!
1.plot: After Ronbie's girlfriend dumps him, CJ and the boys decide to take the initiative and get their hearts broken.

meta.plot: Containing extensive, never-before-seen archives and more than 80 interviews of past and present Boston Celtics legends, this series chronicles the history, cultural impact, and extraordinary tale of the NBA's winningest and most storied franchise, the Boston Celtics,

1.title: FR - Celtics City - S01E01 - Chapter I: Founding Fathers
1.plot: Led by Bob Cousy and Bill Russell, the Celtics become an NBA dynasty, but racial tensions in Boston and beyond augur a turbulent era ahead.

1.title: FR - Celtics City - S01E02 - Chapter II: No Final Victories
1.plot: Amid backlash for his commitment to civil rights, Bill Russell makes history as the first Black head coach in professional sports.

1.title: FR - Celtics City - S01E03 - Chapter III: All Swept Up
1.plot: The Celtics win a pair of titles in the ‘70s amid racial unrest, and near the end of the decade, they draft Indiana State star Larry Bird.

1.title: FR - Celtics City - S01E04 - Chapter IV: Great Hope, Period
1.plot: Larry Bird arrives in Boston as a beacon of hope for a city still grappling with racial tensions and its identity in flux. His blend of talent and tenacity embodies Boston's working-class ethos, while his rivalry with Magic Johnson and battles against Julius Erving help revive a struggling NBA and elevate it to new heights. With the additions of Robert Parish and Kevin McHale, Bird helps lead the Celtics to their 14th championship in 1981. However, internal discord threatens to derail another potential dynasty.

1.title: FR - Celtics City - S01E05 - Chapter V: F**k the Celtics
1.plot: As the Celtics and Lakers battle for basketball supremacy, Larry Bird and Magic Johnson's rivalry captivates the sports world. The Celtics and the Lakers trade titles in epic showdowns as the teams' racial identities fuel complex conversations about Boston's lingering reputation. In 1986, Bird helps lead the Celtics to one of the most dominant seasons in NBA history, but then an unthinkable tragedy changes everything.

meta.plot: Une vitrine des merveilles, des secrets et des fragilités des Amériques, racontée par Tom Hanks.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E01 - The Atlantic Coast
1.plot: The Atlantic Coast, where wild horses battle, bald eagles chase ospreys and sharks protect fish. Raccoons navigate city life and black bears search for food in ancient forests.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E02 - Mexico
1.plot: Mexico, where deserts meet tropics. See new footage of fledgling pygmy owls, orca hunting, new species in flooded caves and orchid bees filmed in incredible detail.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E03 - The Wild West
1.plot: The Wild West, where coyotes face a snowbound Yellowstone, bison battle on the plains and more.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E04 - The Amazon
1.plot: The Amazon, the largest rainforest on Earth; drone footage captures giant otters hunting together while black caimans prey on newly hatched turtles; a harpy eagle chick's first days in the canopy and army ants on the move reveal new behaviors.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E05 - The Frozen North
1.plot: The Frozen North, where wolves and polar bears vie for food, hares outsmart lynx and walrus sing on rocky shores. As summer arrives, grouse perform mating dances, caribou migrate vast distances and salmon race upstream to survive.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E06 - The Gulf Coast
1.plot: As “The Gulf Coast” unfolds, viewers will witness the delicate balance of life in this coastal paradise. From migratory birds and sea turtles to the vibrant marine life beneath the waves, each moment will reveal the interconnectedness of the ecosystem. This episode is sure to resonate with nature lovers and anyone curious about the wonders of North America.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E07 - Andes
1.plot: The Andes, Earth's longest mountain range, where rare hummingbirds compete for mates and more.

1.title: FR - Les Amériques - S01E08 - The Caribbean
1.plot: The Caribbean, where sailfish hunt with speed, sperm whales dive for squid and millions of red crabs migrate to the sea; hummingbirds defend territories post-hurricane, and on nearby islands, capuchin monkeys use tools to survive.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E01 - Hello, Honey!
1.plot: When Meghan's friend Daniel Martin comes to visit, she prepares a thoughtful guest basket, then harvests honey for DIY beeswax candles and a sweet treat.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E02 - Welcome to the Party
1.plot: Fellow toddler mom Mindy Kaling drops by Montecito to help Meghan plan a kid-friendly tea party in the garden. But first, frittatas and parfaits.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E03 - Two Kids from LA
1.plot: Chef Roy Choi bonds with Meghan about growing up in Los Angeles, while teaching her a foolproof way to cook with spicy Korean flavors.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E04 - Love Is in the Details
1.plot: Meghan and her polo pal Delfina Figueras enjoy a hike in the great outdoors, followed by an afternoon picnic featuring fresh, homemade focaccia.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E05 - Surprise and Delight
1.plot: Meghan hosts her longtime friends Abigail Spencer and Kelly Zajfen for a breezy ladies' lunch, then shares an easy tip for everyday flower arrangements.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E06 - The Juice Is Worth the Squeeze
1.plot: When Meghan's girlfriends come over for game night, a local chef pops into the kitchen to help her prepare a gourmet taco bar.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E07 - Elevating the Everyday
1.plot: Meghan assembles a harvest basket for her dear friend and neighbor Vicky Tsai, then they make Vicky's potsticker recipe and enjoy home beauty treatments.

1.title: FR - With Love, Meghan - S01E08 - Feels Like Home
1.plot: To celebrate her new business, Meghan and legendary chef Alice Waters whip up fresh California cuisine for a brunch party with family and friends.

meta.plot: Meghan, duchesse de Sussex, invite des amis et des célébrités dans une magnifique propriété californienne, où elle parle cuisine, jardinage et art de recevoir.

1.title: FR - Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue - S01E01 - Dead Reckoning
1.plot: Nine people survive a plane crash into the Mexican jungle. But they don’t know that a murderer lurks in their midst… Nine days later, their bodies are recovered by the Mexican army. One of the passengers is missing...but who?

1.title: FR - Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue - S01E02 - Black Angels
1.plot: Alliances form, enemies are made and lines are drawn as the passengers search for food and water; but when another passenger dies, they realize they may all be targets.

1.title: FR - Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue - S01E03 - Rapido
1.plot: The survivors work out how to call for help - but are faced with a treacherous climb; as some of the group begin to crack under the pressure, a third death - the most violent so far - warns that they are running out of time.

1.title: FR - Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue - S01E04 - The Short Straw
1.plot: The deadly secret hidden in Flight CBZ517 is discovered, but it still doesn't explain the murders or help the survivors escape; the passengers believe they have found the traitor in the group - but are they right?

1.title: FR - Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue - S01E05 - Cloud Cover
1.plot: Air authorities search desperately for the plane and federal agencies spring into action; as the group becomes smaller and smaller, the last survivors know they are going to have to fight to stay alive.

meta.plot: Suivez les aventures de neuf inconnus qui se retrouvent perdus dans une jungle mexicaine isolée après le crash de leur petit avion en provenance du Guatemala et à destination des États-Unis. Les survivants sont assassinés l'un après l'autre, et les passagers restants doivent résoudre ce mystère avant d'être à leur tour victimes du tueur.

1995. Lidia, jeune recrue ambitieuse de l’anti-terrorisme, est envoyée à Peranne, pour enquêter sur le scalp d’un imam, aux côtés de Jean, gendarme désabusé, hanté par ses souvenirs de la guerre d’Algérie. 25 ans plus tard, l’ancien maire de Peranne est assassiné. Et alors que Lidia est au faîte d’une carrière en apparence irréprochable, Jean disparaît du jour au lendemain. Le passé que tous croyaient définitivement enterré refait surface.
