1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Two Soaps and a Talc
1.plot: Kath is planning her anniversary celebrations, while Diane is worried she’s not got enough cheese for the soiree she’s organising for the ‘French exchange people’.  Meanwhile, Martin is under financial pressure and needs to make some big decisions - decisions that will end up impacting him and everyone close to him.

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Miss Stockport
1.plot: Diane is worried that she didn’t impress the school governors, Kath is revealing more than she should, and Martin is desperately trying to get his hands on a chunk of cash.

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - A Dark Horse
1.plot: Moneylenders move in on Martin’s family, leaving him with no choice but to fight back. Meanwhile, Diane and Kath pursue Martin in the hope that they can work out what he’s up to.

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - No Words Are Spoken
1.plot: Kath visits Martin in his office and gets way more than she bargained for, and Diane’s trip to the bank leaves her red-faced and running for the door.

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - White Goods
1.plot: Diane puts her trust in Kath and sends her on a covert mission while she reluctantly goes to dinner at Sandy Cooper’s house with Martin. But will Kath be discovered?

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Dynamite
1.plot: It’s the big day for Kath and Diane as they attempt to finally exact their revenge on Martin. But whilst Diane has never felt more alive, is Kath having second thoughts?

meta.plot: It’s Stockport 1990 and Martin Parker, a man with the ambition of Alan Sugar and the looks of Robert Kilroy Silk is slowly waking up to the fact that things are changing. With a chain of electrical stores, a wife, kids and a flash car, he has the perfect life. But in reality he’s swimming in a sea of debt and lies, and it falls to the two women in his life, Kath and Diane to plot his downfall.

1.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Indiana government worker Leslie Knope is given the assignment to convert an abandoned quarry pit into a community park. A documentary film crew follows Leslie through her mishaps and gaffes as she tries to make her assignment a reality.

1.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S01E02 - Canvassing
1.plot: Leslie decides that she and her committee need to go door-to-door to gain support for the park project as well as support for an upcoming town hall meeting, but their mission does not go as planned. Meanwhile, Tom wanders away from the canvassing group and uses his own creative recruitment tactics.

1.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S01E03 - The Reporter
1.plot: Leslie arranges for a reporter to do a story about her park project, but she and her committee have the worst time staying on topic. She then calls Mark to help her save the story, but it ends up hurting more than helping. Meanwhile, Tom does all he can to suck up to his boss.

1.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S01E04 - Boys' Club
1.plot: Leslie attempts to break into the political "old boy's club," causing an ethical dilemma. Meanwhile, Andy plans a surprise for Ann.

1.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S01E05 - The Banquet
1.plot: During a banquet honoring her mother's public service, Leslie tries to convince a local zoning official to support her proposed park project. Meanwhile, Mark and Tom try to meet some ladies.

1.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S01E06 - Rock Show
1.plot: Leslie attends what she believes is a business meeting with an elderly local government bigwig, unaware that her mother has secretly set her up on a blind date. Andy plays his first gig since breaking both of his legs in the pit.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E01 - Pawnee Zoo
2.plot: When Leslie decides to marry two penguins to promote the local zoo, she inadvertently causes an uproar when both penguins turn out to be male. Meanwhile, Mark puts Ann in an awkward situation when he asks her to go see a movie.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E02 - The Stakeout
2.plot: While tending to the new community garden, Leslie and Tom discover someone has planted marijuana among the vegetables. In an effort to catch the people responsible, they pull an all-night stakeout. With Leslie's permission, Ann decides to go on a date with Mark.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E03 - Beauty Pageant
2.plot: Leslie gets to judge a beauty contest, but ends up having conflicting opinions on "the ideal woman" with the other judges. While on a date with Mark, Ann learns Andy has been living in the pit.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E04 - Practice Date
2.plot: Leslie is nervous about her first date with Dave, so Ann takes her on a practice date to help her prepare. Meanwhile, after a local councilman is caught up in a sex scandal, Tom, Ron, April and Mark decide to see who can uncover the worst dirt on each other.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E05 - Sister City
2.plot: Leslie plays host to the Parks and Recreation department from Pawnee’s sister city, Boraqua, Venezuela, and is shocked at the cultural differences. Tom becomes an errand boy, and April plays hard to get.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E06 - Kaboom
2.plot: Leslie, Ann and the rest of the Parks Department volunteer to help the organization KaBOOM! build a playground for a neighboring town. After building an entire playground in one day, Leslie gets frustrated at the lack of progress with the pit, and takes some advice from Mark to cut through the red tape.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E07 - Greg Pikitis
2.plot: Leslie enlists the help of Dave and Andy in order to catch a local teen vandal. Meanwhile, Ann struggles to make her Halloween party fun, and ends up getting help from an unlikely source.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E08 - Ron and Tammy
2.plot: Leslie is upset when she learns the library department wants to take over her lot. Making matters worse, the library is run by Ron's ex-wife Tammy, who still has a powerful emotional hold on him. Meanwhile, Andy gets a job in hopes of winning Ann back.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E09 - The Camel
2.plot: After one of the murals ("The Spirit of Pawnee") in City Hall is defaced, Leslie and the Parks Department compete to come up with a new design. Meanwhile, Andy and Ron share an uncomfortable moment at the shoeshine stand.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E10 - Hunting Trip
2.plot: Leslie tries to prove she can hang with the guys so she invites herself on Ron’s annual hunting trip, but things don’t go as planned. Meanwhile, April and Andy bond in the office while everyone is away.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E11 - Tom's Divorce
2.plot: After Leslie finds out that Tom is getting a divorce, the department takes him out on the town to cheer him up. Meanwhile, Andy tries to hustle Mark in a game of pool.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E12 - Christmas Scandal
2.plot: Leslie designs the Pawnee Winter Wonderland Festival, but has to hide from the press when a meeting with a disgraced Councilman lands her in the middle of a sex scandal. Meanwhile, Ron offers to cover for Leslie for the day, and quickly discovers how much work she really does.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E13 - The Set Up
2.plot: Ann sets Leslie up on a blind date with a co-worker, which does not go as well as Leslie hoped. An old friend of Ann's makes Mark feel insecure.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E14 - Leslie's House
2.plot: After an amazing date with Justin in Indianapolis, Leslie tries to impress him with a dinner party at her house.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E15 - Sweetums
2.plot: The Parks Department forms a partnership with a local company to sell energy bars at the parks in Pawnee, but Leslie tries to stop the deal when she discovers how unhealthy the snacks are. Mark reluctantly agrees to help Tom move out of his house.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E16 - Galentine's Day
2.plot: When Leslie hears her mom’s story about an old flame, she and her boyfriend Justin track him down and reunite them on Valentine’s Day. Meanwhile, Andy and his band are nervous about playing a gig at the Senior Center.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E17 - Woman of the Year
2.plot: Leslie is outraged when Ron wins a “Woman of the Year” award for a project she started. Meanwhile, Tom is desperate to find some money to invest in a local Pawnee club.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E18 - The Possum
2.plot: When a possum bites the mayor's dog on a golf course, Leslie is asked to form a task force to catch the pesky animal. Meanwhile, Ron is upset when Mark refuses to bend the rules for him.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E19 - Park Safety
2.plot: After Jerry gets mugged by a bunch of kids, Leslie meets with the head park ranger in hopes of improving park safety. Meanwhile, everyone tries to be nicer to Jerry once he returns to the office.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E20 - Summer Catalog
2.plot: Preparing the Summer Events Catalog, Leslie decides to take Ron and the past directors of the Parks Department out for a picnic lunch. Tom enlists the help of Ann and Mark to pose for the cover photo.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E21 - 94 Meetings
2.plot: Ron is furious when April mistakenly schedules a ton of meetings for him. Meanwhile, Leslie fights to preserve a historical landmark.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E22 - Telethon
2.plot: Leslie hosts a late-night shift for a local telethon, and lands former Indiana Pacer Detlef Schrempf as a celebrity guest. Meanwhile, Mark has big plans for his relationship with Ann.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E23 - The Master Plan
2.plot: Leslie is disappointed when her new park plans are put on hold by a visit from two state auditors. April has plans for Andy at her birthday party, and Ann tries to piece together a romantic mystery.

2.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S02E24 - Freddy Spaghetti
2.plot: When Ben prevents Leslie from holding a children’s concert, she takes matters into her own hands. Mark makes some big decisions about his life, and Andy gets some unexpected romantic attention.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E01 - Go Big or Go Home
3.plot: Leslie and the Parks Department return to work after three months to discover that the budget crisis still looms. After unsuccessfully trying to have their budget restored by using Ann to charm Chris with a date, Leslie decides to make an all or nothing play by resurrecting the Pawnee Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Ben restarts the youth basketball league and instates Ron and Andy to coach the only two teams. April returns from a vacation with a new boyfriend.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E02 - Flu Season
3.plot: While planning for the local Harvest Festival, Leslie is struck with the flu and is forced to go to the hospital. Ron and Andy have a day of male bonding, and Tom hits the spa.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E03 - Time Capsule
3.plot: Leslie wants to bury a time capsule that encapsulates life in Pawnee, but an odd suggestion from a local man causes unforeseen consequences. Andy seeks help from Chris about how to win back April.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E04 - Ron & Tammy: Part Two
3.plot: Tom tries to get back at Ron by going out on a date with Ron's ex-wife Tammy, while Leslie tries to protect Ron from falling prey to her charms. Meanwhile, April is assigned to work with Chris.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E05 - Media Blitz
3.plot: While advertising for the Harvest Festival, Ben has to deal with some troubling questions about his past. Meanwhile, Andy continues to try to win April back.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E06 - Indianapolis
3.plot: Ron and Leslie take a road trip to the big city in order to visit Ron's favorite place which happens to be a steakhouse, but Leslie has alternative motives for the trip.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E07 - Harvest Festival
3.plot: It's make it or break it for the Parks Department at the Harvest Festival which is full of surprises.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E08 - Camping
3.plot: Leslie takes the whole department camping in order to brainstorm new ideas. Meanwhile, Andy attempts a romantic gesture for April, while Ann gets nervous when Chris returns to Pawnee as the new city manager.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E09 - Andy and April's Fancy Party
3.plot: April and Andy host a dinner party for the Parks Department. Meanwhile, Ann tries to move on from Chris at a singles' party.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E10 - Soulmates
3.plot: Leslie tries an online dating service, but doesn't end up with a stranger as she expects. Also, Chris challenges Ron to a grilling competition as part of his plans to make Pawnee healthier.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E11 - Jerry's Painting
3.plot: Jerry’s contribution to Leslie’s community art show causes a stir. Ben moves in with April and Andy and attempts to teach them how to be adults. Meanwhile, Leslie is frustrated by Chris and his interoffice dating rules.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E12 - Eagleton
3.plot: Leslie's ex-best friend, Lindsay Carlisle Shay, launches an attack on Pawnee, banning residents from visiting a nearby park in the neighboring city of Eagleton with a large fence, causing Leslie to go to war with Eagleton. Meanwhile, everyone finds out that it is Ron's birthday, a fact that he went to extreme lengths to conceal.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E13 - The Fight
3.plot: When Leslie tries to get Ann a job at city hall, her lukewarm reaction causes their first-ever fight. Tom invites the entire department to the Snakehole Lounge to help him promote his new alcohol, "Snake Juice."

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E14 - Road Trip
3.plot: When Chris sends Leslie and Ben on a trip to Indianapolis, Leslie is afraid she won't be able to deny her feelings for him. Ron teaches a young student about his views on government. Meanwhile, Andy gets his feelings hurt by April after playing Tom's new game.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E15 - The Bubble
3.plot: Everyone in the office is unhappy when Chris decides to make some big changes in the parks department -- especially Tom who starts to question his career choices. Leslie is caught off guard when Ben has a meeting with her mom.

3.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S03E16 - Li'l Sebastian
3.plot: Leslie and the parks team put together a memorial service for a dearly departed friend. Meanwhile, Tom makes a big life decision, while Chris reacts badly to a health problem.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E01 - I'm Leslie Knope
4.plot: Leslie is torn between Ben and her dreams of running for public office, while Ron braces himself for the arrival of his first wife, the original Tammy.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E02 - Ron and Tammys
4.plot: Ron's first ex-wife, Tammy One, reenters his life and tries to control his every move. Meanwhile, Ben helps Tom balance the books at his new company, and Ann makes a PSA, with help from Chris.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E03 - Born and Raised
4.plot: Leslie's book about Pawnee comes out just in time for her campaign. Ann tries to bond with Ron and April.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E04 - Pawnee Rangers
4.plot: Ron takes his boys-only troop of Pawnee Rangers into the wild. Not wanting the girls to feel left out, Leslie also takes her troop of Pawnee Goddesses on an adventure weekend. Meanwhile, a reluctant Ben joins Tom and Donna for a day of relaxation, and Chris spends some time with Jerry.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E05 - Meet 'n' Greet
4.plot: Andy and April host a Halloween bash at their house. Tom emcees an event for Leslie's campaign. Andy and April receive an unusual wedding present from Ron and Ann.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E06 - End of the World
4.plot: A local Pawnee group predicts the end of days, causing chaos in the Parks department.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E07 - The Treaty
4.plot: Leslie enlists the help of Ben, Andy and April to host a Model U.N. for Pawnee Central High School. Chris asks Ann for her advice on love when a date cancels on him. Meanwhile, Ron struggles to find a replacement for Tom.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E08 - Smallest Park
4.plot: Leslie uses her new tourist attraction as a way to spend more time with Ben. Meanwhile, Ron  and April encourage Andy to go to college, and Chris tasks Tom and Jerry with revamping the Parks and Rec logo.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E09 - The Trial of Leslie Knope
4.plot: Leslie has to face an ethics committee about her secret relationship with Ben after they come clean to Chris.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E10 - Citizen Knope
4.plot: Unable to get work done from inside the Parks Department, Leslie forms a citizen action group and fights from the outside. Meanwhile, everyone in the office brainstorms ideas for what to get Leslie for Christmas.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E11 - The Comeback Kid
4.plot: Leslie enlists everyone's help in staging an attention-getting event. Ben takes up a new hobby, while April and Andy adopt a pet.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E12 - Campaign Ad
4.plot: Faced with a tough new opponent, Leslie and Ben disagree on the content of her first campaign ad. Ron is very uncomfortable when Chris tries to befriend him, while Andy and April make a trip to the doctor.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E13 - Bowling for Votes
4.plot: Leslie and Ben host a bowling night after receiving feedback about Leslie's campaign. April, Chris, and Jerry hold a competition to see who can raise the most funds.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E14 - Operation Ann
4.plot: Leslie works to find Ann a Valentine's date. Ron helps Ben with a scavenger hunt, and Chris becomes depressed over his love life.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E15 - Dave Returns
4.plot: While trying to get an endorsement from the Chief of Police, Leslie and Ben awkwardly run into Leslie's old flame, Dave. Meanwhile, Andy and the rest of the office work on a theme song for Leslie's campaign.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E16 - Sweet Sixteen
4.plot: Leslie realizes that the department has forgotten Jerry's birthday and decides to throw a party for him at a special location. Meanwhile, Tom is flabbergasted when he finds out Ann doesn't share his taste in music.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E17 - Campaign Shake-Up
4.plot: Leslie and Ben are caught off guard when her opponent Bobby Newport hires a powerful campaign manager from Washington. Chris forces Ron to start interviewing replacements for Leslie when work starts falling through the cracks, and an unlikely officemate solves a challenging problem.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E18 - Lucky
4.plot: Leslie and Ben are thrilled when Buddy Wood wants to interview Leslie for his Indianapolis talkshow. April and Ron prep Andy for his final exam in his Women’s Studies course.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E19 - Live Ammo
4.plot: Leslie discovers that the Parks Department budget is about to be cut, and she later meets the City Council member she is running to replace. Chris and Ron visit a meditation center.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E20 - The Debate
4.plot: Leslie goes toe-to-toe with Bobby Newport in a debate. Ann, Tom, and Chris work in the media spin room, while Ron goes the extra mile to save a party for Leslie's donors.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E21 - Bus Tour
4.plot: An important person in Pawnee dies while Leslie is on a bus tour for the final day of her campaign. Meanwhile Andy investigates a security threat, and Chris finds a cure for his depression.

4.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S04E22 - Win, Lose, or Draw
4.plot: It's election day in Pawnee, and Leslie and Bobby Newport are separated by a razor-thin margin. While everyone waits with Leslie for the race to be called, they ponder their futures, and their new opportunities.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E01 - Ms. Knope Goes to Washington
5.plot: Leslie and Andy visit Ben and April at their new jobs in Washington D.C., and Leslie feels overwhelmed by the city -- especially after meeting two of her idols. Meanwhile, Ron throws a "thank you" barbeque for the entire Parks and Recreation staff.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E02 - Soda Tax
5.plot: Leslie decides to wage war on obesity in Pawnee in her first mission as city councilor by passing a city-wide soda tax. Meanwhile, Andy tries to get in shape for his police-entrance exam, and Ben struggles to connect with the interns in his office.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E03 - How a Bill Becomes a Law
5.plot: Leslie helps a local swim team get more practice time by working on a new law that extends the hours at the community pool; Ron finds himself filling a pothole for a local woman (Lucy Lawless) as part of Chris' new plan to solve citizens' problems around the city; April and Ben take a road trip to Pawnee.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E04 - Sex Education
5.plot: An STD outbreak amongst Pawnee seniors prompts Leslie to conduct a sex education class. Meanwhile, Ron helps Tom adjust to life without technology after his gadgets are taken away, and Ben and April meet Congressman Murray for the first time.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E05 - Halloween Surprise
5.plot: A new job offer for Ben causes Leslie to contemplates their future. Meanwhile, Ron and Andy take Diane's girls out trick-or-treating, and Tom searches for a new business idea.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E06 - Ben's Parents
5.plot: Leslie is nervous about meeting Ben's divorced parents. Tom prepares to pitch his new business to Ron with Jean-Ralphio's help. Chris rides an emotional rollercoaster.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E07 - Leslie vs. April
5.plot: Leslie gets upset when April tries to get Lot 48 made into a dog park. Meanwhile, Tom enlists Ben’s help as he tries to launch his new business venture, and Andy hones his crime scene investigation skills.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E08 - Pawnee Commons
5.plot: Leslie and Ben meet with an architect from their rival town, Eagleton, about designs for a new park.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E09 - Ron and Diane
5.plot: Ron, Diane, and Leslie attend a wood working awards dinner after one of Ron's handcrafted chairs is nominated, but the happy occasion is threatened by the arrival of Tammy II. Meanwhile, Jerry hosts a holiday party at his home with his wife, and some of his friends are shocked to find they were not invited.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E10 - Two Parties
5.plot: Ben and Leslie's rival bachelor and bachelorette parties each take on a very different tune.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E11 - Women in Garbage
5.plot: Leslie and April handle a garbage route, while Tom asks Andy and Ben to teach him about basketball. Meanwhile, Ron is left to watch Diane's kids while their babysitter is out of town.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E12 - Ann's Decision
5.plot: Ann tries to get to know herself as Leslie meddles in one of her biggest life decisions. Meanwhile, things go south when Ben enlists the guys to help choose a caterer for the wedding.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E13 - Emergency Response
5.plot: Leslie and Ben organize a black tie gala to raise money for their park, but their plans are derailed when a city-wide emergency response drill is called. Meanwhile, Andy prepares to take his Police Academy Exam and Ron fills in for Leslie on Pawnee Today.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E14 - Leslie and Ben
5.plot: Leslie and Ben are getting married, and have to cram months of planning into two hours. Meanwhile, Ron's temper gets him in trouble.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E15 - Correspondents' Lunch
5.plot: Leslie's speech she prepared for a special event is stolen. Ben begins his new job at the Sweetums Charity Foundation. Ann summons the courage to ask an important question.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E16 - Bailout
5.plot: Leslie is determined to help a local video store stay in business, while Chris offers Tom advice on how to deal with a difficult employee. Elsewhere, Ann resorts to blackmail to get April to be her friend.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E17 - Partridge
5.plot: Leslie accompanies Ben on a trip to his hometown which has offered him a key to the city. Ron deals with a lawsuit filed against him by Councilman Jamm. Ann and Chris take a parenting compatibility quiz.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E18 - Animal Control
5.plot: Leslie decides to give the Animal Control Department a much-needed makeover. Ann tries to get Ron the medical attention he needs. Ben, Tom, and Andy recruit donors for their charity foundation.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E19 - Article Two
5.plot: Leslie works to get rid of outdated laws from the original town charter. April and Ron receive management training from Chris. Ben finds himself in a bidding war against Ann to win a present for Leslie.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E20 - Jerry's Retirement
5.plot: When Leslie finds out Jerry is retiring, she struggles with the proper way to commemorate the occasion. Chris and Ann prepare to have a baby together. Tom worries he will become the office punching bag once Jerry leaves.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E21 - Swing Vote
5.plot: Leslie deems Ron's budget-cut proposals unacceptable. Andy and Ben celebrate a big donation made to their charity. Ann tries to solve Tom's girlfriend troubles.

5.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S05E22 - Are You Better Off?
5.plot: Leslie celebrates her first year as a city councilwoman. Retired Special Agent Burt Macklin is recalled to action. April gets some life-changing news. Tom debates a big business opportunity.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E01 - London
6.plot: Leslie wins an award from an international Women in Government organization, and travels to London with Ben, Andy, April and Ron to accept it.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E02 - The Pawnee-Eagleton Tip-Off Classic
6.plot: Ben, Leslie and Chris meet with Eagleton city councilor Ingrid de Forest to discuss financial matters; Ann brings April to vet school orientation; Ron tries to get off the grid.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E03 - Doppelgängers
6.plot: Leslie pairs up the Pawnee Parks employees with their Eagleton counterparts. Meanwhile Ben and Chris reunite for an accounting project, and Ann reveals her plans for the future.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E04 - Gin It Up!
6.plot: Leslie tries to calm a minor scandal that gets blown out of proportion. Tom tries to impress a new love interest, while Ben convinces Ron to prepare a will.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E05 - Filibuster
6.plot: Leslie throws Ben a birthday bash but is forced to leave early for an emergency late-night filibuster. Tom tries to make some memories with his new girlfriend, Ron and Donna go hunting. April reconnects with Andy.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E06 - Recall Vote
6.plot: Leslie prepares a haunted house with Ben, Ann and Chris for Halloween on the day of the recall vote. Meanwhile, Tom fears the end of Rent-A-Swag and persuades Ron to help save his business.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E07 - Fluoride
6.plot: Leslie tries to complete some of her biggest city council goals, like hosting an NFL Play 60 event with the Indianapolis Colts, and trying to add fluoride to Pawnee’s drinking water. Meanwhile, Chris and Ron attempt to bond while building cribs for their future children.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E08 - The Cones of Dunshire
6.plot: Leslie faces off with Councilman Jamm; Ben gets a new hobby; Tom, April and Donna help Ron sell his cabin.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E09 - Second Chunce
6.plot: Leslie comes to terms with her last day in office and plans for the future with Ben. Chris and Ann find out the sex of their child, Andy comes home from London, and Tom looks to the future.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E10 - New Beginnings
6.plot: Leslie and Ben both face new challenges on the first day of new jobs. Donna, April and Andy play a prank on Ben, while Tom prepares for a big presentation. Meanwhile Ann and Chris contemplate taking a big leap together.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E11 - Farmers Market
6.plot: Leslie fights with Ben over questionable sales techniques at the local farmers market. Ann searches for a way to vent about the annoying aspects of pregnancy, while April supports Andy in a new creative venture.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E12 - Ann and Chris
6.plot: On Ann and Chris's last night in Pawnee, Leslie throws a grand farewell party and attempts to fulfill one last promise. Meanwhile, Tom, Ben, Ron and Andy struggle to find the perfect going away gift for Chris.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E13 - Anniversaries
6.plot: Ben attempts to surprise Leslie with a special anniversary gift. Tom and Adam try to help Leslie bring positive light to the Pawnee-Eagleton merger, while April asserts her new authority as Donna’s boss.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E14 - The Wall
6.plot: Leslie's efforts to take down the wall separating Eagleton and Pawnee yield unexpected results; Ben and Tom meet with possible sponsors for the concert; Ron finds a new hobby.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E15 - New Slogan
6.plot: Leslie aims to create a new town slogan, but runs afoul of local shock jocks. Andy scouts bands to play the Unity Concert and discovers an interesting secret about Ron, while Tom looks for a restaurant locale with Donna and April.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E16 - Galentine's Day
6.plot: Leslie throws a hasty Galentine’s Day in an attempt to find a replacement for Ann. Tom and Ben look to finalize a deal on tents for the Unity Concert, while Ron finds himself looking after Andy.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E17 - Prom
6.plot: Leslie helps organize the high school's Senior Prom, and battles with Ron over the future employment of a bright high school senior. Andy takes an unwilling April as his date, and Tom is tasked with DJ'ing and agrees to let Ben help.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E18 - Flu Season 2
6.plot: In the midst of flu season, a sick Leslie and Andy struggle to book performers for the Unity Concert. Meanwhile, Tom heads to a wine competition in search of a sommelier for his new restaurant, and Ben seeks drunken help from Ron with a personal problem.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E19 - One in 8,000
6.plot: Leslie and Ben run a charity auction to raise funds for the unity concert. April steps in to manage Andy's schedule, while Donna asks Ron for help with her ex-boyfriend.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E20 - Moving Up
6.plot: Leslie, Ben, and Andy head to San Francisco for a National Parks Conference. Tom opens his restaurant, Ron has another run-in with his ex-wife Tammy 2, Andy lives a rock and roll fantasy, and Leslie makes a huge decision about her future.

6.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E21 -
FR - Parks and Recreation - S06E22 -

7.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S07E01 - 2017
7.plot: Leslie launches a competition with tech company Gryzzl for a large parcel of land, which she wants to turn into a National Park. April and Andy try to regain their spontaneity. Ben is recognized at a Bicentennial gala, where Tom delivers a speech in his honor.

7.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S07E02 - Ron and Jammy
7.plot: Leslie and Ron briefly put aside their feud to help old foe Jeremy Jamm escape the clutches of the diabolical Tammy 2. Ben vows to help April discover her true passion in life, while Andy and Tom travel to Chicago.

7.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S07E03 - William Henry Harrison
7.plot: Leslie's team tries to strengthen her case that the Newport land should be turned into a National Park. Ron's team, fighting back, brings on a celebrity as a minority owner.

7.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S07E04 - Leslie and Ron
7.plot: Leslie and Ron attempt to work out their differences.

7.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S07E05 - Gryzzlbox
7.plot: Leslie and Ben suspect that Gryzzl is invading the privacy of Pawnee residents. April addresses the new Parks and Rec interns, while Tom helps Andy renegotiate a contract.

7.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S07E06 - Save JJ's
7.plot: Leslie holds a rally in an attempt to keep JJ's Diner from closing. Tom surprises Donna with the ultimate pre-wedding gift.

7.title: FR - Parks and Recreation - S07E07 - Donna and Joe

meta.plot: Au sein du Liars Club, 5 duos mythiques vont s’affronter dans un jeu dans lequel ils devront raconter des histoires folles qui leur sont arrivées… ou pas. Leur but : convaincre les autres qu’ils disent la vérité. Mais à chaque manche, seul l’un des binômes sera sincère, tandis que les autres navigueront en plein mensonge ! Les duos devront donc mettre leur talent de comédien à profit et faire preuve de mauvaise foi persuasion pour tenter de convaincre, mais aussi de malice pour retrouver qui dit vrai. Car à la fin, seul le duo qui aura trouvé la bonne combinaison d’histoires vraies remportera le jeu. Sauront-ils percer le mystère et dénicher les récits véritables parmi ce labyrinthe de fables ?

Follow Moiraine, a member of the shadowy and influential all-female organization called the “Aes Sedai” as she embarks on a dangerous, world-spanning journey with five young men and women. Moiraine believes one of them might be the reincarnation of an incredibly powerful individual, whom prophecies say will either save humanity or destroy it.

meta.plot: Une série de bombes sophistiquées sèment la terreur en ville. Un nouvel artificier est à l'œuvre : celui qu'on surnomme « Matriochka ». Véronique Valiquette, sergente et technicienne en explosifs de la police nationale, est d'abord confrontée professionnellement au travail de Matriochka, puis personnellement, lorsqu'une explosion la blesse grièvement et tue l'un de ses proches. Cette battante, blessée dans son être et dans son corps, doit reprendre confiance en elle, en ses moyens, en son jugement, en son instinct, en son savoir et en ses mains reconstruites, qui n'ont plus la dextérité de jadis.

"#1 HAPPY FAMILY USA", de Ramy Youssef, est une série animée pour adultes qui suit les Hussein, la famille musulmane la plus optimiste, patriotique, pacifique et moins suspecte de "l'Amreeka" post-11 septembre. Cette série aborde la période difficile du début des années 2000 avec satire et dérision, en présentant une famille qui vit sous l'œil atttentif de ses voisins terrifiés.

1.title: FR - #1 HAPPY FAMILY USA - S01E01 - NINE TEN
1.plot: Hello, I am Hussein, and this is my family, the Husseins! This is a very big day for us. We have experienced a loss… but I negotiated a very cheap burial price! Go me. Tomorrow is already looking better!

1.title: FR - #1 HAPPY FAMILY USA - S01E02 - #1 VIGIL MOURNERS!

1.title: FR - #1 HAPPY FAMILY USA - S01E03 - WE ARE NOTHING!

1.title: FR - #1 HAPPY FAMILY USA - S01E05 - VERY GOOD HATE CRIME!
1.plot: Hateful, but helpful. The best hate crime I have ever seen. I love this country.

1.title: FR - #1 HAPPY FAMILY USA - S01E06 - DAUGHTER PRESIDENT!
1.plot: The school election is just as important as the presidential election and only one of them is rigged. Soon my daughter will run the world! While my son wastes away. Inshallah.

1.title: FR - #1 HAPPY FAMILY USA - S01E07 - INSHALLAH PUBES!
1.plot: Rumi, once they grow down there, they leave your head. I’m sorry son. It’s time for you to grow up. You will be a bald man by high school.

1.title: FR - #1 HAPPY FAMILY USA - S01E08 - A SLEEPOVER WITH MR. PRESIDENT!
1.plot: We love you Mr. Bush. Feel free to stay at our house, and torture our family. We cannot wait to visit this Guantanamo Bay! It sounds beautiful.

1.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Secrets
1.plot: With the rest of the crew off visiting a genetics lab, Kenji sneaks Darius into the park's top-secret underbelly — and straight into danger.

1.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Cattle Drive
1.plot: The campers hop into their Gyrospheres to help move a dinosaur herd toward fresh grazing lands. But an incoming storm stirs up unexpected trouble.

1.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Things Fall Apart
1.plot: Darius remembers the promise he made to his dad. Elsewhere on the island, the campers find themselves face-to-face with a newly freed threat.

1.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Happy Birthday, Eddie!
1.plot: After a close encounter with the Indominus, the gang seeks shelter in the genetics lab, where a strange scientist reveals the truth about Dr. Wu.

1.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Welcome to Jurassic World
1.plot: Sammy's secret shocks everyone — but there's no time for anger when an accident unleashes a flock of Pteranodons and forces the crew below ground.

1.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Last Day of Camp
1.plot: The campers leave the Mosasaurus lagoon and fight their way onto the monorail … where Ben gets a chance to face his fears.

1.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - End of the Line
1.plot: It's a race against time as the campers make their way to the main dock to catch the last ferry leaving the island. But what if they're too late?

2.plot: Still stranded on the island — and still reeling from the apparent loss of Ben — the campers make a last-ditch attempt at rescue by sending out an SOS.

2.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - The Art of Chill
2.plot: Darius and Sammy face a moral dilemma while searching the park for supplies. The campers start building a new treehouse. Brooklynn sees something odd.

2.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - The Watering Hole
2.plot: Brooklynn, Sammy and Yasmina team up to investigate strange noises in the park. Elsewhere, Darius and Kenji go exploring and witness a majestic sight.

2.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Salvation
2.plot: A bonfire in the distance signals that the campers have company: a pair of posh eco-tourists and their disgruntled security guy. But can they be trusted?

2.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Brave
2.plot: The campers reunite with a long-lost friend, who shares an inspiring story — then reveals that Mitch, Tiff and Hap aren't who they seem.

2.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Misguided
2.plot: Darius must make a difficult choice to save Sammy and Yasmina. Meanwhile, the remaining campers are trying to decide if Hap is a friend... or a foe.

2.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Step One
2.plot: Brooklynn, Ben, Kenji and Yasmina work to uncover a secret and restore power to the park as Darius leads Mitch and Tiff straight into a T. rex trap.

2.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Chaos Theory
2.plot: A guilty Darius is determined to protect the island's innocent dinos — even if he has to do it all alone. But with luck, maybe he won't have to...

3.plot: The campers catch a lift to Lookout Point in search of materials to make a sail, then must quickly find a way back down. Ben worries about leaving Bumpy.

3.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Safe Harbor
3.plot: After finding Mitch and Tiff's abandoned yacht, the happy campers celebrate. But the party's over when something big goes bump in the night.

3.plot: Kenji takes the campers to his father's penthouse to gather supplies — but they've soon got company. Sammy reflects on what life must be like back home.

3.plot: A thrilling chase brings Darius, Kenji and Yaz to the old Jurassic Park Visitors Center. Elsewhere on the island, Brooklynn and Sammy find a secret lab.

3.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Eye of the Storm
3.plot: Sammy and Brooklynn rush to warn the others about a sinister new threat while Darius, unaware of the danger, searches for his dad's favorite dinosaur.

3.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - The Long Run
3.plot: As a poisoned camper fights to survive, it's up to Yaz — the fastest among them — to fetch the antidote before it's too late.

3.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - A Shock to the System
3.plot: It's crunch time for the campers to get to the boat and make their escape... until Ben disappears, deciding he'd rather stay. Can Darius change his mind?

3.plot: With multiple threats running rampant on the island, dinosaur lover Darius must put his feelings aside and make a difficult decision.

3.plot: The group is forced to switch gears when a familiar face returns to Isla Nublar. Now, getting off the island is no longer the most important thing.

3.plot: With Brooklynn being held prisoner, the remaining campers hatch a plan to rescue her — and it won't be easy.

4.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S04E02 - At Least...
4.plot: The weary crew dodges danger in the desert while trying to figure out where they are. But they unearth more questions than answers.

4.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S04E03 - Turning Dr. Turner
4.plot: A strange tunnel takes the teens to a lush forest, where they meet a mysterious scientist studying dino behavior. The question is: Can they trust her?

4.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S04E04 - Rude Awakening
4.plot: With Dr. Turner's help, the campers hatch a plan to get off the island that finds them crossing a snowy arctic biome — and making a selfless rescue.

4.plot: Darius has to think fast to distract Kash and protect the others, so he pretends to hate dinos as much as Kash does — while learning everything he can.

4.plot: Brooklynn must devise a hack to help Darius, who's being tailed by an upgraded BRAD-X. Meanwhile, Kash prepares to woo a group of dangerous investors.

4.plot: Ben's refusal to bond with a new friend leads to regret — and a realization that it's time to take Kash down. Kenji and Brooklynn face their feelings.

5.plot: Kenji's thrilled to see his father - and eager to prove himself. Elsewhere, Sammy and Brooklynn team up to find out what happened to Sammy's family.

5.plot: A stunning betrayal lands the friends in lockdown, where they unpack their feelings and plot their escape. Kenji follows his father to Isla Nublar.

5.plot: Something unsettling is sending the dinos into a frenzy. Darius and Brooklynn pour their energies into problem-solving. Kenji chooses sides.

5.plot: Kenji accepts an important assignment - and drives straight into danger. Back on Mantah Corp. Island, the others race to ruin Mr, Kon's plans.

5.plot: The Kids come up with a plan to protect the dinosaurs. Left on her own, Sammy will have to rely on her own strength. Yaz opens up to Ben.

5.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S05E08 - Clean Break
5.plot: An Increasingly suspicious Kenji starts looking into his father's activities. Mae works to break free from Kon's control and follow her heart.

5.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S05E09 - The Core
5.plot: Yaz is ready to tell Sammy the truth - but the island has other plans. A conflicted Darius worries that he's lost his way.

5.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S05E10 - Arrival
5.plot: The friends must think fast to outwit Mr. Kon and his cronies. Ben sets out to rescue an old friend - and gets help from a surprising source.

5.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S05E11 - The Last Stand
5.plot: A high-stakes battle begins for control of Mantah Corp. Island. Kenji's ready to rejoin his friends, but Darius isn't sure he can forgive him.

5.title: EN - Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous [MULTI-SUB] - S05E12 - The Nublar Six
5.plot: With the future of the Island at steak, the friends band together - and fight harder than ever before - to protect what's really important.

Tommo and Erin need his help and try to lure him out of hiding with a new business proposition and together with the lads they plot to rob a travelling circus. With the help of a disgruntled clown, Mr Popov, the gang aim to make this theft a 'roaring' success.

2.plot: Vinnie is tasked with collecting a guy called Tony Tillerton. It seems like a simple task... Meanwhile, a booze cruise to France is under way.

2.plot: Vinnie agrees to grow weed on an industrial scale for McCann and the lads get busy setting up a new grow shed. Meanwhile, Erin attends a disastrous dinner party with Jake's family and Tommo hatches a plan to steal some erotic furniture to re-vamp the Rat & Cutter. But what starts as a simple robbery quickly descends into bedlam when a rival gang of thieves turn up and the lads find themselves joining an elaborate treasure hunt.

2.title: FR - Brassic - S02E04 - The Intruder
2.plot: Suffering from insomnia, Vinnie decides to have a chilled night in at the local pub, but things take a sinister turn when a stranger breaks in.

2.title: FR - Brassic - S02E05 - The Festival
2.plot: Ordered by McCann to sell all the weed they have grown, the lads decide to throw a music festival in Jim's field.

2.title: FR - Brassic - S02E06 - Stealing a Wedding
2.plot: When a close friend gets engaged, Vinnie is determined to throw them the best wedding he can muster, and so decides to steal one.

3.title: FR - Brassic - S03E01 - The Great Bull Semen Heist
3.plot: Vinnie finally gets released from prison and with the newly promoted Detective Carl Slater watching his every move, he is doing his best to lie low.

3.title: FR - Brassic - S03E02 - Gideon's Mum Funeral
3.plot: Vinnie's friend Gideon calls to say his mother has passed away and asks Vin to help him honour her final wishes.

3.title: FR - Brassic - S03E03 - The Ransom
3.plot: Ashley's cousin Doolan has been kidnapped and his uncle Francis calls on Vinnie to be the bag drop man in his ransom.

3.title: FR - Brassic - S03E04 - Classic Cars
3.plot: Mr and Mrs Bishop are back and the gang are once again caught up in their bitter divorce battle.

3.title: FR - Brassic - S03E05 - Parenthood
3.plot: When Ashley decides that he wants to track down his real father, Vinnie and the gang promise to do everything they can to help find him.

6.plot: Farmer Jim is forced on a trip down memory lane when an old flame pops up in Hawley. Also - JJ is back!

6.title: FR - Brassic - S06E04 - Naked Cult
6.plot: Tommo meets Craig, a once-famous dance arcade champion, as the gang try to rescue Gideon from a naked cult.

6.title: FR - Brassic - S06E05 - Heartbreak
6.plot: Cardi's mum shows up in Hawley - she is getting married.... again. Meanwhile, Carol gets a nasty shock of her own.

6.title: FR - Brassic - S06E06 - The Mark
6.plot: After being humiliated by some local youths, Ashley decides it's time to up his game - with the help of Jim and Cardi.

6.title: FR - Brassic - S06E07 - Two Funerals and a Wedding
6.plot: JJ and Sugar's joyous celebrations turn into a morbid affair after the gang learns of some sad news.

1.title: FR - Million Dollar Secret - S01E01 - Instant Millionaire
1.plot: Upon arriving at The Stag, the secret millionaire is crowned. Mistrust runs rampant as the other players investigate with few clues at their disposal.

1.title: FR - Million Dollar Secret - S01E02 - The Five Suspects
1.plot: A risky strategy sparks early suspicion from prying eyes. Morals are tested when the millionaire realizes their survival comes at a hefty cost.

1.title: FR - Million Dollar Secret - S01E03 - Going to Hell on a Scholarship
1.plot: One player drops a bombshell in an effort to win trust, but will it backfire? Alliances form as the group hunts for the millionaire with renewed zeal.

meta.plot: Dans cette compétition acharnée, un millionnaire sous couverture doit tout faire pour garder son secret et éviter l'élimination s'il veut remporter le jeu et l'argent.
This immersive documentary series goes inside the dugout and gets up close and personal with the 2024 Boston Red Sox during their roller-coaster season.

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - 162
1.plot: After finishing last in their division in 2023, a young Red Sox team contends with its passionate fanbase and high expectations before Opening Day 2024.

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Where Everybody Knows Your Name
1.plot: A major injury slows the team's roll, drawing scrutiny from diehard, outspoken Fenway fans. Alex Cora opens up about the pressure of playing in Boston.

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Gerente
1.plot: Despite injuries and roster shakeups, the Sox find their flow in comeback kid Cam Booser. Later, they face their longtime rivals: the New York Yankees.

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Still Alive
1.plot: As other Boston teams cement their legacies, the Sox vie for a win against the Toronto Blue Jays. Jarren Duran reflects on his mental health journey.

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Boston, You're My Home
1.plot: Emotions run high as the Sox try to clinch a wild card spot. For international players like Brayan Bello, competing far from home proves a challenge.

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Buyers or Sellers
1.plot: Rumors fly as the MLB trade deadline looms. With his eyes on the playoffs, Craig Breslow weighs a difficult decision: Should the Sox buy or sell?

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Dog Days
1.plot: In the dog days of summer, pressure to perform mounts. Can the Sox turn their season around? A heckler gets under one player's skin, sparking a scandal.

1.title: EN - The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Designed to Break Your Heart
1.plot: Radio legend Joe Castiglione recalls his 42-year tenure of calling games for the Sox. After a dramatic push for the playoffs, Fenway looks to the future.

1.title: FR - Les Coqs - S01E01 - A New Era, A New Man
1.plot: Mike misses out on a promotion. Ivo's daughter moves in with him. Greg tries to spice up his sex life. Daan's girlfriend wants an open relationship.

1.title: FR - Les Coqs - S01E02 - Happily Ever After
1.plot: Tess sends her father on an exciting date. Merel catches someone's eye at the gym. Mike and Greg have trouble adjusting to their new circumstances.

1.title: FR - Les Coqs - S01E03 - First Dates
1.plot: Ivo and Greg suspect Pam of infidelity. Mike embarrasses Stevie at an influencer event. Merel comes to a decision about her marriage.

1.title: FR - Les Coqs - S01E04 - Back to School
1.plot: The guys start attending a seminar about modern masculinity. After changing his mind about an open relationship, Daan makes a bold suggestion.

1.title: FR - Les Coqs - S01E05 - We Need to Talk
1.plot: Ivo tries to be more adventurous. Daan and Stevie head out on a wild chase. Fed up with the seminar, Mike decides to start his own.

1.title: FR - Les Coqs - S01E06 - Return of the Rooster
1.plot: While Mike and Daan face the consequences of their actions, Ivo and Greg fall back into their old lives — though not without some adjustments.

meta.plot: En pleine crise de la masculinité, quatre amis luttent pour préserver leurs vies personnelles et professionnelles dans un monde en constante évolution.

1.title: FR - Le pas très Grand Tour - S01E01 - The Glory and the Power
1.plot: Richard and James celebrate the glories of the internal combustion engine with some classic moments from The Grand Tour including the hypercar holy trinity, muscle cars in Detroit, a city sprint in a Bugatti, the world’s craziest tank, and a race between the past, present and future. Plus, Jeremy’s house explodes. That’s not a clip about engines, Richard and James just wanted to see it again.

meta.plot: Richard et James reviennent sur de grands moments de The Grand Tour, célébrant les gloires du moteur à combustion interne, notamment la sainte trinité des hypercars, les muscle cars de Detroit, un sprint urbain dans une Bugatti, le char d'assaut le plus fou du monde et une course entre le passé, le présent et le futur.
First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

1.title: EN - Resident Playbook [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Struggling with her finances, Oh Yi-young reluctantly returns to resident life — making blunder after blunder. Soon, she faces her first patient crisis.

1.title: EN - Resident Playbook [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The first-year residents contemplate quitting after burning out from hospital life. When Yi-young is backed into a corner, Ku Do-won comes to her aid.

1.title: EN - Resident Playbook [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Episode 3

meta.plot: Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Ladies Hostel
1.plot: Madhu arrives in Delhi and moves into a hostel but is warned that there is something wrong with her room – she should leave before it is too late.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Stalker
1.plot: The Warden brings a shaman known as ‘Doctor,’ to check the room, while Madhu is led by her instinct to hunt for her assaulter.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Venom
1.plot: Madhu decides to confront Nakul and face her fears, while the women in the hostel make a pact with the Doctor.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Fever
1.plot: As the Doctor becomes increasingly desperate for her, a transformed Madhu feels her rage spill out in dangerous ways.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Possessed
1.plot: Dr Shohini begins an inquiry into the events at the hostel, while Madhu unleashes a night of blood and vengeance.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Trap
1.plot: Nikki tries to leave the hostel in a desperate attempt, while Madhu is entrapped by the Doctor.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Happy New Year
1.plot: Confronted by the Warden, the women come clean about what happened in the hostel during last year’s New Year’s Eve celebration.

1.title: EN - Khauf [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - The Reverie
1.plot: While the Doctor hunts for her, a possessed Madhu reaches the hostel for a faceoff with the women, battling both the entity inside her and the trauma of her past.

meta.plot: Le comédien Jonathan Cohen campe le personnage de Serge, un beau parleur qui passe le plus clair de son temps à raconter des histoires.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E01 - The Big Bang
1.plot: Cheyenne is forced to help Lola cover up the killing of her boyfriend’s wife. They turn to crime boss Yannick, but his help comes with a high price.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E02 - Jacob's Ladder
1.plot: In debt to Yannick, Cheyenne forces Lola to steal jewelry, and Yannick has Cheyenne smuggle a mysterious package onto a ferry to aid illegal migrants.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E03 - The Jackals
1.plot: When Yannick has Cheyenne’s sister beaten, Lola and Cheyenne decide to go into business for themselves, smuggling people across the English Channel.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E04 - Eldorado
1.plot: To save migrant women from forced prostitution, Cheyenne creates a story to have Yannick intervene. And Lola’s boyfriend is suspicious about his wife’s death.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E05 - Till Death Do Us Part
1.plot: Cheyenne’s husband escapes from prison and wants revenge for her having cheated on him. But Cheyenne tells Yannick that her husband is a rival crime boss.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E06 - Dancing Queen
1.plot: Cheyenne uses her husband’s dirty money to buy a business, but Audrey betrays her to Yannick. And when Cheyenne finds Dany’s body, she severs ties with Lola.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E07 - Romance
1.plot: Lola and Yannick are in love, but she still tries to protect Cheyenne. Yannick attacks Cheyenne’s smuggling operation, and Yannick’s wife wants Lola killed.

1.title: FR - Cheyenne et Lola - S01E08 - The Harder the Fall
1.plot: To help Cheyenne, Lola turns Yannick and Babette, against each other. And when Babette betrays Yannick to the police, Cheyenne and Lola think they are free.

meta.plot: Sortie de prison il y a trois mois, Cheyenne fait des ménages sur les ferries en rêvant de partir en Amazonie. Lola est une ravissante parisienne, égoïste et sans scrupules, qui vient de débarquer dans le Nord pour s’installer avec son amant. Quand Lola tue l’épouse de son amant, Cheyenne, témoin involontaire, sait qu’elle va être accusée du meurtre à cause de son casier. Elle est obligée de demander au caïd de la région de faire disparaître le corps. Une faveur qui va les entrainer dans un très dangereux jeu de dupes tout en leur permettant de faire fortune à l’insu de tous…

Tokyo brûle, et dans toute la ville, des citoyens sont victimes de combustion spontanée. La Fire Force, brigade en charge d’éteindre ce brasier compte une nouvelle recrue dans ses rangs, le jeune Shinra. Au sein de la 8e brigade, il fera bon usage de ses pieds de feu pour empêcher la ville d’être réduite en cendres. Mais un secret brûlant et un passé ardent pourraient bien venir mettre le feu aux poudres !

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E01 - Shinra Kusakabe Enlists
1.plot: On his first day with Special Fire Force Company 8, Shinra Kusakabe, a third-generation pyrokinetic who is able to produces flames from his feet, meets his fellow company members and begins to fulfil his wish of becoming a hero.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E02 - The Heart of a Fire Soldier
1.plot: Arthur Boyle, the self-professed “Knight King,” arrives at Company 8, and immediately, there are tensions between him and Shinra. With the Rookie Games coming up, Hinawa wants to see what the two new recruits are really capable of.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E03 - The Rookie Fire Soldier Games
1.plot: Shinra and Arthur compete in the Rookie Fire Soldier Games, a contest to test the abilities of each year’s newest recruits. However, they are interrupted at the goal by the mysterious man who created explosions at their last fire scene.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E04 - The Hero and the Princess
1.plot: A call mistakenly comes in to Company 8 to rescue a dog out of a tree, to which Shinra and Arthur respond. However, when an Infernal suddenly appears at the district courthouse, the two must play catch-up to join the rest of the company.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E05 - The Battle Begins
1.plot: While jogging, Shinra inadvertently disturbs Iris’s purification rite, and sees that she is troubled. When Iris later turns up missing, the other members of Company 8 rally to Company 5’s compound, to which Iris had secretly slipped away.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E06 - The Spark of Promise
1.plot: Shinra confronts Hibana in an attempt to rescue Iris, and must once again deal with her ability to make his body shut down. The story of Hibana and Iris’ youth as orphans, as well as Hibana’s rise to prominence, is revealed.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E07 - The Investigation of the 1st Commences
1.plot: The members of Company 5 and 8 get together for a cookout, ostensibly to celebrate a successful nighttime training exercise. Using the bylaws of the Special Fire Force, Obi gets Shinra and Arthur temporarily assigned to the 1st to investigate it.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E08 - Infernal Insects
1.plot: Obi goes over Hibana’s research, and learns that the artificially-created Infernals she dissected all had traces of insect DNA in them. Shinra and Arthur’s investigation at the 1st continues, and they finally get their first lead on a culprit.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E09 - The Spreading Malice
1.plot: Tamaki watches on as Shinra confronts Rekka over his actions, and reminisces about how she once looked up to the lieutenant. Rekka reveals his objective in seeking out compatible children, one which could spell disaster for the entire world.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E10 - The Promise
1.plot: A captains’ conference is convened to allow the Special Fire Force to discuss the situation with the Evangelist and the White-Clad. Shinra once again has an encounter with Joker, in which startling information about Shinra’s brother is revealed.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E11 - Formation of Special Fire Force Company 8 / The Mightiest Hikeshi
1.plot: While Company 8 searches for clues about the Evangelist, Hinawa recounts the tale of how the company originally came into existence. A lead prompts the crew to pay a visit to Company 7’s jurisdiction in Asakusa, and its captain, Benimaru.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E12 - Eve of Hostilities in Asakusa
1.plot: Company 8 pitches in to help rebuild Asakusa after the latest Infernal incident, helping to gain the trust of its people. However, a White-Clad plot threatens to undo all of their goodwill, prompting Obi to take matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E13 - The Trap Is Set
1.plot: With Konro’s help, the members of the 8th begin investigating events in the 7th’s jurisdiction. Chaos breaks out one dozens of cases of mistaken identity crop up, and the town’s people turn on each other. The 8th comes under White-Clad attack.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E14 - For Whom the Flames Burn
1.plot: As Asakusa burns around them, Konro encourages Benimaru to step into his role as a community leader. Benimaru devises a way for the townspeople to foil the designs of the impostors among the crowd. Konro reaches out to Shinra for help.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E15 - The Blacksmith’s Dream
1.plot: Viktor Licht is assigned to Company 8 as its forensic scientist, but he is viewed with suspicion, since the assignment came from Haijima. Obi sends Shinra, Arthur and Iris to speak to a man named Vulcan about joining the 8th as its engineer.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E16 - We Are Family
1.plot: Vulcan teaches Yu a lesson in the importance of forging things that cannot be broken, and his hope to create similarly unbreakable family ties. Sensing a threat to Vulcan, the members of Company 8 take up positions to keep him safe.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E17 - Black and White and Gray
1.plot: While Dr. Giovanni continues to search Vulcan’s workshop, Hibana comes to Shinra’s aid, allowing him to rush back to help Vulcan. Meanwhile, Arthur has his hands full trying to deal with Mirage’s illusions, and Iris resists in her own way.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E18 - The Secrets of Pyrokinesis
1.plot: Vulcan gets settled in at the 8th, while Captain Obi meets with Hibana, Konro, and Karim to exchange data on the White-Clad matter. Konro proposes that Shinra and Arthur be given combat training in Asakusa to improve their fighting skills.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E19 - Into the Nether
1.plot: Licht’s analysis of the attack on Vulcan’s workshop reveals that the Evangelist’s men have been in the “Nether,” the area beneath Tokyo. Company 8 proceeds underground in search of the White-Clad and the secrets behind human combustion.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E20 - Wearing His Pride
1.plot: Hinawa comes upon an abandoned subway station, where he gets into a shootout with Arrow. Arthur and Mirage find themselves in a rematch, as Arthur gets the chance to put the training he received from Benimaru and Konro to the test.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E21 - Those Connected
1.plot: Obi and Vulcan face off against Dr. Giovanni and Lisa, during which Giovanni tells Obi more about the nature of Adolla Bursts. Shinra has an unusual experience that leads him to find Sho, but their reunion proves more volatile than hoped for.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E22 - A Brother’s Determination
1.plot: As Shinra and Sho continue to share their Adolla Link, Shinra learns a startling truth about the origin of his Adolla Burst flame. Shinra comes to understand the Link’s nature further, developing his skills even more in his effort to reach Sho.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E23 - Smile
1.plot: Shinra revisits his childhood to share his memories with Sho, to try to forge a deeper connection. When one of their own is critically injured, the members of the 8th rally to the rescue, and turn to Captain Huang of the 6th for assistance.

1.title: FR - Fire Force - S01E24 - The Burning Past
1.plot: Before being discharged from the hospital, Shinra is visited by Captain Burns, who offers to tell him all about the fire that happened 12 years ago, but only if Shinra can demonstrate that he is strong enough to hear the whole truth.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E01 - A Fire Soldier’s Fight
2.plot: Company 8’s junior crewmen take in a day of shopping for some new clothes for Lieutenant Hinawa, but their excursion is interrupted by the appearance of a giant Infernal. The 8th prepares for the annual Special Fire Force beefcake calendar shoot.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E02 - Flames of Madness
2.plot: Shinra is approved to have a meeting with Company 4 Captain Hague, who may be able to provide information on the Evangelist and Adolla Bursts. However, once the meeting starts, nearly everyone involved begins behaving erratically.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E03 - A New Flashpoint
2.plot: Obi goes to see the chief with news of a fifth Adolla-Burst bearer. Schoolgirl Inca, who has the ability to sniff out fires before they start, becomes notorious as the Fireground Thief, extorting valuables from victims in exchange for rescuing them.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E04 - Groping Through the Fire
2.plot: A widespread outbreak of fires stretches the members of Company 8 thin. Shinra tries to keep Charon and his men from taking Inca. With a shortage of ecclesiastical assistance, the crew members cannot put the Infernals to rest fast enough.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E05 - Corna (Sign of the Devil) / A Secret Plan
2.plot: Shinra makes an important discovery about how to fight Charon, but incorporating a new hand form into his fighting style proves difficult. The other Fire Soldiers put into action a novel approach toward putting to rest a demon Infernal.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E06 - The Time to Choose
2.plot: Inca is faced with the decision of whether to go with Shinra and the Fire Force, or to go with Charon and side with the Evangelist. Fed up with always being a step behind the Evangelist’s men, the 8th launches a research expedition to find answers.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E07 - Road to the Oasis
2.plot: The task force arrives on the Chinese Peninsula, and sets off through inhospitable territory toward a spatial rift that they hope will provide the answers they seek. They pick up an unexpected companion along the way who agrees to be their guide.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E08 - Smoldering Malevolence
2.plot: Shinra hears a voice via an Adolla Link. Scop tells the team about a mysterious woman in black robes that taught him how to speak, and who repaired the Tabernacle. The team’s mission takes a turn when intelligent Infernals show up at the Oasis.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E09 - The Core
2.plot: Pan, Arthur and Licht continue to investigate the inside of the Tabernacle, while outside, the rest of the team have their hands full fighting off an Infernal attack. Shinra has an idea as to how to beat them, but needs Ogun to buy him some time.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E10 - The Woman in Black
2.plot: Through Adolla Links and the assistance of Grace, Shinra learns more about the Evangelist and views Tempe’s memories. The team completes their investigation into the Tabernacle, but draw some unsettling conclusions from what they learn.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E11 - Dark Hero
2.plot: After reporting their findings to Obi, the team is dismayed to hear that their discoveries are being quashed by the church, prompting Licht to turn to unofficial channels. Joker approaches Benimaru with a proposition concerning the Holy Sol Temple.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E12 - Shadows Cast by Divine Light
2.plot: Joker and Benimaru break their way into the church in search of the hidden scriptures. When Benimaru presses Joker for answers as to how he knows so much, Joker tells him about his past, revealing some dark secrets about the Holy Sol Temple.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E13 - A Pair of One-Eyes
2.plot: Burns confronts Joker and Benimaru, then offers them the scant leads he has uncovered during his own personal probe of the Holy Sol Temple. Konro reports Benimaru’s findings to the 8th, and the target of their next investigation becomes clear.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E14 - The Ashen Reaper
2.plot: Licht reveals to the other members of the 8th that he has been spying on them for Haijima. Licht and Shinra come up with a plan to get inside the child pyrokinesis lab where Shinra was institutionalized as a child to uncover some dirt on Haijima.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E15 - A Three-Way Melee
2.plot: At Licht’s signal, the rest of the 8th breaks into the Haijima compound, where Vulcan and Maki confront an overpowered puppeteer. The rest of the company meets up with Shinra and Licht, who are facing Kurono, when a third party shows up!

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E16 - Mind Blown
2.plot: The three-way battle between Haijima, the White-Clad, and the 8th continues, but when Ritsu and Haumea both use their unique abilities, everyone involved is placed in imminent danger. It’s up to Vulcan and Arthur to turn things around.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E17 - Boys, Be Weak
2.plot: As Nataku continues to rampage, Shinra Adolla Links with him, revealing the pressure his parents placed on him to succeed. When the threat Nataku poses comes to a head, his protection as one of the Pillars comes from an unlikely source.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E18 - The Holy Woman’s Anguish / The Man, Assault
2.plot: A routine trip to the Baptism Church to bless the 8th’s equipment reveals the crisis of faith that Iris and other Holy Sol Temple clergy are facing. Assault is back and ready to take on Tamaki, who stands in his way of exterminating the 8th.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E19 - The Oze Family
2.plot: Maki returns home for a family dinner, where her brother, Takigi, a criminal investigator with the Armed Forces, asks her about her time in the Nether. When Takigi is injured in a White-Clad attack, Maki’s father recalls her to the military.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E20 - Weapons of Destruction
2.plot: Company 2 and Company 8 launch a joint, multi-pronged investigation into the Nether, and are met with resistance by the White-Clad. The squad containing Tamaki and Juggernaut faces a particularly deadly new foe named Orochi.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E21 - Enemy Contact
2.plot: Tamaki struggles to get Juggernaut back to the surface. Takigi and Hinawa find themselves at odds with each other, as well as with a new threat from the White-Clad. Shinra suddenly comes face to face against an old adversary.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E22 - Plot for Extinction
2.plot: Shinra and Arthur continue their battle against Dr. Giovanni, who reveals some new information about Adolla Links. Licht discovers an imminent crisis threatening the Fire Soldiers in the Nether, as well as the Tokyo Empire at large.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E23 - Firecat
2.plot: Shinra wants to know why he was able to Link with Konro, while Hibana remains suspicious of him. Benimaru invites Shinra and Arthur back to the 7th for more training, and Tamaki, tired of being a burden to others, comes along as well.

2.title: FR - Fire Force - S02E24 - Signs of Upheaval
2.plot: Benimaru continues to push Shinra and Arthur to their limits in order to unlock their Hysterical Strength. Captain Huang examines Konro at Hibana’s request, as she tries to uncover the mysteries of those who have been touched by Adolla.

meta.plot: Après avoir traversé les vicissitudes de la vie, un couple d'amoureux séparé par la mort se retrouve au paradis. Petit problème : il est trentenaire et elle a 80 ans.

1.title: FR - Mon amour au paradis [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1

meta.plot: Au cœur d’une station balnéaire, Stéphanie, Camille et Isabelle, victimes d’un violeur en série, décident d’unir leurs forces pour le retrouver et l’arrêter. Agressées chez elles, en pleine nuit, elles racontent le même mode opératoire, la même stupeur, mais ne sont pas toutes crues. Question de vie ou de mort, elles doivent parler, de plus en plus fort, pour être entendues. Avec l’aide d’autres femmes agressées et d’un duo d’enquêteurs, ces héroïnes du quotidien luttent pour se reconstruire alors que chaque soir les plonge dans l’angoisse du lendemain et l’annonce d’une nouvelle victime.
