meta.plot: De jeunes célibataires passent dix jours dans un pays étranger où ils s'en remettent au destin pour trouver l'amour. Sauront-ils trouver l'âme sœur sans appareil numérique ?

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Day 1, 11 a.m. — Give Up Your Digital Devices
1.plot: Ten hopeful singles arrive at the seaside city of Nice, looking for love. But first, they must give up their smartphones and find each other organically.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Day 2, 7:15 p.m. — Bye-bye, Till We Meet Again
1.plot: Nanami receives and writes her first letter. Maho has an unforgettable encounter at a church. Mimi and Sho grow close, but Aru's arrival stirs things up.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Day 3, 5:15 p.m. — Letters That Determine Fate
1.plot: While exploring the city alone, Maho encounters two participants on a date. Later, everyone receives a mysterious invitation to gather at Maison Margaux.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Day 4, 7:30 p.m. — I Don't Want to Leave
1.plot: Two groups head out on their day trips, testing their chemistry as they venture beyond Nice. Meanwhile, Tohko eagerly prepares for her very first date.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Day 5, 10:30 p.m. — Falling for the Same Girl
1.plot: As Yudai grows increasingly fond of his date, he realizes he may have unwanted competition. Meanwhile, Kanaka surprises Sho with an impromptu suggestion.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Day 6, 6:30 p.m. — Well That Changes Things
1.plot: Kanaka and Nanami go on a double date to the Alps. Aru prepares extensively for his upcoming date. Tohko musters the courage to express her feelings.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Day 7, 9 p.m. — Why Are You Crying?
1.plot: Tohko and Nanami confide in each other during an emotional breakfast. Aru's big date arrives, but he quickly realizes it's far from picture-perfect.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Day 8, 7:30 p.m. — I Liked You...
1.plot: Slowly but surely, Nanami manages to open up to her date. Atsushi whisks his crush off to Monaco. Back in Nice, Tohko receives a cryptic letter from Yudai.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Day 9, 9 p.m. — I Don't Want to Hear Your Answer Yet
1.plot: Yudai will stop at nothing to make one last confession. Later, as everyone gathers for a final dinner, tensions rise as they face the last day.

1.title: FR - Offline Love [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Day 10, 12 a.m. — To the One I Want to Meet Again
1.plot: The participants drop off their last letters. Will their crushes show up at the promised location before sunset, or will they return to Japan alone?

meta.plot: Un récent veuf et poète acclamé, l'inspecteur énigmatique Adam Dalgliesh utilise son empathie et sa perspicacité exceptionnelles pour sonder les profondeurs les plus sombres de la psyché humaine tout en enquêtant sur des crimes complexes dans l'Angleterre des années 1970.

1.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Shroud for a Nightingale (1)
1.plot: January 1975. Student nurse Heather Pearce dies during a training demonstration. Detective Chief Inspector Adam Dalgliesh is sent to investigate, accompanied by his partner DS Masterson. Pathologist Dr. Chopra confirms that Pearce was poisoned. Dalgliesh and Masterson take statements from the nurses, despite Matron’s attempts to intercede.

1.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Shroud for a Nightingale (2)
1.plot: After Fallon’s death, Dalgliesh finds a library book in Fallon’s room and a letter in Pearce’s pigeonhole about a patient of Courtney-Briggs’ called Martin Dettinger, whose recent death on the hospital ward upset her. He later discovers rose spray, which Chopra confirms was used to poison Fallon. In the woods Dalgliesh is violently attacked.

1.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - The Black Tower (1)
1.plot: March 1975. Dalgliesh is invited to Dorset by his old friend Father Michael, only to discover that he died a few days ago. Father Michael lived in a home for the disabled run by the enigmatic Wilfred, who has organised trips to Lourdes ever since he was miraculously cured there of a serious illness.

1.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The Black Tower (2)
1.plot: Wilfred announces that he will transfer the Grange to the Ridgewell Trust and hold a vote on whether he will carry on as spiritual adviser. Maggie threatens to down the ‘whole rotten place’. Despite Eric and Helen’s plot to usurp Wilfred, the majority of the Grange vote for Wilfred to stay, ensuring the Lourdes trips will continue.

1.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - A Taste for Death (1)
1.plot: May 1975. 8-year-old Darren and churchwarden Miss Wharton find two dead bodies in the vestry of St Matthew’s Church, Paddington, their throats slashed. One is Sir Paul Berowne, a baronet and recently-resigned Tory MP; the other a homeless man called Harry Mack. Dalgliesh is called in to investigate, accompanied by DS Masterson and his new DS Kate Miskin.

1.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - A Taste for Death (2)
1.plot: After the attack on Father Barnes while Halliwell was in custody, Dalgliesh brings Swayne and Lampart in for questioning. He discovers Lampart is having an affair with Lady Barbara, who reveals she is pregnant and thinks she will inherit everything. However, Lady Lavinia reveals that Sir Paul secretly changed his will at the last minute.

2.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - Death of an Expert Witness (1)
2.plot: When a senior forensic biologist is found dead in his lab, Dalgliesh is called to East Anglia, where the murderer is lying in wait to strike again.

2.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Death of an Expert Witness (2)
2.plot: After another body is discovered, Dalgliesh and Miskin untangle a web of infidelities in this rural community, unearthing a killer with secrets to hide and tracks to cover.

2.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - A Certain Justice (1)
2.plot: Dalgliesh, Kate Miskin, and new D.S. Daniel Tarrant investigate the murder of an abrasive female defence barrister who successfully defended a shady young man on murder charges, only for him to begin dating her daughter.

2.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - A Certain Justice (2)
2.plot: As Dalgliesh's team sort out the complicated motives surrounding the victim's murder, they are running out of time to save her daughter from her dangerous fiancee.

2.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - The Murder Room (1)
2.plot: Marcus and Caroline Dupayne struggle to convince their brother, Neville, to renew the lease on their family's museum. When Neville's car is torched on the museum grounds and he perishes inside, all who work there are suspects - including his siblings.

2.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - The Murder Room (2)
2.plot: The grisly discovery in the trunk provides a new line of inquiry that leads to a hidden room, ties to intelligence agents, and a scandalous society at the heart of the museum. The team race to crack the case as the killer prepares to strike again.

3.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S03E01 - Death in Holy Orders (1)
3.plot: Dalgliesh travels to a remote seminary overlooking a windswept lake, where a body has been found gruesomely murdered. Nearly everyone in the seminary has reason to resent the victim, and Dalgliesh and DS Tarrant must unpick a complicated set of motives to find their killer.

3.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S03E02 - Death in Holy Orders (2)
3.plot: Dalgliesh travels to a remote seminary overlooking a windswept lake, where a body has been found gruesomely murdered. Nearly everyone in the seminary has reason to resent the victim, and Dalgliesh and DS Tarrant must unpick a complicated set of motives to find their killer.

3.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S03E03 - Cover Her Face (1)
3.plot: Dalgliesh investigates a murder in the Essex home of the Mehtas, a staggeringly wealthy family with connections to the British government. With the help of local detective Clive Roscoe, Dalgliesh builds a picture of events in the weeks leading to the crime, confronting a blanket of secrecy among his guarded suspects.

3.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S03E04 - Cover Her Face (2)
3.plot: Dalgliesh investigates a murder in the Essex home of the Mehtas, a staggeringly wealthy family with connections to the British government. With the help of local detective Clive Roscoe, Dalgliesh builds a picture of events in the weeks leading to the crime, confronting a blanket of secrecy among his guarded suspects.

3.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S03E05 - Devices and Desires (1)
3.plot: Dalgliesh is sent on an urgent mission to investigate a terrorist plot against a nuclear power station on the Kent coast. He is soon drawn into a complex and highly charged hunt for a serial killer, working once more alongside former colleague Kate Miskin, now an acting DCI.

3.title: FR - Dalgliesh [VOSTFR] - S03E06 - Devices and Desires (2)
3.plot: Dalgliesh is sent on an urgent mission to investigate a terrorist plot against a nuclear power station on the Kent coast. He is soon drawn into a complex and highly charged hunt for a serial killer, working once more alongside former colleague Kate Miskin, now an acting DCI.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - In This Beautiful World of Ours
1.plot: Oh Soryong steps in a case, while Han Do, once a drama producer, joins the Trigger team.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Setback
1.plot: Han Do finds himself accused in a case and decides to track down the real culprit.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - For the Loser
1.plot: The team must catch the culprit before things take a turn for the worse.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Mighty Is the Camera
1.plot: A suspect in a disappearance case returns twenty years later, seeking out Soryong.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Price Tag
1.plot: A building collapses, and Soryong has an emotional clash with Han Do.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Dreaming of Love
1.plot: A familiar face returns to Trigger after ten years, seeking help again for a renewed threat.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Inertia
1.plot: A surprising confession unsettles Han Do and Soryong. Cracks form within the Trigger team.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - The Vanished Witness
1.plot: The team finds a new lead in a case, but the past is firmly sealed to unravel.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Cho Haewon
1.plot: As Soryong hunts for answers, Giho throws the team into chaos.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Oh, Soryong
1.plot: Soryong uncovers hidden truths behind the case from twenty years ago.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Trigger Unleashed
1.plot: Soryong and Han Do dig into a vast conspiracy, finally coming face-to-face with a shocking truth.

1.title: FR - Démasqué [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - The Confession
1.plot: The Trigger team risks all to reveal the truth while fending off the villain's counterattacks.

meta.plot: Dans le Séoul d'aujourd'hui, une équipe de journalistes d'investigation se bat pour sa carrière après avoir diffusé un article controversé. Alors que le temps presse, l'équipe se voit confier une tâche impossible si elle veut sauver son emploi : résoudre une affaire vieille de vingt ans impliquant un acteur célèbre qui a disparu sans laisser de traces.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Jan de Lichte is literally dragged towards home as an accused murderer/deserter. When he arrives in his hometown, he finds change everywhere. The poorest citizens tend to end up branded, beat and banished from town, but they have joined together in the forest and that’s where Jan discovers family and friends.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Héloïse meets a suitor. Coffijn resists Baru's push for reform of the City Watch. Jan tells the Embo family that Emiel is dead, but hides his guilt.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Tincke rescues a wounded Jan from bounty hunters but discovers the price on his friend's head. Coffijn involves partners in his road-building plan.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The thieves discover the valuable cargo they've stolen in the stagecoach raid, but the incident provokes a violent backlash not even Baru can prevent.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Baru gets valuable intelligence from his spy, Anne-Marie. Héloïse runs away with Jan, leaving her father distraught. Iron Simon makes Tincke an offer.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: After learning the truth about her brother, Héloïse returns home. Iron Simon puts a price on Tincke's head. Jan engineers a bold reversal of fortune.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Baru is elevated to alderman and welcomes Anne-Marie and her sister into his new home. Tincke schemes to free Jan. Héloïse prepares to wed Nicolaï.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: One year later, an ailing Tincke has taken over a nightclub. Coffijn launches an ambitious new project. The town prepares for a holy procession.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: A miraculous return from the dead precedes the fulfillment of a curse. Nicolaï's mother discovers why Héloïse is not pregnant. Anne-Marie pays a debt.

1.title: FR - Bandits des bois - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The thieves celebrate their good fortune. Benoît Van Gelderhode vows to avenge Nicolaï. Baru succeeds Coffijn and forces Anne-Marie to make a choice.

meta.plot: Le charismatique bandit de grand chemin Jan de Lichte guide les opprimés dans une révolte contre l'aristocratie corrompue des Flandres du XVIIIe siècle.

1.title: FR - Mr. Bates contre le Post Office - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The first part of a four-part drama. Mysterious financial losses lead the Post Office to sack and prosecute village sub-postmasters who have no way to prove their innocence.

1.title: FR - Mr. Bates contre le Post Office - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Alan Bates and the sub-postmasters begin their fightback with new allies in Westminster, but first they must convince an independent investigator of their honesty.

1.title: FR - Mr. Bates contre le Post Office - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Alan allies with the Post Office in the hope his friends can get justice at last, but can he trust the people who have let them down so badly?

1.title: FR - Mr. Bates contre le Post Office - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Alan and his friends finally get the chance to embark on the epic challenge of battling the Post Office in court.

meta.plot: L’histoire de centaines de postiers accusés à tort d’avoir volé de l’argent à leur maison mère entre 1999 et 2015.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Heliocentrism. How About That?
1.plot: A gifted young student plans to study theology at university, but his true passion is astronomy. One day, he meets a mysterious scholar named Hubert.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - And Now... I'm Going to Move the Earth
1.plot: Rafał is intrigued by Hubert’s heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafał a pendant before being whisked away.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - I... Believe in Heliocentrism
1.plot: Nowak convinces Potocki to admit to Rafał's heresy. Once arrested, Rafał is given a choice: recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
1.plot: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Even If I Die... This World Will Continue
1.plot: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee for the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Move... The World
1.plot: Oczy seeks the help of Badeni, the demoted monk who incurred the Church's wrath by turning his curiosity to the riddles of the sky.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Matters of the Truth
1.plot: Gifted scholar Jolenta suffers discrimination as the only girl at an astronomy institute. Badeni seeks resources to prove the heliocentric theory.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - We Must Become Icarus
1.plot: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - This Is What It Means... To Learn Something, I Think
1.plot: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Truth
1.plot: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Terror
1.plot: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Heliocentrism Is My Faith
1.plot: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni's premises but doesn't find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - Freedom
1.plot: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - Tonight's Sky...
1.plot: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents on heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy's torture at Nowak's hands.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E15 - Is It... My Turn?
1.plot: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E16 - It's Time to Begin the Operation
1.plot: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E17 - I Could Make a Lot of Money with This Book… Maybe
1.plot: A young nomad woman haunted by poverty devotes her life to obtaining wealth. One night, she discovers the book that Frei hid in the abandoned village.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E18 - To Liberate Information
1.plot: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt’s men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E19 - Wandering Is How You Find What's Right
1.plot: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E20 - I Love Heliocentrism
1.plot: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E21 - The Times Are Changing
1.plot: Schmidt and the others regroup with their Liberation Front comrades and begin printing the book. However, a traitor brings their operation to a halt.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E22 - Neither of You Will Be Known to History
1.plot: As Nowak's group attacks the Liberation Front, Draka and Schmidt begin their escape. Upon reaching town, Draka makes a proposition to Bishop Antoni.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E23 - Comrades
1.plot: A deluded Nowak turns against Antoni and attempts to burn down the church. Draka fights back and escapes but incurs a terrible wound.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E24 - Thaumazein
1.plot: Albert goes to deliver an order of bread to a church. While there, he encounters a mysterious priest who encourages him to confess his sins.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E25 - 『?』
1.plot: Albert leaves the academic gathering and returns home to an awful sight. In the present, the priest gives Albert advice and makes his own confession.

meta.plot: Lorsqu'il reçoit des enseignements hérétiques sur la Terre et le Soleil, un jeune prodige se met en quête des recherches secrètes de son maître tout en échappant à l'Inquisition.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E01 - Don't Give Up the Ship (1)
1.plot: The introduction of the series, as Donald Duck joins the Navy and sends Huey, Dewey, and Louie off to live with their uncle Scrooge McDuck. Meanwhile, a mysterious man named El Capitán busts the Beagle Boys out of jail in order for them to help him steal an awkward treasure map in Scrooge's possession.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E02 - Wronguay in Ronguay (2)
1.plot: After foiling the Beagle Boys, Scrooge and his nephews decipher the strange marking on the map, which leads to a sunken treasure ship in Ronguay. However, Flintheart Glomgold and El Capitán are out to stop them at every turn.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E03 - Three Ducks of the Condor (3)
1.plot: Upon finding out of the Valley of the Golden Suns, Scrooge begins an expedition to find the treasure therein, starting with finding the map that leads to it. First, he must get one half of the map from High Golden Sun Priest Joaquin Slowly.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E04 - Cold Duck (4)
1.plot: The nephews, Webby, and Mrs. Beakley find themselves joining Scrooge in his adventure as he looks for the second half of the treasure map in Antarctica.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E05 - Too Much of a Gold Thing (5)
1.plot: Scrooge develops gold fever as he and the gang make their way to the Valley of the Golden Suns, all the while pursued by El Capitán.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E06 - Send in the Clones
1.plot: Magica DeSpell gets the Beagle Boys to help her steal the Number One Dime, disguising them as the nephews.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E07 - Sphinx for the Memories
1.plot: An ancient Egyptian civilization abducts Donald so that he can host a spirit of a Pharaoh.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E08 - Where No Duck Has Gone Before
1.plot: Gyro's props for a science fiction television show accidentally launch the cast into space, and Launchpad becomes the hero when it is realized that he is the only real pilot on board.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E09 - Armstrong
1.plot: Gyro presents the McDuck household with a robot named Armstrong to do their work for them. However, the robot decides it would rather work for itself.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E09 - Armstrong
1.plot: Gyro presents the McDuck household with a robot named Armstrong to do their work for them. However, the robot decides it would rather work for itself.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E10 - Robot Robbers
1.plot: After the incident with Armstrong, Gyro builds giant human-operated robots for Glomgold, only to have them be stolen and operated by Ma Beagle and the Beagle Boys.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E11 - Magica's Shadow War
1.plot: Magica's plot to steal the Number One Dime using her own shadow goes awry when her shadow develops a mind of its own.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E12 - Master of the Djinni
1.plot: Scrooge and Glomgold race for mastership of Aladdin's genie.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E13 - Hotel Strangeduck
1.plot: Scrooge turns a castle once owned by mad scientist into a hotel, but he doesn't believe that the place is haunted.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E14 - Lost Crown of Genghis Khan
1.plot: Scrooge goes searching for a crown in the Himalayas, which is guarded by a snow beast. Loosely based on the Carl Barks story of the same name.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E15 - Duckman of Aquatraz
1.plot: Scrooge is framed for stealing a painting from Glomgold's art gallery and sent to Aquatraz.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E16 - The Money Vanishes
1.plot: The Beagle Boys steal Gyro's handheld teleporter and use it to steal Scrooge's fortune.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E17 - Sir Gyro de Gearloose
1.plot: Gyro, tired of being looked upon as a "gadget man", invents a time machine and uses it to go back in time to the Middle Ages.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E18 - Dinosaur Ducks
1.plot: Scrooge and Launchpad explore a land where dinosaurs still live, but the kids tag along against Scrooge's directions to the contrary.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E19 - Hero for Hire
1.plot: After being fired by Scrooge, Launchpad is tricked by the Beagle Boys into performing a series of bank robberies disguised as movie scenes.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E20 - Superdoo!
1.plot: Having a hard time at camp, Doofus accidentally finds a stolen alien crystal that grants him numerous super powers.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E21 - Maid of the Myth
1.plot: Mrs. Beakley is abducted by Vikings and it is up to Scrooge and the others to rescue her.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E22 - Down & Out in Duckburg
1.plot: A family debt causes Scrooge to lose his entire fortune, sending his entire family into the poorhouse.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E23 - Much Ado About Scrooge
1.plot: Scrooge and the boys track down a lost play by a famed playwright.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E24 - Top Duck
1.plot: Launchpad's family comes to visit while the Beagle Boys eye Scrooge's new jet so that they can use it to pilfer his Money Bin.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E25 - Pearl of Wisdom

1.title: FR - Devil May Cry - S01E03 - The Deep and Savage Way
1.plot: A flashback sheds light on Mary's past. In the present, a convoy with precious cargo hits a roadblock as the White Rabbit creeps closer to his prey.

1.title: FR - Devil May Cry - S01E04 - All Hope Abandon
1.plot: The amulet's signal leads DARKCOM to a run-down apartment building. But is it really the Rabbit's lair... or a trap? Dante learns his true origins.

1.title: FR - Devil May Cry - S01E05 - Descent
1.plot: Grim discoveries complicate Mary's mission. An exhilarating free fall fuels an epic transformation, forcing Dante to confront his demon side.

1.title: FR - Devil May Cry - S01E06 - The First Circle
1.plot: A revealing trip down the rabbit hole yields a haunting tale of two childhoods — parallel stories with intertwining fates.

1.title: FR - Devil May Cry - S01E07 - At the Gates of Paradise
1.plot: The stage is set for the ultimate showdown as the Rabbit and his army lie in wait for Dante to arrive. But there's more than one hero ready to fight.

1.title: FR - Devil May Cry - S01E08 - A River of Blood and Fire
1.plot: Dante and Mary face impossible choices — and an enemy more powerful than the world has ever seen. In the aftermath, Baines puts a bold plan into motion.

meta.plot: Une série inspirée du parcours de la journaliste et écrivaine italienne Oriana Fallaci qui, à l’aube de sa carrière, signe des chroniques sur l’art de vivre et le cinéma. Elle s’imposera au fil des ans comme la journaliste la plus influente et controversée du 20e siècle. La jeune critique de cinéma rêve de couvrir l’actualité politique. Alors qu’elle affine son style singulier dans une série d’articles sur Hollywood, Oriana Fallaci vit un premier amour tourmenté.

1.title: FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Milan, 1956. Ambitious young journalist Oriana Fallaci, fed up with her role as the 'Cinema girl', makes a bet with her editor: if she manages to interview Marilyn Monroe, she will finally have the chance to write about politics.

1.title: FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Oriana gets invited to a party full of Hollywood stars to interview them, but the actors are terrified by the press and would rather give up having fun than end up in the papers. However, she turns her failure into an opportunity.

1.title: FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Thanks to the help of powerful producer Albert Gordon, Oriana manages to interview some of Hollywood's biggest stars. However, when she realizes that her independence is at stake, she decides to leave and return home.

1.title: FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Oriana meets Alfredo again and falls in love, but the liaison is short-lived as Alfredo is leaving for London. After interviewing Frank Sinatra, she leaves the USA and convinces her editor to be sent to London to be with him.

1.title: FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Oriana slips intensely into the affair with Alfredo and ends up neglecting her work. When she finds out he is seeing someone else, she steps back, but discovers she is pregnant. To not lose him, she decides to end the pregnancy.

1.title: FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E06 - Episode 6
FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E07 - Episode 7
FR - Miss Fallaci - S01E08 - Episode 8

meta.plot: Révèle le fonctionnement interne d'une famille criminelle de Toronto et l'empire mondial d'une organisation criminelle terrifiante.

1.title: FR - Mafia: Most Wanted - S01E01 - Watch Your Back
1.plot: With the emergence of the Mafia in the 1970s, Toronto becomes a mob city with two crime fac-tions vying for control.

1.title: FR - Mafia: Most Wanted - S01E02 - Behind the Bosses
1.plot: A betrayal leads to a temporary Mafia takedown, when the mob bosses reemerge so does a new violent, power-hungry enforcer, Joe Ferraro.

1.title: FR - Mafia: Most Wanted - S01E03 - They Always Get Away
1.plot: Our view of organized crime expands; we go undercover with the RCMP as they conduct elabo-rate surveillance to bring down the Mafia bosses.

meta.plot: In 2003, rock singer Bertrand Cantat killed his partner, actress Marie Trintignant. This documentary revisits the case that divided a nation.

1.title: EN - From Rock Star to Killer [MULTI-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Just an Accident?
1.plot: Vilnius, July 2003. Actress Marie Trintignant is hospitalized after being beaten by her partner, singer Bertrand Cantat. He claims it was an accident.

1.title: EN - From Rock Star to Killer [MULTI-AUDIO] - S01E02 - A Deadly Passion?
1.plot: Despite a damning autopsy report, Cantat's defense tries to minimize his responsibility. French society is divided ahead of the highly publicized trial.

1.title: EN - From Rock Star to Killer [MULTI-AUDIO] - S01E03 - The Cantat Curse
1.plot: In 2007, Bertrand Cantat moves in with his ex-wife, Kristina Rady. Tragedy unfolds again when her 2010 death follows some disturbing phone messages.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E01 - Diary of a Perfect Murder
1.plot: Atlanta lawyer Ben Matlock takes on the high profile case of a television reporter accused of murdering his former wife. The case is complicated when his daughter Charlene develops feelings for the accused killer.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E02 - The Judge
1.plot: Ben Matlock accepts the pro bono case of Kevin Meredith, a young man accused of murdering his lover, whom Ben soon realises had a much more powerful lover.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E03 - The Stripper
1.plot: Years ago, Ben represented Jason Hardiman in his divorce proceedings, and upon his instructions, offered Carla a small fortune to relinquish custody of their son. She refused, and eventually won. Now Carla can only find work as a stripper. Jason goes to her work and again threatens to take their son Jimmy from her. When he is found at the edge of death, Carla is the immediate suspect. He is murdered while in the hospital, and Carla is the prime suspect. Ben's suspicions soon turn to a woman named Helen Shelly, but unfortunately, it's hard to find her. Doug Templitt seems to be the only one who knows where she is.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E04 - The Affair
1.plot: Matlock represents the a maid accused of killing her employer, at the request of the man's widow. The request is a little odd, but it seems Christina Ward wants people to know exactly what kind of man her husband was. Matlock is more than a little uncomfortable when it seems Charlene is developing a tendre for the woman's son Clark, an old college chum of Charlene's.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E05 - The Seduction
1.plot: Matlock is hired to defend Brad Bingham, an aging football star with a reputation as a womanizer who was about to be cut from the team. Charlene is resistant to Ben's choice, as she believes everything the tabloids have to say about Brad...not only that, but years earlier, he'd had a brief relationship with her friend Ellen Hawley, who had tried to kill herself after they broke up. As the case continues, Charlene realises that not everything that's printed in the papers is true and that maybe Ellen wasn't quite honest with her, even though a call girl (Caryn Nelson) hired to make Brad look guilty almost convinces her that he is.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E06 - The Don (1)
1.plot: When Nicholas Baron, a well known mobster, is accused of murdering one of his rivals, he asks Ben Matlock to represent him. Ben initially refuses, but agrees to represent Baron despite threats on his own life. He soon meets the entire family, and realises that despite what Baron has always done for a living, at heart he's a worried father who wants to clear his name.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E07 - The Don (2)
1.plot: Even though they've lost a key witness, Matlock keeps defending Nicholas Baron. Daniel tries to convince Matlock that his father just can't handle any stress due to his heart condition, but Nicholas continues to beg Matlock to clear his name. While Matlock investigates a suspect closer to home than Baron would want, Charlene blows her chance at a relationship with Paul when she can't separate the man from the legend.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E08 - The Sisters
1.plot: Harold Scully is a boring man. But at least he knows that. When he begs old acquaintance Ben Matlock to defend him on charges of murdering his wealthy wife Esther, Matlock reluctantly agrees. The more investigating he does, the more he realises that there is something seriously wrong with Harold's two nieces, sisters Julia and Emily.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E09 - The Cop
1.plot: Detective Joe Peters has been accused of taking bribes and murdering a fence, and also suspected in the death of a fellow cop. When it comes right down to it, one of the other cops on the force was more involved than they should have been.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E10 - The Angel
1.plot: Matlock reluctantly agrees to hire free-spirited rock star Angel after Charlene reveals she's already taken the job for them. Angel has been accused of killing her manager, and due to an alcohol induced black-out, can't even offer herself an alibi for the night. Matlock gets more and more angry when Angel continues to ignore his suggestions at toning down her life-style, but luckily he's able to get through to her before her attitude gets her convicted of murder.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E11 - A Traitor in Thine Own House
1.plot: Tensions rise as Shae work with Olympia's team on a case for a tech startup that's had trade secrets stolen.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E12 - This Is That Moment
1.plot: Olympia and Julian's issues intensify as they each represent opposing sides in a nasty custody case. Also, Matty uses the firm's security system to her advantage.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E13 - Pregame
1.plot: An important class-action lawsuit leads the team to investigate a sorority; Matty brings Alfie with her to Jacobson Moore on Family Day.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E14 - Game Day
1.plot: Olympia hires an outside party to select jurors rather than using Shae, putting the case at risk.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E15 - Game Face
1.plot: Olympia's partnership dream hangs in the balance as she and her team race against the clock to get a dangerous drink off the market.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E16 - The Johnson Case
1.plot: Olympia tries to impress the partnership board by taking on a complicated murder case.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E17 - I Was That, Too
1.plot: A pregnant woman asks for Olympia’s help obtaining a divorce from her husband, whose family is a client of the firm.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E18 - Tricks of the Trade (1)
1.plot: When Sarah's client is arrested after his business partner is found murdered, Billy attempts to help her handle the case while Matty and Olympia contend with a pressing confidential matter.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E19 - Tricks of the Trade (2)
1.plot: Sarah's career is put in jeopardy as Jacobson-Moore readies for a trial that could change everything; Matty makes a shocking discovery.

meta.plot: Ancienne gloire du barreau, Madeline Matlock reprend du service dans un prestigieux cabinet où elle utilise son allure discrète et ses tactiques rusées pour gagner des affaires et dénoncer la corruption.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Enter Sandman (2)
1.plot: Gibbs and the gritty ragtag team continue their investigation at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office.

1.plot: Gibbs goes undercover for the first time with Lala as NIS works the case of a dead Navy seaman who may have been sharing top-secret intel that poses a threat to national security. Also, Lala struggles with her place on the team and an unexpected development in her personal life.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - One Flew Over
1.plot: NIS investigates the murder of a dementia-afflicted Jane Doe. Also, flashbacks reveal the first time Gibbs met Franks

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Sick as Our Secrets
1.plot: Gibbs and the team investigate the case of a Navy priest who was killed in the confessional booth and may have been targeted by mistake. Meanwhile, Randy shows Gibbs the ropes of working a protective detail while struggling with a personal situation.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Vivo o Muerto
1.plot: The case of a missing woman who disappeared after a night of clubbing with a Navy seaman takes the team to Mexico, where they learn of a possible connection to Gibbs' past.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Blue Bayou
1.plot: As Leroy Jethro Gibbs prepares for his first Christmas without his wife and daughter, flashbacks reveal the unlikely journey that led to his first day on the job as a special agent.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Flight of Icarus
1.plot: The team investigates the death of a famed Marine commander's son, while a pivotal part of Franks' past involving his family is revealed.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Touchstones
1.plot: When the evidence room is broken into and significant cash goes missing, the team looks into a connection to a recent case. Also, Lala opens up to Gibbs, and Kowalski struggles to move forward.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - Monsoon
1.plot: The team investigates the brutal murder of a veteran who fell on hard times after serving in Vietnam, leading Franks to reflect on his own struggles following the war. Also, Gibbs considers a new path forward.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - To Have and to Hold
1.plot: The team works the case of an investment advisor found dead shortly after her release from prison. Also, Mary Jo is left reeling by an unexpected development in her personal life.

1.plot: The team investigates the brutal murder of a military sergeant found burned in her car, a case Franks suspects could have a connection to the assault of his estranged wife.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E17 - Darlin', Don't Refrain
1.plot: After the shocking developments in the Sandman case, the team works with the FBI to investigate further; while Wheeler struggles to hold onto his job, his family reaches a crisis point.

1.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S01E18 - Cecilia
1.plot: When the murder of Pedro Hernandez is unearthed, Gibbs faces a reckoning. But when he needs his team most, the loyalty of one is brought into question.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - The Funky Bunch
2.plot: Gibbs and Franks investigate the disappearance of a young Marine connected to a mysterious compound with a charismatic leader, and Lala’s fate is revealed.

2.plot: When the body of a college swimmer washes up on the beach, the team must determine if it was an accident or murder. Also, Gibbs prepares for his first interrogation.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - Bend, Don't Break
2.plot: A murder near Camp Pendleton leads Gibbs and the team to a suburban mall in San Diego, where Gibbs takes matters into his own hands. Jackson Gibbs pays Franks an unexpected visit.

2.plot: Tensions rise when Franks’ estranged older brother, Mason, blows into town, desperate for help after hitting rock bottom. Also, the team investigates the robbery of a Navy bank while Lala, still struggling after her accident, makes a decision about her future.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - Funny How Time Slips Away (I)

Gibbs and the NIS team investigate the small-town death of a naval officer, but struggle to come up with justice.

2.plot: When an anonymous tip leads to the discovery of a young Marine’s body at a chilling crime scene, Randy believes it could be connected to a previous case where a coin was left in the victim’s throat. Also, Franks tries to track down priceless packages meant for his brother, Mason.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E07 - Crazy Little Thing Called Love
2.plot: The team investigates the murder of a Marine who had recently been handpicked for a classified mission. Also, Wheeler’s personal life is upended, Lala is thrown by unexpected news from Vera, and Gibbs and Diane double-date with Randy and his wife.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E09 - Fools Rush In
2.plot: As the team discovers Gibbs’ drunken Vegas elopement with Diane, the newlyweds contemplate their future. Also, the team investigates a fatal movie theater bombing with a connection to the Pruitt compound where Mason is staying.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E10 - Lean On Me
2.plot: When a marine captain shows up at Camp Pendleton exhibiting symptoms of a fatal virus, NIS goes on lockdown and Gibbs is forced to take charge. As panic spreads, the team races to determine whether it really is a deadly outbreak or something else entirely.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E11 - Feelin' Alright?
2.plot: When a lieutenant’s water-logged body is discovered with a potential connection to an international smuggling ring, NIS Panama agents are called in to assist, and Gibbs comes face-to-face with an old nemesis: Special Agent Dwayne Pride. Once the two are assigned to a dangerous undercover mission together, Gibbs must find a way to move on from their past.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E12 - The Gambler
2.plot: When the NIS Regional Director tries to transfer Mary Jo, she reconnects with an old friend from Atlantic City to help investigate the roadside deaths of two Marines.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E13 - Homeward Bound
2.plot: When Dr. Tango is arrested for stealing human remains from a national park, Dr. Donald "Ducky" Mallard returns to assist the team in proving his innocence.

2.title: FR - NCIS: Origins [VOSTFR] - S02E14 - The Beautiful Ballad of Gary Callahan
2.plot: When the team's trusted K-9 agent, Gary Callahan, is critically wounded at a crime scene, NIS races to track down the culprit while a surprising pre-Pendleton chapter in Franks' life is revealed.

meta.plot: Les jeunes années de Gibbs au sein du NIS et au NCIS dans les années 90

FR - Zodiac : l'obsession - S01E02 - Episode 2

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire offre un regard unique et contemporain sur l'une des affaires criminelles les plus célèbres de l'histoire. Fayçal Ziraoui, un jeune polytechnicien, découvre par hasard l'affaire du Zodiac, une affaire qui a émergé à la fin des années 60 à San Francisco. Un tueur en série terrifiait la population, mettant en scène ses crimes et inondant les journaux et la police de lettres énigmatiques contenant des cryptogrammes. Le tueur a disparu sans laisser de trace. 50 ans plus tard, Fayçal relève le défi de déchiffrer les deux derniers codes envoyés par le tueur.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Goodbye, Sang Yan. Goodbye, Wen Yi Fan.
1.plot: Down-on-her-luck news reporter Wen Yifan visits a newly opened restaurant, but soon realizes that it's owned by Sang Yan, her childhood crush.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Your Name Is Written on My Heart.
1.plot: After narrowly escaping an assault by her violent roommate, Wen Yifan and Sang Yan cross paths again as she decides to change her living arrangements.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Everyone Needs a Romantic Interest. You're My Romantic Interest.
1.plot: Fate pushes Wen Yifan and Sang Yan together once more when her moving plans fall through and a fire breaks out at his apartment complex.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Rumors. I'll Dispel the Rumors for You.
1.plot: Wen Yifan has a tense encounter with her sister, and Sang Yan officially moves in. Some old friends stop by for a night of nostalgia.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Get Closer, Would You?
1.plot: A game of Truth or Dare leads to a surprising kiss. Sang Yan stews over his regrets. Wen Yifan's mother asks her to visit for New Year's Eve.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - I Will Always Be with You. Will You Always Be with Me?
1.plot: Working through New Year's celebrations, a lonely Wen Yifan struggles to cope. As Sang Yan steps in to keep her company, she reflects on her childhood.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - A Secret… that Can’t Be Kept
1.plot: Sang Yan's sister visits and reminisces about the past. After Wen Yifan has a difficult conversation with her aunt, Sang Yan tries to cheer her up.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - The Sun In the Rain, Dazzling and Warm
1.plot: A sleepwalking incident has Sang Yan questioning the nature of his relationship with Wen Yifan, who downplays its significance.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - False of Heart, Honest of Action
1.plot: Wen Yifan encounters a stalker, but a mysterious stranger with an odd connection to her childhood comes to her rescue. Sang Yan secures a job interview.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - You Forgot, but I Still Remember
1.plot: Wen Yifan opens up to her old friend Zhong Siqiao about her personal problems, and another sleepwalking incident raises the stakes for her and Sang Yan.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Take Care of Yourself. I’m Always Here.
1.plot: Sang Yan helps Wen Yifan come to terms with the trauma behind her sleepwalking. Later, she begins an unusual assignment with Mu Chengyun.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - How to Be Happy? Staying with You
1.plot: At a party, a tipsy Wen Yifan asks Sang Yan about their graduation ceremony. Mu Chengyun's pursuit sparks jealousy.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - We Made a Promise: I Want to Be with You
1.plot: Su Hao'an's secret is exposed. A guilt-ridden Wen Yifan sleepwalks again.

1.title: FR - The First Frost [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - Can’t Let Go of My Feelings for You

1.plot: As their relationship heats up, Sang Yan and Wen Yifan enjoy a dinner date, but the mood sours when her troublemaking sister appears.

meta.plot: A species of parasitic aliens descends on Earth and quickly infiltrates humanity by entering the brains of vulnerable targets; insatiable beings that gain total control of their host and are capable of transforming themselves to feed on unsuspecting prey. High school student Shinichi Izumi falls victim to one of these parasites, but the creature fails to take over his brain and ends up in his right hand.

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Metamorphosis
1.plot: The whole world is about to change one quiet evening with the arrival of parasytes who devour human brains. One of their eggs lands at the home of Izumi Shinichi, a high school student. The hatched parasyte attacks Shinichi, but it faces unexpected resistance and fails to infiltrate his brain.

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Demon in the Flesh
1.plot: As Shinichi and his parasyte continue their unasked-for coexistence, the parasyte in his right (migi) arm decides to take on the name of "Migi." Shinichi realizes that parasytes are involved in the ongoing mincemeat murders. Feeling alone in his discovery, Shinichi grapples with frustration. Unbeknownst to him, he is about to meet another parasyte for the first time...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Feast
1.plot: As the number of mincemeat murder victims grows, Shinichi, alone in his knowledge of the truth, is in turmoil. When Migi suddenly alerts him to the presence of another parasyte, he is aghast to find that it is in his own school. Paranoid, Shinichi attends a schoolwide assembly, where the staff introduce a beautiful new teacher...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Disheveled Hair
1.plot: Shinichi's life returns to "normal" after A's killing spree, but Shinichi remains in low spirits. His mother, Nobuko, becomes worried, but Shinichi just bluffs when she asks him what's wrong. His father, Kazuyuki, suggests to Nobuko that a past incident may be involved. Nobuko looks down at the old scar on her hand and thinks back to what happened when Shinichi was a little boy...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Stranger
1.plot: Running late to school, Shinichi sees Nagai in trouble with some punks. When Shinichi steps in to help, he meets a high school student, Kimishima Kana. Shinichi and Satomi share a close moment when she tends to his injuries, but his life is about to take a sudden turn with a single phone call from his father...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Sun Also Rises
1.plot: Struck through the heart by his mother-turned-parasite, Shinichi survives only through Migi's efforts. After regaining consciousness, Shinichi is devastated by the realization that none of it had been a dream.

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Dark Night's Passing
1.plot: Thinking he'd found his mother's killer, Shinichi instead meets Uda Mamoru, a man in a similar situation as himself. Uda sympathizes with Shinichi and suggests that they all work together. The time to avenge his mother has come at last! Shinichi heads to the precipice...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Freezing Point
1.plot: Shinichi has regained some semblance of a normal life. However, with Migi's cells dispersed throughout his body, his physical abilities have greatly increased to the point that not even Mitsuo poses a threat. Shinichi fears that the changes go beyond the physical and into the psychological. Just as peace returns to his school, a new parasite appears!

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Beyond Good and Evil
1.plot: Yuko is drawn to Shimada Hideo, but gradually realizes that something is seriously amiss with Shimada's face itself. As Yuko pursues Shimada's secret, she connects the dots between him and her brother's police investigation.

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - What Mad Universe
1.plot: Incapable of rationala thought, Shimada Hideo is a savage beast on a rampage, and Satomi's class has become his prey. Shinichi must make his way through the carnage in order to save Satomi...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Blue Bird
1.plot: Kana's feelings for Shinichi grows day by day, and so does Shinichi's apprehension about Kana's ability. As ordinary life returns, Satomi struggles with her mounting suspicion that something has changed in Shinichi. Meanwhile, a new parasite appears to wreak havoc in a local gang hideout. Everyone's lives are about to get shattered yet again.

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Kokoro
1.plot: Kana's special ability is gaining in strength. Believing that ignoring her will only endanger her life, Shinichi tells Kana everything about the parasites. Shinichi only wants to save Kana, but Kana believes Shinichi is lying to her. They are two ships, passing in the night...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Hello Sadness
1.plot: A few days after Kana's death, things seem to be back to normal for Shinichi. Satomi and her friends are perturbed by his seeming indifference, but Shinichi, himself, is grappling with his own sense of disquiet with his unnatural state of mind. Meanwhile, a man begins snooping around about Shinichi...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - The Selfish Gene
1.plot: Shinichi's secret becomes known to Kuramori, the private investigator hired by Tamura. Shinichi tries to confide in Satomi, but his unsuccessful attempt only drives a wedge between them. Shinichi recruits Uda's help to break the impasse.

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Something Wicked This Way Comes
1.plot: Though still full of doubt, Kuramori has, for the time being, accepted Shinichi. Soon after, Kuramori's resolve is severely shaken by witnessing a parasite murder a human being. Shinichi is frustrated by the turn of events, but the lull is cut short when a new parasite appears...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Happy Family
1.plot: The newest parasite to appear is different from the others. Chatty and expressive, the parasite identifies himself as Miki and immediately makes his move. With Migi asleep, all Shinichi can do is to run and keep running...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Adventure of the Dying Detective
1.plot: Having determined Tamura to be a threat, Kusano's group moves to eliminate her. Meanwhile, Kuramori moves to avenge his family's death by abducting Tamura's baby. With her baby in his arms, Kuramori faces Tamura and threatens to throw the infant down a steep slope--what will Tamura do?

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - More Than Human
1.plot: Shinichi and Migi arrive at the park, only to find Tamura holding her child. As Shinichi struggles to quell his fury at the sight of her, Tamura unleashes a flurry of questions about the meaning of the parasites' existence and what humanity means to them.

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - In Cold Blood
1.plot: Suspecting Shinichi's connection to the parasite cases, Hirama arranges to have Shinichi meet with Uragami, a convict with a peculiar ability. Although cleared of any suspicion and able to return to his high school life, it isn't long before Hirama appears once more before Shinichi. A government operation to neutralize the parasites with Hirokawa is about to begin...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Crime and Punishment
1.plot: The joint operation by the police and the strike force to eliminate the group of parasites led by Hirokawa has begun. Yamagishi's unit uses their special sensor system to hunt down the parasites. Amidst the chaos, human victory seems all but confirmed. But the tables are about to be turned by a single parasite...

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Sex and Spirit
1.plot: The assault squad succeeds in eliminating Hirokawa, the parasites' leader, but they find themselves in a bind when the ultimate parasite appears. Their failure to eliminate Gotou strikes fear into Shinichi's heart--who will give him the final courage to face Gotou?

1.title: EN - Parasyte -the maxim  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Quiescence and Awakening
1.plot: Motivated by Satomi to stay alive, Shinichi resolves to fight Gotou. With Migi's support, they press their attack in an isolated forest. However, they fail to finish Gotou at a critical juncture, causing Shinichi to lose Migi and flee in defeat.

Les survivants mettent tous leurs espoirs dans un voyage à travers le temps pour découvrir les causes de la catastrophe et la prévenir. C'est James Cole, hanté depuis des années par une image incompréhensible, qui est désigné pour cette mission.

Meanwhile, Jones visits Old Jennifer Goines to explore the true nature of Time - and the Twelve’s method to destroy it.

3.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S03E10 - Witness
3.plot: The final battle with the Witness begins.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E01 - The End
4.plot: The final conflict with the Army of the 12 Monkeys begins when the Witness returns to Project Splinter.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E02 - Ouroboros
4.plot: Travelers come face to face with ghosts from their past when they find themselves maneuvering around their own timelines.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E03 - 45 RPM
4.plot: Cassie travels back in time to confront a younger Olivia; Cole helps Jennifer find the meaning behind her final Primary vision.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E04 - Legacy
4.plot: Team Splinter goes back in time to the wild, wild frontier in search of a weapon to destroy the Witness.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E05 - After
4.plot: A clue to breaking the cycle leads Cole and Cassie to the 1960s. Christopher Lloyd returns as Zalmon Shaw, a devoted follower of the Witness.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E06 - Die Glocke
4.plot: The team infiltrates a Nazi gala to steal an artifact known as 'Die Glocke'. Their operation comes undone when French Resistance interferes and an unexpected guest arrives.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E07 - Daughters
4.plot: Jones sends Hannah back in time to 2007 on a personal mission that could be the key to everything.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E08 - Demons
4.plot: Everything changes when the team finally climbs the steps... and rings the bell in the Middle Ages.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E09 - One Minute More
4.plot: The beginning of the end as Cole and Cassie embark on their final mission.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E10 - The Beginning (1)
4.plot: The final battle against the Witness as the fate of time and mankind hangs in the balance. All the pieces finally come together to mark the end of the beginning.

4.title: FR - 12 Monkeys - S04E11 - The Beginning (2)
4.plot: When all hope is lost, Cole must complete his cycle so that his younger self will one day arrive at the end with the answer.

meta.plot: Après avoir été aux premières loges d'un crime violent, un génie milliardaire rachète un commissariat de police délaissé pour mettre en place une force de police privée plus efficace, renforcée par de nouveaux outils high tech et des idées novatrices.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E01 - Hard Reset
1.plot: After tech billionaire Gideon Reeves witnesses his best friend's murder, he takes charge of Chicago's troubled 13th District and reboots it as a technically innovative police force, challenging the district to rethink everything about the way they fight crime. Gideon knows if he's going to change anything, he'll need help, which he finds from detective Theresa Murphy, an ambitious, street-smart cop who is willing to give Gideon's technological ideas a chance. After Gideon launches the APB app, allowing citizens to immediately alert the police of a crime, downloads of the app spike, and Gideon realizes his work is just beginning.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E02 - Personal Matters
1.plot: When Gideon accompanies Murphy on a ride-along to see the impact of his reforms, they run into a pharmacy robbery that results in the injury of a child. Gideon vows to get involved and tests out a new drone, but after that fails, he is inspired by an unlikely source to create new electric motorcycles to help find the suspects. Meanwhile, Murphy is disturbed when she hears that someone close to her is the leader of a new project that could take down Gideon's plans for the 13th district. Don't miss the high-speed action.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E03 - Hate of Comrades
1.plot: A group of robbers kill a security guard who was a former police officer and who, before his death, used the APB app. Meanwhile, Gideon redesigns a feedback chair - previously utilized in the aerospace industry - for use in the investigation room, and Murphy learns that her ex-husband, Assistant State Attorney Scott Murphy, may be watching them.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E04 - Signal Loss
1.plot: After armor-piercing bullets are found on the black market, the team decides to send Officer Brandt on an undercover mission to catch the criminals selling them. Meanwhile, a task force led by Murphy's ex-husband threatens Gideon's future.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E05 - Above & Beyond
1.plot: After a man goes to extremes to get justice for his daughter, Gideon and Martinez use new technology to investigate the case. Meanwhile, the assistant state attorney continues to interrogate Gideon and his ideas for the 13th district in the all-new.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E06 - Daddy's Home
1.plot: After Gideon's father finds himself in trouble, he turns to Gideon for assistance. Meanwhile, Brandt and Goss work to track down the mastermind behind a huge grand theft auto case.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E07 - Risky Business
1.plot: When Murphy and Ada team up to help solve a murder, they discover that the killer's next target is Gideon. After learning his safety's at risk during his company's huge technology convention, they utilize a high-tech scanning system to try and track down the killer.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E08 - Fueling Fires
1.plot: After another fire hits one of the gang-run buildings, Murphy and Gideon find out that the cause is much worse than an act of gang retaliation. Meanwhile, Goss is unsure about Brandt's old service buddy, after he's accused of assaulting a customer at the bar where he's a bouncer. Goss seeks the truth and Gideon is faced with an important decision.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E09 - Last Train to Europa
1.plot: An FBI agent seeks Murphy's help when he learns his informant's life may be in danger. Gideon not only assists Murphy with the investigation, but makes a decision that could make or break his company. Meanwhile, the past comes back to haunt Ada.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E10 - Strange Bedfellows
1.plot: When a serial rapist is on the loose, Captain Conrad orders Gideon and Murphy to find the perpetrator before there are any more victims. However, after Gideon's new technology fails to prove helpful for the case, the team is forced to turn to an unexpected ally for help. Meanwhile, Ada struggles with a threatening part of her past and worries that if it resurfaces, it may be harmful.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E11 - Pandora's Box
1.plot: Gideon's life is threatened, so Conrad sends him home to get away from District 13. When the men after Gideon find him, Murphy and Gideon hide in his secret lab, where they become trapped. As they search for a way to escape, Murphy learns the main reason these men are after Gideon.

1.title: FR - A.P.B. : Alerte d'urgence - S01E12 - Ricochet
1.plot: When Gideon is blamed for recent terrorist attacks, he and Captain Conrad work fast to track down the real culprit. But Gideon finds himself in a predicament, when Danny continues to use his technological skills to disrupt the city, leaving Murphy, Ada and the rest of the squad struggling to find a way to stop him. Discover who makes it out alive.

meta.plot:
Nam Shin (Seo Kang-joon) fils d'une famille qui dirige une grande entreprise,

tombe dans le coma après un accident inattendu.  Sa mère Oh Ro-Ra (Kim Sung-ryung) est une spécialiste de la science cérébrale et de l'intelligence artificielle.

Elle va alors créer un androïde nommé Nam Shin III qui sera la copie conforme de son fils dans le coma.

L'androïde va prétendre être Nam Shin et prendre sa place.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - I've Missed You Very Much
1.plot: After Oh Laura loses her son, Nam Sin, to her father in law, Nam Gun Ho, she creates an AI robot that looks exactly like Nam Sin. Nam Sin grows up to as the heir of a rich conglomerate, PK group. He is infamous within the society for his reckless acts. However, he has no intentions of following his grandfather’s footsteps and runs away.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - He'll Come Back Someday
1.plot: Nam Sin goes to Czech Republic to find his mother, Oh Laura. Oh Laura goes to the market with Namsin. At the market, both Nam Sin and Namsin, the robot, are shocked to see each other. Meanwhile, Seo Jong Gil orders a man to assault Nam Sin to get rid of him and take PK group for himself.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Who Are You?
1.plot: Young Hoon, Sin’s personal secretary, follows Sin into Czech Republic. After seeing Nam Sin in a coma and Oh Laura taking care of him, Young Hoon feels shocked. Meanwhile, Gun Ho, the CEO of PK group, tries to fill in for Sin’s presentation of their Driverless Car Project, but Mr. Seo gives the presentation instead.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Disaster Mode
1.plot: So Bong barges into the presentation room and tries to argue with Nam Sin, but she fails. She tries to argue with him again at a club with Ms. Jo’s help, but that is stopped too. However, a fire breaks out at the club. So Bong ends up stuck beneath collapsed debris, but Namsin helps her out.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Hero
1.plot: Namsin gets praised as a hero after saving people’s lives at the fire accident. However, as the ambulance takes him, Laura stops the ambulance and takes him elsewhere. After hearing this, Jong Gil gets suspicious and barges into the operation room where Namsin is.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Who Is This Person?
1.plot: So Bong asks Namsin to take her in as his personal bodyguard, and Namsin decides to take her in. However, Namsin and Young Hoon are still suspicious about her, so they keep an eye out for her. Meanwhile, So Bong follows Young Hoon to PK hospital after hearing his conversation on the phone.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Why Are You Here?
1.plot: So Bong is shocked to see there is another person that looks just like Nam Sin. She reports to Mr. Seo, but he only cares about taking Nam Sin, Laura, and Young Hoon out of his way. Meanwhile, So Bong gets sure about what she saw and sets up a plan with Ms. Jo to get evidence to prove that she was right.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - I'm Sorry
1.plot: Namsin makes So Bong think that she was mistaken. Meanwhile, the test driving of the driverless car is held in front of many reporters. However, as Sin and So Bong follow the driverless vehicle, they realize that something has gone terribly wrong.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Uncanny Valley
1.plot: So Bong is shocked to learn that a robot has been pretending to be Nam Sin. Young Hoon tries to persuade her to keep the secret about Namsin3 and Nam Sin. However, So Bong insists that she should meet Mr. Seo. Meanwhile, Laura tells Young Hoon not to let Namsin get near the driverless car.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Please Help Me
1.plot: So Bong has found out the true identity of Namsin3, but he treats her like a friend. The more he does that, So Bong becomes uncomfortable. In the end, she tries to leave PK group and Namsin. Meanwhile, the chairman rushes his plans to make Nam Sin and Ye Na get married to each other.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - What Must I Trust?
1.plot: So Bong is shocked to be suddenly kissed by Namsin3. In the end, she realizes that Namsin had no bad intentions on this action and decides to continue helping him. However, Ye Na becomes jealous of this and tries to start living with Nam Sin’s house. Meanwhile, So Bong tells Mr. Seo about Ye Na to get rid of her.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Dementia
1.plot: Jong Gil overhears Chairman Nam throwing a fit as his dementia kicks in, so he tries to confirm what he overheard. Young Hoon asks Ye Na to find out if Jong Gil is sure about what he had heard and tells Namsin. Meanwhile, Jong Gil tries to confirm what he heard by threatening Ho Yun with her child.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - What Are You Expecting?
1.plot: Namsin tells Chairman Nam that he doesn’t have dementia. Jong Gil becomes sure that Chairman Nam has dementia and tells So Bong to stay silent about it. Meanwhile, Namsin finds out about Hee Dong’s secret and offers a deal to Ho Yun. However, Namsin gets in trouble as he becomes unable to resupply his battery on time.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - Top Priority
1.plot: Everyone is surprised as Ye Na suddenly steps up and rushes getting married with Nam Sin. So Bong’s father hears about this and visits PK Group out of anger. Meanwhile, So Bong feels uncomfortable as Ye Na keeps mistreating Namsin. This makes her step up to stop Ye Na from mistreating Namsin.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E15 - Rules
1.plot: Chairman Nam finds Laura and tries to persuade her. However, Laura strongly rejects doing anything for Chairman Nam, so Chairman Nam keeps an eye on her just in case. Meanwhile, everybody is surprised to see that Namsin is showing unexpected behavior. This causes Ye Na to take a step further in rushing her wedding.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E16 - He Was All by Himself
1.plot: Laura and Young Hoon only care about the human, Nam Sin. However, So Bong thinks that is unfair for Namsin even if he’s just a robot. Jong Gil starts to suspect So Bong and gives her a warning and one last mission. Meanwhile, Namsin goes out to find So Bong as he can’t find her location since her phone gets turned off.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E17 - Another Method
1.plot: Namsin starts to think and act on his own after So Bong leaves him. Laura becomes worried that Namsin’s identity as a robot might get revealed as he starts to continue to show unexpected actions. This makes her meet So Bong herself. Meanwhile, Jong Gil’s agent follows Laura and finds out that So Bong might be deeply involved with her.

1.title: FR - Are you human? [VOSTFR] - S01E18 - Let Me Borrow Him
1.plot: So Bong just can’t forget about Namsin after turning her back on him. She ends up visiting Laura’s hideout to meet him. Namsin is very happy to see her again, but So Bong only tells him that he should do as Laura and Young Hoon tells him to do. Meanwhile, Jong Gil sends out his agent to find out what secrets So Bong holds.

meta.plot: Une femme policier instable se retrouve forcée de retourner dans sa ville natale. La confrontation avec sa mère abusive est inévitable, mais la découverte d'un corps change la donne. Tout en devant faire face à ses démons, elle se lance à la chasse d'un dangereux tueur en série.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E01 - Black Beach
1.plot: Detective inspector Anita returns to her hometown after a 15-year absence. She dreads meeting the people she's long been avoiding. En route, she's called back to duty after a body is found on the shore by Glerársandar.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E02 - The Journey is the Destiny
1.plot: The appearance of the injured girl changes the investigation of the death of the tourist, but the lack of ambition and mediocre work ethics of the police complicate matters. Anita strengthens her bonds with those who are closest to her.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E03 - Insomnia
1.plot: Anita makes a serious error while interrogating the girl, and the team tries to get their act together before everything falls apart. The widower arrives in Iceland and shines a light on the case that starts to take on a whole new shape.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E04 - You're Not Here
1.plot: Gusti interviews Lena and finds out how his colleagues have made a botch of things. Frida's under pressure and the imminent arrival of Gusti to town, which encourage Anita to look for assistance in a familiar place.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E05 - Salt in the Wounds
1.plot: The autopsy confirms murder. Salomon visits Helga and Elin while Anita battles Gusti, who has extended his stay. Cold cases lead to new information, and a lovers' soiree takes an unexpected turn.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E06 - The Curtain Comes Down
1.plot: Another body is found, connected to one of the cases Frida and Anita are investigating. Mother and daughter are taken aback, and Salamon and Anita's relationship creates an unexpected opportunity for the investigative team.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E07 - A Little Blond Boy
1.plot: Salomon and Anita's past is more important than anyone can suspect. Ragnar is updated about the status of the case, and together, Gusti and Anita put into action the most challenging project of her career and life.

1.title: FR - Black Sands - S01E08 - A Lovers Night
1.plot: The world keeps on turning. Anita and Gusti are in a race against time, fearing the worst. The past two years' events become more apparent, and it's evident that together they head for a final reckoning that will change everything.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E01 - Time to Live
2.plot: Helena, arrives at the police station seeking information about historical abuse in foster homes. Fríða becomes concerned when she learns the foster home belongs to Aníta's grandmother, while Aníta battles postpartum depression at home.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E02 - Everything is a Lie
2.plot: Helena is found dead in a car crash, plunging Fríða into shock. Suspicions of foul play spark an investigation. Fríða keeps the details from Aníta who later uncovers the truth while battling a deepening depression.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E03 - Alone and Forsaken
2.plot: After learning the truth about Helena's death, Aníta returns to work. A family secret drives her to investigate her grandmother's foster home, uncovering ties to Helena's death as other women from the foster home gather for the funeral.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E04 - Too Many Breaths
2.plot: After Helena's funeral, the women argue over Davíð's presence in town. Fríða's investigation points to him, while Aníta uncovers disturbing truths about her grandmother's foster home. Auður confronts Davíð, leading to tragic consequences.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E05 - Alone you are
2.plot: When Davíð's body is found, everything changes. Aníta's mental state deteriorates unnoticed by Fríða. Helena's investigation implicates Davíð, while surveillance footage reveals crucial clues to his death.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E06 - Dancing Barefoot
2.plot: In 1983, Helena arrives at the foster home as Grandma Helga confronts David about his situation with the girls, marking the start of the Black Sands saga.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E07 - Getting Out
2.plot: Interrogations shift dramatically after new autopsy information. Gusti is concerned about Anita and takes the baby, leading to terrible consequences.

2.title: FR - Black Sands - S02E08 - Black Beach II
2.plot: The search for Anita and her baby continues overnight. Frida finds some important evidence, forcing her to make a critical decision about Anita's future.

meta.plot: The Emmy-nominated series celebrates four culinary giants — Jamie Oliver, José Andrés, Alice Waters and Thomas Keller — who changed how the world eats.

1.title: EN - Chef's Table: Legends [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Jamie Oliver
1.plot: Jamie Oliver was a TV chef who didn't look like a typical chef. He found his true passion by inspiring younger generations with healthy, joyful cooking.

1.title: EN - Chef's Table: Legends [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - José Andrés
1.plot: A maximalist chef who revolutionized Spanish cuisine in the United States, José Andrés elevated his love of cooking into his life's greatest work.

1.title: EN - Chef's Table: Legends [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Thomas Keller
1.plot: As the first American chef to win three Michelin stars, and the only one to do it twice, Thomas Keller reflects on his legacy and undeniable influence.

1.title: EN - Chef's Table: Legends [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Alice Waters
1.plot: When Alice Waters built the farm-to-table movement from scratch at Chez Panisse, she inspired generations to embrace the flavor of local, organic food.

1.title: FR - Chef's Table: Legends - S01E01 - Jamie Oliver
1.plot: Jamie Oliver was a TV chef who didn't look like a typical chef. He found his true passion by inspiring younger generations with healthy, joyful cooking.

1.title: FR - Chef's Table: Legends - S01E02 - José Andrés
1.plot: A maximalist chef who revolutionized Spanish cuisine in the United States, José Andrés elevated his love of cooking into his life's greatest work.

1.title: FR - Chef's Table: Legends - S01E03 - Thomas Keller
1.plot: As the first American chef to win three Michelin stars, and the only one to do it twice, Thomas Keller reflects on his legacy and undeniable influence.

1.title: FR - Chef's Table: Legends - S01E04 - Alice Waters
1.plot: When Alice Waters built the farm-to-table movement from scratch at Chez Panisse, she inspired generations to embrace the flavor of local, organic food.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E01 - Contact
1.plot: Two years after the mysterious Burst that killed her family, Aiko has nearly learned to walk again.But a transfer student's arrival upends her life.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E02 - Target
1.plot: Kanzaki takes Aiko to the Town, where her father's old colleague Kurose tells her the unbelievable: Her brain was transplanted into an artificial body.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E03 - Decision
1.plot: The CAAC detains Aiko and Yuya, but the Divers manage to break them out. Though the Matter is active again, the group plans to head to Primary Point.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E04 - Encounter
1.plot: The group clears the Gate just as the government orders an evacuation. Their first target is the Guillotine Shutter at K1, but the Matter is active.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E05 - Memory
1.plot: Inside the Area, the group rests and resupplies at the camp. Nanbara gets a ride from Kurose, but she and Isazu appear to have their own plans.
