1.plot: Langur monkeys, tigers, Joro spiders and tomistomas compete with Asian needle ants, otters and king cobras for first place.

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Accidential Assassins
1.plot: Will top honors be won by water buffaloes, needlefish, toxic crabs, mugger crocodiles, box jellyfish or reticulated pythons?

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Pretty and Painful
1.plot: Cone snails, Asian black bears, red pandas and deadly coral snakes battle Eurasian lynxes, Asian elephants and red lionfish.

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - The Road Less Travelled
1.plot: Facing off for top predator status are Asiatic lions, Lomodo dragons, electric rays, golden jackals, wolverines, striped eel catfish and brown bears.

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Urban Jungle
1.plot: The field narrows as wild boars, feral dogs, pufferfish, Indian red scorpions, Asian tiger mosquitoes and common kraits square off.

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - Corn Me, I'll Fight
1.plot: The formidable features of wolves, stonefish and Malayan porcupines are compared against those of sloth bears, gibbons and snow leopards.

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - The Bold and the Brutal
1.plot: Honey badgers don't care, but Russell's vipers, triggerfish, macaques, yaks and blue-ringed octopuses nearly match their daunting reputation.

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E11 - Big! Banded! and Billed!
1.plot: Giant moray eels complete with gaurs, banded sea kraits, asian forest scorpions, gharials, billfish and Asian giant hornets in the final round.

1.title: EN - 72 Dangerous Animals: Asia [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E12 - Fearsome Finalists
1.plot: The 72 most formidable wild animals in Asia have been profiled and the finalists selected -- but only one can be named most dangerous.

meta.plot: Aspiring Polish rappers drop bars, battle, and craft tracks to impress judges Bedoes 2115, DZIARMA, and Sokół — vying for fame and a 500,000 złoty prize.

1.title: EN - Rhythm + Flow: Poland [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Poland: North, Center, South Part 1
1.plot: The nationwide search for the next big Polish rap name begins — with guests Asster, Kubi Producent, Margaret, Sapi, Włodi, Young Multi and Zeppy Zep.

1.title: EN - Rhythm + Flow: Poland [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Poland: North, Center, South Part 2
1.plot: More auditions unfold with guests 2115, Otsochodzi, Pezet and Pro8l3m. Will they impress the judges enough to take the big stage in Warsaw?

1.title: EN - Rhythm + Flow: Poland [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Warsaw Casting
1.plot: Will the contestants crash and burn… or rise to the occasion when the first round of performances take the stage in Warsaw? With guest judge Oki.

1.title: EN - Rhythm + Flow: Poland [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Cyphers
1.plot: The contestants collaborate on new tracks and perform cyphers in groups. How will they fare when they have to work together? With guest judge Żabson.

meta.plot: Explore what it would be like if the Allied Powers had lost WWII, and Japan and Germany ruled the United States. Based on Philip K. Dick's award-winning novel.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E01 - The New World
1.plot: Joe Blake, a resistance fighter, leaves German New York with cargo for neutral Colorado. In Japanese San Francisco, Juliana Crane receives footage of the Allies winning the war and a bus ticket to Colorado from her sister. There, she meets Joe. Joe reveals a dark secret.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E02 - Sunrise
1.plot: Juliana and Joe are becoming closer and closer in the neutral Rocky Mountain states. Juliana finds a job in a local cafe and receives information of a mysterious King James bible in a local bookshop. Frank is tortured and interrogateed by the Japanese Occupation Military Police back home to know about Juliana's whereabouts.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E03 - The Illustrated Woman
1.plot: Joe and Juliana must act quickly as a vicious bounty hunter known as The Marshal arrives in Canon City. Tagomi makes plans with Wegener to pass valuable secrets from the Reich, and Frank plots his revenge against the Japanese.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E04 - Revelations
1.plot: Joe is increasingly torn between duty and his growing feelings for Juliana. While Ed tries to stop Frank from making an irrevocable decision, Smith's investigation is interrupted when he has trouble with his witness, and Tagomi's plan goes awry as events take a dramatic turn at the Crown Prince's speech.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E05 - The New Normal
1.plot: Juliana returns home, only to discover new clues that lead her closer to unraveling the mystery behind the films. Meanwhile, Joe faces a tough debriefing upon his return home. Kido begins his investigation into the events surrounding the Crown Prince's speech, while Tagomi and Wegener make a last-ditch attempt to complete their mission.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E06 - Three Monkeys
1.plot: Joe celebrates VA day at Smith's house. Juliana accepts a job working for Tagomi as she continues her search for answers. Smith invites an old friend to join the celebrations with surprising results.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E07 - Truth
1.plot: Juliana makes a startling discovery about her sister's death. Frank reflects on recent events and makes an important decision about his future, and Tagomi gains greater insight into Juliana's past.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E08 - End of the World
1.plot: Juliana and Frank make plans to escape the Pacific States, only to be dragged back into danger by Joe as he tries to retrieve a new film. Meanwhile, Smith's loyalty is put to the ultimate test when confronted with a startling family discovery.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E09 - Kindness
1.plot: With time running out, a desperate Frank is forced to put his life on the line to help Joe. The pieces finally fall into place for Smith as he uncovers who was behind the assassination attempt. Tagomi is devastated when he's confronted with the consequences of his scheming, and Kido's investigation takes a dramatic turn when he makes an important discovery.

1.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S01E10 - A Way Out
1.plot: As revelations abound, Juliana is forced to make the hardest decision of her life. Wegener returns to Germany to carry out his mission. Smith risks becoming the prey as he goes hunting with his assassin, and Kido desperately tries to close his investigation before his time runs out.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E01 - The Tiger's Cave
2.plot: When Julianna allows Joe to flee from the hands of the Resistance, she is questioned on her loyalty, Obergruppenführer John Smith returns with news on the event that almost led to his death and Trade Minister Tagomi is overwhelmed by the vision of life if the Nazis had failed to win World War 2.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E02 - The Road Less Traveled
2.plot: After narrowly escaping death, Juliana discovers a family secret that could have global implications - and leads her to make a life-changing decision. Kido, Tagomi, and Frank all take dangerous risks, while back in New York, Joe settles into a normal routine, only to have it turned upside down when Smith gives him the opportunity he's waited for his whole life.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E03 - Travelers
2.plot: Fighting to acclimatize to the strange new world of Nazi New York, Juliana seeks out the one person she thinks she can trust: Joe Blake. Angry and defiant after Juliana's departure, Frank is drawn to the Resistance movement and its charismatic leader. Joe confronts his own identity when he finally meets his father.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E04 - Escalation
2.plot: Juliana discovers she's far from safe from the Resistance in the Reich. Smith confronts the reality of the lengths he's willing to go to in order to protect his son. And another father - Joe's - tries to persuade him to give Berlin a chance. Frank also has a decision to make: how far is he prepared to go to help the Resistance cause?

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E05 - Duck and Cover
2.plot: Joe learns a truth about his past that makes him question everything. The rift between Frank and Ed widens as Frank is drawn further into the Resistance. In order to assure her safety, Juliana must betray someone close to her.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E06 - Kintsugi
2.plot: Nicole introduces Joe to an unexpected side of Berlin, that leads him down a new path. On her new mission, Juliana inserts herself into the Smith's inner circle. Tagomi is finally reunited with his family, only to be faced with the prospect of losing them again.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E07 - Land O' Smiles
2.plot: As Juliana worms closer to the Smiths, she discovers a dangerous secret. Childan and Ed get themselves in a sticky situation as they try to settle the Yakuza debt. On a Resistance mission, Frank uncovers a Japanese plan that could realize his worst nightmare.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E08 - Loose Lips
2.plot: Juliana gathers intel for the Resistance that could trigger WWIII. When the political situation in Berlin becomes unsafe, Joe must make a choice that could put his life in danger. Frank learns the truth about Juliana, leading him to question his newfound Resistance family.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E09 - Detonation
2.plot: Tagomi faces a dilemma: to stay with his family or return to the world he left behind. Desperate to escape the Reich, Juliana strikes a final, dangerous deal with the Resistance. When Ed reveals a secret that puts the Resistance plan in jeopardy, Frank must decide how to deal with his best friend's betrayal.

2.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S02E10 - Fallout
2.plot: Tagomi enlists Kido in a deception to save Japan from destruction. As Smith's life crumbles around him, he makes a dangerously bold play to hold onto his power. Joe tries to do the right thing but suffers the ultimate betrayal. Juliana must make a heart-wrenching choice that will shape the future of the world.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E01 - Now More Than Ever, We Care About You
3.plot: Juliana Crain makes a new acquaintance in the Neutral Zone - an Irish fixer named Wyatt - and soon finds herself on the run and seeking Tagomi's aid. The Japanese test an atomic bomb. Joe Blake is sent on a diplomatic mission to San Francisco. Kido hires a new sergeant. Nicole Dormer arrives in New York to head a new propaganda campaign. The Smiths struggle with the aftermath of Thomas' death.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E02 - Imagine Manchuria
3.plot: Juliana recognizes that her and Tagomi's fates are intertwined. Tagomi and Admiral Inokuchi realize the Reich is imposing a covert oil embargo on the Pacific States. Reichsmarschall Rockwell and J. Edgar Hoover plot against John Smith. Helen starts therapy to cope with her grief over Thomas, and takes drastic action to protect her family. Kido and Tagomi clash over Juliana.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E03 - Sensô Kôi
3.plot: Juliana and Tagomi pursue the mysteries of the films and Juliana reunites with an old friend. Childan is anxious to return to San Francisco now that the reprisals have stopped, but a potential new romance makes Ed reluctant to leave. Kido receives intelligence that sets him on a new path. Smith finds himself celebrated by Nazi high society at a screening of Nicole's new film about Thomas.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E04 - Sabra
3.plot: A new community fights for survival in the Neutral Zone. Juliana and Joe get reacquainted, while Joe continues his undercover work for Himmler. Wyatt drops in on Juliana in San Francisco. Smith's past rises up to haunt him. Ed and Childan face a challenge on their way home to San Francisco. As tensions between the Reich and the Empire rise, Tagomi finds his life may be in danger.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E05 - The New Colossus
3.plot: As the Reichsführer continues to provoke the Japanese Pacific States, Juliana barely escapes a deadly situation and discovers a trove of Nazi secrets. John Smith tangles with his political adversary. The Nazis prepare for "Year Zero." Joe and Juliana come to a turning point in their relationship.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E06 - History Ends
3.plot: With Wyatt's aid, Juliana flees San Francisco with the stolen Nazi secrets. Childan can finally return home; Ed decides to stay in the Neutral Zone. Tagomi makes revelations to Kido that change Kido's perspective. John Smith's career takes a turn.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E07 - Excess Animus
3.plot: Juliana embarks on a mission to stop the Nazis - a mission that reunites her with old friends. Thelma and Nicole grow closer, despite the risks. Smith learns more about the Nazis' efforts into alt-world travel. Kido demands Tagomi come clean about the films and his ability to travel. Kido coaxes crucial intelligence from Childan.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E08 - Kasumi (Through the Mists)
3.plot: Juliana realizes time might be running out, but recruiting supporters continues to prove challenging. Tagomi finds himself in a dangerous life-or-death struggle. In therapy, Helen Smith crosses a line. Kido pursues his target in the Neutral Zone.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E09 - Baku
3.plot: Juliana and Wyatt's mission takes them farther east and dangerously close to the center of a top-secret Nazi project. Trying to improve relations between their sides, Tagomi reaches out to Smith. Smith makes a crucial discovery. Kido finds closure.

3.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S03E10 - Jahr Null
3.plot: Juliana's attempt to stop the Nazis lands her in a precarious position. Himmler and John Smith lead a lavish celebration of Year Zero. Amid a series of successes, Smith faces a setback. Kido returns to San Francisco with a prize, performs an act of kindness for a friend. Tagomi makes a difficult decision. Ed returns to San Francisco and reconnects with Childan.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E01 - Hexagram 64
4.plot: Juliana Crain finds herself in a new world. In the wake of an attack on Trade Minister Tagomi, Chief Inspector Kido begins a crackdown against the suspected culprits: the Black Communist Rebellion. John Smith leads a military incursion into the Neutral Zone to capture Wyatt Price and his rebel army. Helen Smith’s new independence is tested as John comes to claim his daughters.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E02 - Every Door Out...
4.plot: John Smith receives key intelligence from his officers at the Die Nebenwelt complex, while back at home he struggles with the changing dynamics of his family. Bell Mallory and the BCR join forces with Wyatt Price’s rebels. Kido tries to bond with his estranged son, Toru. Childan makes a connection with his Japanese assistant. Juliana discovers an enemy in one world can be a friend in another.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E03 - The Box
4.plot: Wyatt’s rebels and the BCR join forces to attack Tokyo’s elite at Robert Childan’s auction. Helen comes back to the Reich to protect her children. Kido receives an unexpected call from the Yakuza. Smith sends an assassin to kill Juliana.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E04 - Happy Trails
4.plot: John and Helen host Himmler and his wife for dinner, along with a new and dangerous threat from Berlin, Obergruppenführer Goertzmann. Juliana returns to the High Castle world, arriving in the ruins of what is now known as “The District of Contamination.” Kido is forced to turn against the Crown Princess by his general. A captive Hawthorne Abendsen shares some new tales from the High Castle.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E05 - Mauvaise Foi
4.plot: John Smith is forced to confront the choices he’s made. The Empire attempts secret peace talks with the BCR. Kido arrests a traitor, threatening to divide the Japanese against themselves. Helen is assigned a new security minder. Juliana reunites with Wyatt to plan the fall of the American Reich.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E06 - All Serious Daring
4.plot: John Smith discovers that one can get lost on the path not taken. Juliana attempts to decode hidden messages from Abendsen. Amid voices of dissent, Bell devises a new strategy for the BCR. Kido must decide where his true loyalties lie, even if it costs him the Empire.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E07 - No Masters But Ourselves
4.plot: The BCR launches a massive assault across the JPS, and Kido finds the fate of the Empire in his hands. Childan becomes a captive of the Kempeitai. Helen resolves to support her husband by re-entering public life. Juliana and Wyatt arrive in New York to plan a daring new strategy against Smith.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E08 - Hitler Has Only Got One Ball
4.plot: Juliana’s instincts about Helen are put to the ultimate test. As San Francisco evacuates, Kido goes in search of his son, only to find himself a captive. A letter arrives, forever changing Childan and Yukiko’s lives. The BCR receives an unexpected offer of help from the Yakuza. Abendsen condemns Smith with his final prediction.

4.title: FR - The Man in the High Castle - S04E09 - For Want of a Nail
4.plot: Smith and Helen’s true loyalties are placed on trial by an old nemesis. The BCR struggles to maintain order across the JPS. Kido is forced to confront his atrocities. Bands of roving vigilantes threaten Childan and Yukiko.

meta.plot: Idriss Toma, 46 ans, l’avocat parisien des riches et des puissants, voit sa vie basculer lorsqu’il est victime d’une tentative de meurtre. Il en réchappe miraculeusement, mais un éclat de balle inopérable peut désormais lui être fatal à tout moment. Décidé à corriger ses erreurs personnelles et professionnelles, il revient à Lille, sa ville natale, et s’associe avec Nadia Ayad, une avocate engagée, et Jeanne Vanhoven, ex-gloire du barreau. Ensemble, ils mettent leur audace et leur talent au service de ceux que la machine judiciaire menace d’écraser…

1.title: FR - Le Code - S01E01 - Profession of Faith
1.plot: Idriss Toma and Claire Caldeira represent Estelle Lantez, accused of murdering her violent partner. The client claims to have acted in self-defense, but the lawyers quickly understand that the reality is quite different. Nadia Ayad, for her part, defends Mr. Garcia, a compulsive kleptomaniac who steals shoes on a regular basis. At the same time, Idriss tries to reconnect with his daughter Chloé, on her 20th birthday...

1.title: FR - Le Code - S01E02 - Presumed Guilty
1.plot: Nadia and Maxime Laffargue defend Jeremy Dutertre, a young man with a lengthy criminal record accused of shooting a grocer during a robbery. Jeremy, who has made great efforts to get out of delinquency and proclaims his innocence, has a hard time controlling himself against a particularly devious opponent: Attorney General Jacques Kowalski...

1.title: FR - Le Code - S01E03 - Word against word
1.plot: Idriss and Claire defend one of his friends: Olivier Walter, the owner of a hotel, accused of raping one of his employees. The case becomes seriously complicated when the complainant turns out to be not the only one to blame the client. At the same time, Nadia sees an old fling resurface in her life when a man asks for her help in a case of flagrante delicto led by customs...

1.title: FR - Le Code - S01E04 - Gears
1.plot: Court-appointed to Jessica Guilaume, a woman accused of drug trafficking, Maxime finds Jacques Kowalski on his path. Determined to show Nadia that he is up to the task, he decides to confront the Attorney General alone… at his client's risk.

1.title: FR - Le Code - S01E05 - The Moment of Truth
1.plot: Jeanne Vanhoven makes her big comeback to the assizes: she defends, with Maxime, David Kerval, a novelist suffering from obsessive compulsive disorder, accused of the murder of his wife. At the same time, Claire assists Jacqueline Arsena, mother of a young woman killed by Xavier Durieux, a drug addict who has just filed a request for early release. Idriss, for his part, learns that his health has deteriorated considerably...

1.title: FR - Le Code - S01E06 - Pretium Doloris
1.plot: While Idriss and Nadia travel to Paris for the trial of Carl Roussel (Stéphane Blancafort), the man who shot Idriss, Claire finds herself in the eye of the storm: Jacqueline Arsena has committed a murder and had warned her of her intentions.

2.title: FR - Le Code - S02E01 - Till Death Do Us Part
2.plot: Idriss' secret is now revealed and the entire firm knows that he only has a few months to live. Determined to leave Ayad, Toma and Vanhoven, Nadia defends with Claire M. Perez accused of having killed his wife, who suffers from Alzheimer's disease. A gesture of love or premeditated femicide? For his part, Idriss is offered a strange deal to exonerate Chloé.

2.title: FR - Le Code - S02E02 - Legitimate violence
2.plot: Idriss defends Mr. Duval, accused of killing the man who tried to rob him. Self-defense seems to prevail, but the facts and the judge's investigations undermine the client's version. Nadia comes to the aid of Alice, his teacher partner, suspected of hitting a student in her class. Does the truth always come out of the mouths of children?

2.title: FR - Le Code - S02E03 - A Perfect Culprit
2.plot: Believing she's defending a wealthy client, Jeanne forces Claire to be present at a murder trial... except that the accused is homeless, a very disturbing reflection of our potential downfall. Nadia tries to assist a drug addict client who is now pregnant. But how far can you go to help someone against their will?

2.title: FR - Le Code - S02E04 - Skids
2.plot: Nadia and Maxime defend a police officer accused of causing the death of a young man in police custody. Claire sees an unexpected client arrive at the office: her mother. Chloé meets a friend who was there the night of her accident… and whose testimony could change the entire course of her future trial...

2.title: FR - Le Code - S02E05 - In Charge
2.plot: Jeanne and Maxime defend a doctor accused of murder on appeal. Facing them: a real police bigwig, against whom Jeanne has a tenacious grudge. Elodie is attacked in the street. Suspect No. 1 is none other than a client of... Nadia.

2.title: FR - Le Code - S02E06 - Irresponsible
2.plot: While Nadia comes to the aid of an incarcerated client who wants to attend the funeral of his aunt who raised him at all costs, Idriss's state of health becomes very worrying. However, and against the advice of his loved ones, the lawyer wants to honor his promise to defend a young schizophrenic accused of killing his neighbor. Between the lawyer and his client, who is the most irresponsible?

meta.plot: The birth of a music label and three characters fighting for their dreams inside the complex inside the music industry.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Futura
1.plot: Music producer Guillermo Rojas discovers talented rock singer Robert, and teams up with his assistant Maribel to launch a new sub-label, Futura.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The License
1.plot: Robert auditions for a license to perform professionally, but Guillermo's past interferes. Maribel learns her new friend's devastating secret.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Single
1.plot: When Guillermo struggles to find a studio to record Robert's new single, Maribel comes to the rescue with an unorthodox idea. Ignacio makes a decision.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Campaign
1.plot: Maribel and Robert start to feel a deeper connection just as the singer's career begins to take off. Guillermo's past mistakes catch up with him.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Album
1.plot: A slew of challenges vex the team as they try to record Robert's new album, and Maribel is faced with both sexism at work and lies at home.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Concert
1.plot: Maribel runs point as Robert prepares for his important concert at the Price, but an unexpected lawsuit involving Ignacio puts all of Golden in peril.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Movie
1.plot: Sparks fly when Robert is cast in a movie opposite a famous actress. Maribel anxiously awaits medical results. Zabala worries about Golden's future.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Tour
1.plot: Before Robert and his band tour Spain, Vidal tells the singer to fake a relationship with Fanny. Guillermo helps Zabala with his fleeing artists.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Premiere
1.plot: Vidal instructs Robert and Fanny to keep lying about being in love to promote their film, but the press catches wind of Robert's romance with Maribel.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Debut
1.plot: Ignacio is arrested with no hope of release, unless Robert performs at a military party. Maribel hires an assistant. Guillermo spends time with his son.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Offer
1.plot: A tragic death leaves Golden's future uncertain, so Guillermo and Zabala scramble to raise money to save it. Robert is offered a record deal in London.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Competition
1.plot: Robert feels cornered when the government requests he enter a singing competition to represent Franco's regime. Ángeles and Guillermo reminisce.

1.title: EN - 45 RPM [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Last Song
1.plot: After the news of Robert's illness breaks, Guillermo and Maribel organize a farewell concert in his honor. Meanwhile, Robert plans his own surprise.

meta.plot: In a town in Chile, a woman leads a frantic search to find her missing sister amid a media storm and the police investigation. Inspired by a true case.

1.title: EN - 42 Days of Darkness [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - These Things Don't Happen Here
1.plot: After a woman disappears from her home, her husband alerts the police, a lawyer gets interested in the case, and her sister leads a search in the area.

1.title: EN - 42 Days of Darkness [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - If You Vanished, What Would They Say About You?
1.plot: The police receive an anonymous letter. Pizarro carries out his own investigation with the help of two associates and offers his services to the family.

1.title: EN - 42 Days of Darkness [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - The House Across the Street
1.plot: The media descend upon the Montes family's home. Mario draws suspicion when inconsistencies between his declaration and Verónica's call log are found.

1.title: EN - 42 Days of Darkness [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Day 42
1.plot: Mario points out Cecilia and her husband as suspects. Braulio and Nora lose hope in the investigation. A discovery unearths the authorities' negligence.

1.title: EN - 42 Days of Darkness [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - I Don't Believe What They Say
1.plot: After sharing the forensic report's conclusion with Cecilia, Pizarro and his team deepen their research. Years later, a new lead reopens the case.

1.title: EN - 42 Days of Darkness [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Still In the Dark
1.plot: A confession reignites the family's hope to get justice, but the lack of evidence threatens to hurt the case. Kari asks her dad a painful question.

meta.plot: Archival video and new interviews examine Mexican politics in 1994, a year marked by the rise of the EZLN and the assassination of Luis Donaldo Colosio.

1.title: ES - 1994 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Successor
1.plot: Mexican Political ex-President Carlos Salinas, detail Luis Donaldo Colosio's rise to become the PRI presidential candidate in 1993

1.title: ES - 1994 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Revolution
1.plot: The Zapatista uprising in early 1994 brings peacemaker Camacho sudden fame

1.title: ES - 1994 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Snake
1.plot: Witnesses recount the chaos that ensued when Colosio was assisted

1.title: ES - 1994 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Eagle Knight
1.plot: Zedillio announces his presidential candidacy

1.title: ES - 1994 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Round Earth
1.plot: Insiders recall the post-election economic crisis

meta.plot: Driven to claim top culinary honors, an arrogant heir meets a low-profile but stubborn chef whose recipes astonish him — sparking an unlikely romance.

1.title: KO - Tastefully Yours [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - A Taste of Familiarity
1.plot: On a quest to earn a three-star review, Han Beom-woo traces a copycat of his dish to a humble restaurant — where he clashes with its owner, Mo Yeon-joo.

1.title: KO - Tastefully Yours [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Stubbornness of Jungjae

FR - LIGHT & MAGIC - S01E01 - "Gang of outsiders."
1.plot: The year is 1975, and George Lucas has a problem. There is no visual effects company in Hollywood capable of realizing the massive vision behind his new film “The Star Wars”. George and camera expert John Dykstra assemble an unlikely team of artists and dreamers for the job, but despite their best efforts and some remarkable new technology, the ILM team falls woefully behind.

1.title: FR - LIGHT & MAGIC - S01E02 - "On the bucking bronco."
1.plot: When a near fatal wreck thwarts his boyhood dream of racing cars, George Lucas finds success as a filmmaker. He spends his own money on the special effects of an ambitious new “space opera”, but progress is painfully slow. With the help of key new hires, ILM rallies to finish the film on time. Star Wars premieres to worldwide success, yet George remains curiously unsatisfied with the results.

1.title: FR - LIGHT & MAGIC - S01E03 - "Just think about it."
1.plot: After Star Wars, ILM moves north to a new facility—but not everyone is invited. As work begins on The Empire Strikes Back, the team faces unprecedented new challenges. Frustrated by the available tools, George creates a new division to help modernize filmmaking. Upon the release of Empire, ILM takes on outside work for the first time, setting the stage for a remarkable string of success.

1.title: FR - LIGHT & MAGIC - S01E04 - "I think I found my people."
1.plot: A new partnership with Steven Spielberg results in the memorable effects of Raiders of the Lost Ark, E.T., and more. Meanwhile, the computer graphics group scores its first digital breakthrough. As the 80s blockbuster era rolls in, ILM crews are competing against each other, for both resources and awards. When George makes a fateful business decision, ILM is forced to rebuild on the fly.

1.title: FR - LIGHT & MAGIC - S01E05 - "Morfing."
1.plot: ILM enters the digital era as its revamped computer division faces its first big test with Willow. With a new team of rebels arriving at the company eager to push CG to its limits, James Cameron gives them a chance with The Abyss and Terminator 2. But the transition to digital is not without its casualties, as some struggle to adapt. Then Steven Spielberg returns with his greatest challenge yet.

1.title: FR - LIGHT & MAGIC - S01E06 - "No more pretending you're dinosaurs."
1.plot: Stop-motion genius Phil Tippett feels like he’s gone extinct when CG unexpectedly takes center stage in Jurassic Park. The watershed moment convinces George Lucas to return to his long-planned Star Wars prequel trilogy and push the technology even further. As digital filmmaking continues to grow and evolve, The Volume proves that the spirit of innovation remains alive and well at ILM.

meta.plot:
Une occasion unique de découvrir l'histoire quasi inconnue de la société Industrial Light & Magic (ILM) – une division de Lucasfilm – qui a révolutionné depuis sa création l’univers des effets spéciaux, de l'animation et la production numérique.

Lorsque George Lucas se lance dans l’aventure Star Wars, il est loin de se douter qu’il va révolutionner le cinéma. Cette série retrace l’évolution d’Industrial Light & Magic, la société derrière les effets spéciaux de Star Wars, E.T., Terminator 2, Jurassic Park... Découvrez les génies créatifs qui ont su mettre de la magie dans certains des plus grands films de notre époque.
