1.plot: Sage’s troubles start trending, and Dondre discovers Janelle’s been keeping a secret from him.

1.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S01E06 - Duets
1.plot: Odalie finds out why Davis has been skipping class, King’s loyalties are torn, and Tal finally makes a move on his crush.

1.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S01E07 - Dance Craze
1.plot: Tensions flare at Dondre and Janelle’s over-the-top party, while Johnny forces Tal to face the truth about who he is.

1.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S01E08 - Ensemble
1.plot: Poppy and Janelle open up to one another, as Rigo and Dondre grapple with the events of the party.

1.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S01E09 - Choreography
1.plot: Rigo goes viral and King makes a big reveal to Poppy.

1.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S01E10 - Two-Step
1.plot: Sage Odom’s tour auditions are underway, Uncle Al tries to save the twins, and Collette and East-O’s turbulent past comes to a head.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E01 - Precision
2.plot: With Sage’s tour opening in barely two months, Tal, Dondre, Poppy, and Odalie realize just how hard they’ll have to push themselves if they want to truly become a professional dance squad. East-O’s sudden death leaves Rigo with questions and a challenge to his father’s throne in the form of his prodigal Uncle Matty, while Sage surprises Collette by bringing in a frenemy from her past to run point on the tour.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E02 - Splits
2.plot: The budding rivalry between Tal and Zo comes to a head at Dondre’s Lit Luau. Odalie brings Davis to the suburbs to meet her parents. Rigo gets an offer from Uncle Matty that puts his relationship with Marquise in jeopardy.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E03 - Form
2.plot: Nine and King develop plans to take Rigo’s music to the next level while Rigo’s ties to the streets continue to put a strain on his music and his relationship with Poppy. Meanwhile, Odalie and Davis hit hard times and tension between Tal and Zo grows as Sage heats things up in preparation for the tour.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E04 - Vogue
2.plot: When the tour dancers are unable to let loose during an erotic dance routine, Sage demands that they go on a journey to find their sexy. Things start to get hot and heavy with Dondre and Poppy. Sage and Rigo go head-to-head.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E05 - Inversion
2.plot: As Nine pushes Sage to tone down his ambitions, Collette takes him on a trip down memory lane to rediscover his artistic roots. Odalie struggles to find balance in both her love life and her dance. Zo takes Tal out for the night of his life... with unforeseen consequences.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E06 - Isolations
2.plot: Tal learns a devastating family secret. Sage and the tour dancers build a risky new concept from the ground up. Nine helps Rigo deal with his feelings about Poppy through music, just as Poppy and Dondre confront their feelings for each other.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E07 - Attitude
2.plot: Odalie, with the help of Davis, attempts to work through a debilitating injury and preserve her spot on tour as Tal tries to assuage himself of his guilt and earn Odalie's forgiveness. As Rigo's star rises, he struggles to keep the peace amongst his friends and decipher who to trust. Meanwhile, Dondre finally meets the real Sage Odom.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E08 - Azonto
2.plot: With Rigo's song about her going viral, Poppy is left with no choice but to respond. Collette takes full control of the tour while Sage is away. Davis helps Uncle Al outside of work.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E09 - Improvisation
2.plot: With the tour just four days away, the dancers make final preparations for their big opening night. Poppy’s mom visits High Water for the first time. Tal learns some shocking news from Zo. Rigo gets some help with his dance routine from an unlikely source. Odalie takes a last desperate step. Sage and Collette make a series of stunning final moves to assure the tour’s success.

2.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S02E10 - Hip-Hopera
2.plot: The tour begins! Sage and the dancers take the stage on opening night in Atlanta. Dondre learns a secret that changes everything between him and Poppy. Rigo learns the truth about the death of his father. Odalie has her moment to shine. Uncle Al has a huge surprise for Davis and Justin. Sage has a dramatic proposal for Collette. A shocking return from his past astonishes Tal.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E01 - Kryptonite
3.plot: Accused of murdering his former friend East-O, Sage Odom is poised to lose everything in his empire. His partner and now fiancé Collette Jones is by his side supporting him; but Collette is hiding a deep secret.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E02 - Ain't Gon' Let Up
3.plot: A troubled Rigo must choose between abandoning the lucrative tour or headline the tour to help rescue the man who possibly murdered his father. With his friend Poppy by his side, he turns the tables on Sage and Collette.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E03 - Player's Ball
3.plot: Prohibited from performing at the BMT Awards, Sage reluctantly agrees to let Rigo perform in his slot. At the live awards performance, Rigo has a surprise for everyone that changes the direction of the entire tour.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E04 - Cell Therapy
3.plot: Sage's actions the night of the BMT Awards have landed him back in jail. Marquise's meddling is upsetting everyone. At the Tabernacle, Rigo thrills the audience, but is confronted by haters.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E05 - Never Scared
3.plot: At Sage's evidentiary hearings, the D.A.'s strategy is working and Sage could be tried for murder. Meanwhile, things heat up between Marquise and Angel, but their fragile relationship is headed for trouble.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E06 - You Know What It Is
3.plot: Sage is freed from jail and ready to reclaim the tour as headliner. The Chicago show will be Rigo's final performance and he's under pressure to come up with new material. Poppy and Collette butt heads over Rigo.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E07 - It’s Goi'’ Down
3.plot: Romantic entanglements are tearing Sage, Collette, Rigo, and Poppy in new directions. The love triangle between Davis, Odalie and Angel has come to a tipping point. Tal has a new position as Sage's Creative Director.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E08 - Who Can I Run To?
3.plot: Things are increasingly hot and cold between Angel and Odalie – someone's keeping secrets. Collette hatches a plan to keep Rigo on the tour. Sage has an epiphany and pledges a new direction for his creative future.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E09 - Bring 'Em Out
3.plot: Sage Odom revises his stadium tour into a grassroots movement with a purpose. Things heat up between Rigo and Collette, but lies and doubts are constantly present. Odalie tries to keep Angel's affections.

3.title: FR - Step Up: High Water - S03E10 - Sleep When U Die
3.plot: It's a battle for control over High Water and dreams of power, fame and fortune. Many secrets are revealed including the real murderer of East-O and the true identity of Saint Clip.

meta.plot: Retour sur la genèse du film oscarisé Le Parrain de Francis Ford Coppola, racontée du point de vue du producteur de films Al Ruddy.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E01 - A Seat at the Table
1.plot: After ditching his job at the Rand Corporation for a shot in Hollywood, Al Ruddy wins the job to produce Mario Puzo’s bestselling novel, “The Godfather” for Paramount Pictures. Joe Colombo, a rising crime boss in the New York City Mafia, has a darker fate in mind for the picture.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E02 - Warning Shots
1.plot: With Francis Ford Coppola and Mario Puzo penning the script, Al Ruddy and Bettye McCartt confront an ever-growing list of opposition to “The Godfather” including Frank Sinatra, LA Gangster Mickey Cohen, and the Colombo led Italian-American Civil Rights League. Meanwhile, Robert Evans and Gulf & Western’s Barry Lapidus lock horns over the creative direction of Paramount Pictures.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E03 - Fade In
1.plot: Pressure mounts for the scripts’ delivery after Ruddy is forced to sit down with Joe Colombo and Evans finds himself navigating hot waters with Gulf & Western’s CEO Charlie Bluhdorn. Meanwhile, Bluhdorn takes an interest in Bettye.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E04 - The Right Shade of Yellow
1.plot: With Marlon Brando and Al Pacino in contention for leading roles in “The Godfather,” Ruddy is caught in the line of fire between Evans and Coppola and must pick a side. After gaining Joe Colombo’s support, Ruddy gets an uncomfortable glimpse of his new friend’s loyalty. The rising stakes surrounding “The Godfather” continues to strain Ruddy’s relationship with Francoise.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E05 - Kiss the Ring
1.plot: Ruddy and Bettye combat logistical nightmares with principal photography quickly approaching. As the Mob continues to ingrain itself in the making of the film, tensions rise between Colombo and notorious hot head Crazy Joe Gallo.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E06 - A Stand Up Guy
1.plot: Ruddy deals with the fallout from the disastrous press conference while Evans creates a plan to save Paramount. Bettye takes action as the first day of filming is compromised due to collisions with Gulf & Western, Paramount, and the Mafia.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E07 - Mr. Producer
1.plot: Dissatisfied with the footage, Barry Lapidus orchestrates a potential coup as Ruddy initiates a bold plan to save both Coppola's and Pacino’s jobs. Crime boss Carlo Gambino questions Colombo’s leadership as he holds another large Italian-American Civil Rights League rally.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E08 - Crossing the Line
1.plot: In the bloody aftermath of the Italian-American Civil Rights League rally, Gallo threatens “The Godfather’s” production budget as Ruddy struggles to protect the funding for Sicily. Evans continues to spiral after the breakup of his marriage with Ali MacGraw, allowing Barry Lapidus to capitalize.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E09 - It’s Who We Are
1.plot: As the production contends with the challenges of filming in Sicily, Ruddy leaves early to help get Evans back on track. Post-production disputes with Lapidus threaten Coppola’s vision for the edit and Bettye starts to think about her next move.

1.title: FR - The Offer - S01E10 - Brains and Balls
1.plot: “The Godfather” is released to rave reviews and box office records. Drama unfolds at the 45th Academy Awards.

meta.plot: En décembre 1776, Benjamin Franklin est mondialement connu pour ses expériences sur l'électricité. Mais sa passion et son influence sont mises à rude épreuve lorsqu'il embarque pour une mission secrète en France tandis que le sort de l'indépendance des États-Unis est en jeu.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E01 - Sauce for Prayers
1.plot: As the fight for independence teeters on the brink of defeat, Benjamin Franklin and his grandson plunge into a world of intrigue and deception.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E02 - Welcome, Mischief
1.plot: An arms operation is threatened by a ruthless opponent. The Paris police watch Franklin's every move. Temple makes a confession.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E03 - Pride and Gout
1.plot: Bad news arrives from America. Franklin finds himself ensnared in the traps of Versailles. Temple bows down before a star.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E04 - Small Revenge
1.plot: Franklin pays back an insult—and receives the favor of a king. A new lover catches his eye, and an old rival turns up to thwart him.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E05 - The Natural State of Man
1.plot: Tensions mount between Franklin and Adams. Madame Brillon asserts her power. Temple decides to fight his own war.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E06 - Beauty and Folly
1.plot: Franklin suspects traitors are everywhere. Vergennes makes a final offer. Jacques introduces Temple to the thrill of the hunt.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E07 - Begin by Creeping
1.plot: After victory at Yorktown, the Americans and the French plot against each other for the upper hand. Franklin is laid low at a crucial moment.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2024) - S01E08 - Think of Three Things
1.plot: The future of the United States is decided by six men in a room. Franklin and Temple face a changed world.

meta.plot: Un artiste de la contrefaçon, également père célibataire, est contraint de travailler avec son ex-amante pour fabriquer le parfait billet de 100 dollars - tout cela pour sauver sa fille mourante.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2025) - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: With his father’s medical bills mounting, the pressure is on Adam to perfect his product. While Yulia’s seemingly smooth heist catches up with her.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2025) - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Despite wanting to fly under the radar, Adam is advised to take on business with notorious crime lord, Al-Hashem — who has his own methods of persuasion.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2025) - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: When Yulia unexpectedly steps in to help, Adam isn’t willing to let the past go. Mounir's rage-filled attempt to get a handle on the situation goes awry.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2025) - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Mounir attempts to make amends with Zein while detained, but his fate is sealed when a rescue heist — led by Yulia — doesn’t go according to plan.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2025) - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Under the pressure of Yara’s illness, and his strained relationship with Yulia, Adam must work with the only person who can help him now… his brother.

1.title: FR - Franklin (2025) - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A turn of events and surprising betrayals turn the exchange on its head, allowing the truth to finally come to light. But is it too late?

meta.plot: Dans une école privée où les jeux d'argent décident du statut social des lycéens, une nouvelle élève douée au passé mystérieux change la donne… et mise sur la vengeance.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E01 - Game On
1.plot: After arriving at St. Dominic's Prep, new student Yumeko scopes out the rules, sizes up the competition and sets her sights on climbing the leaderboard.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E02 - Icebreaker
1.plot: Suki turns up the heat and challenges Yumeko to a chilling game designed to expose a player's darkest secrets. Mary adjusts to life as a house pet.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E03 - First Blood
1.plot: Tragic news has the school buzzing with gossip — and off-the-books side bets. Yumeko dances with danger. Kira fights to keep the upper hand.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E04 - The Recital
1.plot: Someone makes a spicy wager on Ryan's birthday: Will he lose his virginity by midnight? Meanwhile, Yumeko sets a deadly trap — and Riri hunts for a rat.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E05 - House Wars
1.plot: Diamonds. Clubs. Hearts. Spades. A ruthless game of capture the flag between houses finds Michael and Yumeko on opposite sides.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E06 - The Bet Gala
1.plot: It's a night of surprises — and shocking reveals — at a stylish school dance for kings and queens where only one royal can reign supreme.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E07 - The Hunt
1.plot: A desperate Yumeko risks it all to compete in an openly hostile House Pet Hunt. Elsewhere, armed with a map, Michael embarks on a mission.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E08 - The Speakeasy
1.plot: With time running out to make the Top Ten before the end of term, Yumeko unlocks a St. Dominic's secret that could change the rules of the game.

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E09 - Meet the Parents
1.plot: At the school board retreat, revenge is so close that Yumeko can almost taste it. Can Ryan and Michael stop her from making a fatal mistake?

1.title: FR - Bet - S01E10 - Winner Takes All
1.plot: Every second counts as Kira and Yumeko take on their toughest opponents to date: each other. As for the stakes? They've never been deadlier.

meta.plot: La série raconte la relation complice et même privilégiée de Lorelai avec sa fille Rory qu'elle eut à 16 ans. Entre leurs histoires d'amour respectives et les relations avec les grands-parents de Rory ou les personnages secondaires rencontrés au travail de Lorelai ou au lycée d'élite de Rory dans la petite ville de Stars Hollow, Lorelai et Rory n'ont pas le temps de s'ennuyer.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When Rory is accepted to attend a prestigious prep school, Lorelai must swallow her pride and ask her wealthy parents for help paying the tuition.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E02 - The Lorelais' First Day at Chilton
1.plot: Rory's first day at Chilton doesn't go smoothly: First, Lorelai's attire offends Emily and the headmaster; then Rory meets some obnoxious classmates.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E03 - Kill Me Now
1.plot: When Rory and Richard bond during a day of golf at the club, Lorelai feels jealous of Rory's deepening connection with her grandparents.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E04 - The Deer Hunters
1.plot: After Rory receives a bad grade on her English paper, Lorelai helps her cram for a big Shakespeare exam – but catastrophe strikes on test day.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E05 - Cinnamon's Wake
1.plot: Lorelai admits she has feelings for someone. Meanwhile, Rory has a budding relationship of her own that is moving forward.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E06 - Rory's Birthday Parties
1.plot: Rory clashes with Emily when Emily plans a formal birthday party for her. Meanwhile, Lorelai organizes a casual get-together to celebrate.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E07 - Kiss and Tell
1.plot: Rory shares a romantic moment with Dean, but doesn't tell Lorelai. When Lorelai hears about it from Mrs. Kim, she invites Dean over for movie night.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E08 - Love and War and Snow
1.plot: Snow strands Rory at her grandparents' home, while Lorelai spends the day with her beau. Meanwhile, Lane misses Rory and comes to visit.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E09 - Rory's Dance
1.plot: Rory attends her first dance with Dean but they get home late, causing Emily and Lorelai to fight over Lorelai's mothering skills.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E10 - Forgiveness and Stuff
1.plot: Misfortune strikes at the Gilmores' Christmas party. Dean assures Lorelai that nothing improper happened the night he and Rory fell asleep together.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E11 - Paris is Burning
1.plot: After Paris causes a scandal by exposing the relationship between a parent and a teacher, she is confronted.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E12 - Double Date
1.plot: Lorelai goes on a hellish double date with Sookie, Jackson and Jackson's odd cousin. Meanwhile, Rory double dates with Dean, Lane and Dean's friend.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E13 - Concert Interruptus
1.plot: Trouble ensues when Rory takes her friends to a Bangles concert in New York. Lorelai learns something about Luke's romantic past.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E14 - That Damn Donna Reed
1.plot: Rory and Dean argue about women's roles after watching "The Donna Reed Show." Emily makes Lorelai face her feelings.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E15 - Christopher Returns
1.plot: Rory's father returns, causing tension in Emily and Richard's house – and forcing Lorelai to make a big decision about her family's future.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E16 - Star-Crossed Lovers and Other Strangers
1.plot: Rory and Dean celebrate their three-month anniversary, but things don't go as planned. Luke's ex-girlfriend Rachel arrives in town.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E17 - The Breakup, Part 2
1.plot: After recent events, Rory keeps busy, refusing to give in to self-pity. Meanwhile, Stars Hollow's residents rally around her, much to her dismay.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E18 - The Third Lorelai
1.plot: When Lorelai's grandmother offers a trust fund for Rory's education, Emily fears losing contact with a financially independent Lorelai and Rory.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E19 - Emily in Wonderland
1.plot: Emily is horrified when she sees the place where Lorelai and Rory first lived, so she sets out to create a perfect bedroom for Rory in her house.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E20 - P.S. I Lo...
1.plot: Still upset over recent events, Rory becomes angry with Lorelai, who didn't tell her that she is dating again.

1.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S01E21 - Love, Daisies and Troubadours
1.plot: Rory finally tells Dean the truth about how she feels about him. Sensing something between Lorelai and Luke, Rachel makes a decision.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E01 - Sadie, Sadie
2.plot: Lorelai makes a big decision, but when Emily hears about it from someone else, she's hurt and angry that Lorelai didn't bother to tell her.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E02 - Hammers and Veils
2.plot: Rory's sudden flurry of extracurricular activity strains her relationship with Dean. Emily is cold when Lorelai finally reveals her big news.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E03 - Red Light on the Wedding Night
2.plot: During a wild party, Lorelai impulsively calls someone, and their conversation gives her second thoughts about her plans.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E04 - The Road Trip to Harvard
2.plot: With her big plans canceled, Lorelai is eager to escape the reactions of everyone in Stars Hollow, so she and Rory take off on a road trip.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E05 - Nick & Nora/Sid & Nancy
2.plot: Lorelai tries to dissuade Luke from allowing his relative to live with him. Rory finds herself attracted to another boy.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E06 - Presenting Lorelai Gilmore
2.plot: Rory surprises everyone by agreeing to make her debut at a ball, and Lorelai finds herself attracted to a changed man.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E07 - Like Mother, Like Daughter
2.plot: Advised to become more social at Chilton, Rory winds up in the most popular school clique, while Lorelai helps with a fundraising fashion show.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E08 - The Ins and Outs of Inns
2.plot: Lorelai and Sookie have the first fight of their long friendship when Lorelai panics and decides their dream of opening an inn together will fail.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E09 - Run Away, Little Boy
2.plot: When Rory and her classmate Tristan are cast as Romeo and Juliet in a school play, a jealous Dean insists on attending every rehearsal.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E10 - The Bracebridge Dinner
2.plot: While Rory struggles to keep the budding rivalry between Dean and Jess under control, Lorelai invites most of Stars Hollow to an elaborate feast.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E11 - Secrets and Loans
2.plot: Lorelai can't afford to repair her home's extensive termite damage but becomes angry when Rory involves Emily, who again offers Lorelai a loan.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E12 - Richard in Stars Hollow
2.plot: Newly retired Richard is driving Emily crazy, so Lorelai agrees to take her father for a day in Stars Hollow, where he annoys both Lorelai and Rory.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E13 - A-Tisket, A-Tasket
2.plot: The annual Stars Hollow Picnic Basket Auction causes romantic complications when Jess outbids Dean to win a picnic lunch date with Rory.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E14 - It Should've Been Lorelai
2.plot: Christopher brings a visitor to Stars Hollow who wants to get to know Rory. Emily is furious that Lorelai isn't trying to win Christopher back.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E15 - Lost & Found
2.plot: Rory panics when she realizes she's lost the bracelet Dean made for her. When Lorelai spots someone in Rory's room, she makes accusations of theft.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E16 - There's the Rub
2.plot: Lorelai and Emily's weekend at a spa doesn't go as planned. Meanwhile, Rory's night alone becomes difficult when Paris, Jess and Dean arrive.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E17 - Dead Uncles & Vegetables
2.plot: Lorelai and Rory help out at the diner while Luke makes funeral arrangements. Emily goes overboard helping to plan a wedding.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E18 - Back in the Saddle Again
2.plot: After helping Rory with her project for Chilton's annual business fair, Richard realizes he's tired of retirement and wants to start a second career.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E19 - Teach Me Tonight
2.plot: As a favor to Luke, Rory tutors Jess, but during their first study session, Jess convinces Rory to go on a quick outing with him.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E20 - Help Wanted
2.plot: Lorelai helps Richard establish a consulting business. Rory becomes angry that everyone blames Jess for what happened to her.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E21 - Lorelai's Graduation Day
2.plot: Lorelai is about to graduate from business school, so Rory secretly invites guests to her graduation ceremony. Rory makes a trip to New York.

2.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S02E22 - I Can't Get Started
2.plot: On the day before the wedding, Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Meanwhile, Rory is thrilled when a familiar face returns to Stars Hollow.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E01 - Those Lazy-Hazy-Crazy Days
3.plot: Back from a summer internship in Washington, D.C., Rory finds herself torn between Dean and Jess. Meanwhile, Lorelai questions her future.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E02 - Haunted Leg
3.plot: Emily's attempts to reunite Christopher with Lorelai and Rory result in an ugly confrontation between Rory and Christopher.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E03 - Application Anxiety
3.plot: After a Harvard application arrives, Rory and Lorelai seek advice. Meanwhile, Lane places an ad and becomes enamored with a respondent.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E04 - One's Got Class and the Other One Dyes
3.plot: Things get ugly when Lorelai speaks at the high school's career day. To rebel against her conservative mother, Lane does something drastic.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E06 - Take the Deviled Eggs...
3.plot: When Lorelai winds up attending a social event with Rory, she learns more about Christopher's life than she wanted to know.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E07 - They Shoot Gilmores, Don't They?
3.plot: Lorelai forces Rory to be her partner at the Stars Hollow dance marathon, where Rory can't stop arguing with a boy – and another definitely notices.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E08 - Let the Games Begin
3.plot: Lorelai, Rory, Richard and Emily visit Richard's alma mater, but Richard causes trouble by secretly making some arrangements in advance.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E09 - A Deep-Fried Korean Thanksgiving
3.plot: Lorelai and Rory have four Thanksgivings when they stop for celebrations with Lane, Sookie and Luke on the way to dinner with Richard and Emily.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E10 - That'll Do, Pig
3.plot: Lorelai misses the town carnival when a visitor arrives. Rory's beau won't take her to the carnival – until he learns she might go with another boy.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E11 - I Solemnly Swear
3.plot: A classmate convinces Paris that Rory has been plotting against her. Meanwhile, Emily is sued by a former maid, and Lorelai meets an interesting man.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E12 - Lorelai Out of Water
3.plot: Lorelai gets an angling lesson from Luke before her fishing date with her new beau. Meanwhile, the political battle between Rory and Paris escalates.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E13 - Dear Emily and Richard
3.plot: When Sherry goes into labor and asks Rory to stay with her at the hospital, Lorelai reminisces about the day Rory was born.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E14 - Swan Song
3.plot: Lorelai goes away with her boyfriend for a weekend in New York, but she worries about leaving Rory and her boyfriend together.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E15 - Face-Off
3.plot: Tired of waiting for her boyfriend to call and make plans for the weekend, Rory goes to a hockey game with Lane, where she sees a familiar face.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E16 - The Big One
3.plot: Rory and Paris compete to give a speech at a school celebration. Meanwhile, Lorelai shares a passionate kiss with someone unexpected.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E17 - A Tale of Poes and Fire
3.plot: When a meeting of the Edgar Allan Poe Society at her inn is interrupted by a disaster, Lorelai must find rooms for the guests at homes around town.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E18 - Happy Birthday, Baby
3.plot: While Lorelai deals with the aftermath at the inn, Rory schemes to give her mom a special birthday party, complete with a gigantic surprise.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E19 - Keg! Max!
3.plot: Rory makes plans to attend the prom. Lane's rock band debuts at a big party, where longstanding animosities finally explode.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E20 - Say Goodnight, Gracie
3.plot: After the brawl at her band's debut, Lane is in trouble with her mother. Later, Jess receives a visitor at the diner.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E21 - Here Comes the Son
3.plot: Jess travels across the country for a visit. Rory helps Emily choose an outfit for Rory's graduation, resulting in a conflict with Lorelai.

3.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S03E22 - Those Are Strings, Pinocchio
3.plot: Rory and Lorelai prepare for Rory's graduation from Chilton. But major developments involving the inn threaten to dampen the festivities.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E01 - Ballrooms and Biscotti
4.plot: After returning from a summer of backpacking through Europe, Rory and Lorelai frantically prepare for Rory's move to college.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E02 - The Lorelais' First Day at Yale
4.plot: Lorelai helps Rory move into her dorm, where she meets an odd new roommate, and learns that she will also be sharing her room with a familiar face.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E03 - The Hobbit, the Sofa, and Digger Stiles
4.plot: Emily redecorates Rory's dorm room without her permission. Lorelai and Sookie cater a kids' birthday party with a "Lord of the Rings" theme.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E04 - Chicken or Beef?
4.plot: While visiting Stars Hollow for the weekend, Rory encounters Dean, who awkwardly invites her to an event the next day.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E05 - The Fundamental Things Apply
4.plot: Lorelai struggles to hide details of her life from Emily. Rory discovers that college dating isn't easy. Lorelai invites Luke over for movie night.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E06 - An Affair to Remember
4.plot: Emily hires Lorelai and Sookie to cater an elaborate launch party for Richard's new company, but insists they prove that they are worthy of her trust.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E07 - The Festival of Living Art
4.plot: Rory and Lorelai participate in a Stars Hollow event in which the townspeople dress up and present tableaux imitating famous paintings.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E08 - Die, Jerk
4.plot: Rory tries to spice up her articles for the student newspaper. Luke admits to Lorelai that he is revisiting a past relationship.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E10 - The Nanny and the Professor
4.plot: Lorelai and Sookie renovate their inn. Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Rory is irritated by Paris's new relationship.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E11 - In the Clamor and the Clangor
4.plot: Lorelai is upset that Luke has gotten an apartment in another town. Rory learns that a guy she likes has been spreading false information about her.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E12 - A Family Matter
4.plot: Luke is wary when his sister comes to town. Lorelai hesitates to tell her parents about her new beau. Paris's affair gets serious.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E13 - Nag Hammadi Is Where They Found the Gnostic Gospels
4.plot: Rory crosses paths with Jess in Stars Hollow. Luke's sister visits Stars Hollow and introduces her new boyfriend to her brother.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E15 - Scene in a Mall
4.plot: Rory gets a glimpse of Dean's new life. When Lorelai and Rory spend a day at the mall, they run into Emily on a wild shopping spree.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E16 - The Reigning Lorelai
4.plot: Richard is devastated by a sudden loss. Emily receives a shock when she finds an old letter that was written to Richard.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E17 - Girls in Bikinis, Boys Doin' the Twist
4.plot: Rory and Paris head south for their first spring break in Florida, where they run into a couple of their old pals from Chilton.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E18 - Tick, Tick, Tick, Boom!
4.plot: Jason and Richard are sued. Rory is upset by a decision Dean has made. Dean is told to stop spending time with Rory.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E19 - Afterboom
4.plot: Lorelai confronts her father when she learns that he has cut business ties. Luke gives Lorelai an update on his love life.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E20 - Luke Can See Her Face
4.plot: A self-help tape helps a depressed Luke realize who his soul mate is. Lorelai is stressed as the Dragonfly Inn's opening day approaches.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E21 - Last Week Fights, This Week Tights
4.plot: Jess walks his mother down the aisle at her Renaissance-themed wedding. Luke asks his new love interest on a date. Dean confides in Rory.

4.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S04E22 - Raincoats and Recipes
4.plot: Lorelai invites friends and family to do a test run of the Dragonfly Inn opening. Two suitors pursue Lorelai.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E01 - Say Goodbye to Daisy Miller
5.plot: Rory and Lorelai argue about a choice Rory made. Lorelai is happy in her new relationship. Emily and Rory plan to take a European trip.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E02 - A Messenger, Nothing More
5.plot: After Rory apologizes to Lorelai, she sends a letter from Europe, which has unintended consequences. Meanwhile, Luke returns home.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E03 - Written in the Stars
5.plot: Lorelai is a little offended that no one cares about her new relationship – until it becomes a topic of heated discussion at the town meeting.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E04 - Tippecanoe and Taylor, Too
5.plot: Rory and Dean meet alone to discuss where they stand with each other. Lorelai and Sookie manage Jackson's campaign for a town office.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E05 - We Got Us a Pippi Virgin!
5.plot: Wanting to smooth over her relationship with Dean, Lorelai suggests a night out with Luke and Rory – but the evening goes awry.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E06 - Norman Mailer, I'm Pregnant!
5.plot: Lorelai and Sookie are thrilled when a cultural icon starts frequenting the Dragonfly Inn dining room. Rory discovers an intriguing secret society.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E07 - You Jump, I Jump, Jack
5.plot: Logan takes Rory to a mysterious and elaborate event. After discovering that Lorelai has a new beau, Emily and Richard spend time with him.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E08 - The Party's Over
5.plot: When Emily and Richard throw a party to introduce Rory to their alumni friends, she has a realization about her boyfriend.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E09 - Emily Says Hello
5.plot: Rory and Lorelai plan to convince Richard and Emily to reconcile, but Emily dashes their hopes by making a bold announcement.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E10 - But Not as Cute as Pushkin
5.plot: Rory hosts a high school student who's considering the same university, but things don't go as planned. Lorelai and her beau have their first fight.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E11 - Women Of Questionable Morals
5.plot: When Christopher visits Rory at college, she rejects his attempt at reconciliation. Lorelai consoles him but doesn't tell her boyfriend where she was.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E12 - Come Home
5.plot: Rory offers to help Logan write an article. When Richard sees Emily talking to a man she dated, he has an explosive reaction.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E13 - Wedding Bell Blues
5.plot: Lorelai and Rory throw Emily a party. Richard and Emily recommit to their marriage. Rory tells Logan what she wants from him.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E14 - Say Something
5.plot: After the disastrous scene at her parents' recent social event, Lorelai begs her boyfriend not to give up on their relationship.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E15 - Jews and Chinese Food
5.plot: Lorelai is upset about the recent turn of events. Luke builds sets for the elementary school play in hopes of seeing the costume designer.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E16 - So... Good Talk
5.plot: Richard and Emily return from their second honeymoon. Miserable Luke burns food and handles complaining customers by throwing them out of the diner.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E17 - Pulp Friction
5.plot: Rory regrets agreeing with her beau to date other people. Lorelai reunites with her boyfriend but remains cold toward Emily.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E18 - To Live and Let Diorama
5.plot: Luke helps turn an old house into a museum. Lorelai says too much during an interview about the inn. Rory, Paris and Lane have boyfriend trouble.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E19 - But I'm a Gilmore
5.plot: When Rory tells her beau she can't have a casual relationship with him, he gives her an unexpected response. Sookie finds herself confined to her bed.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E20 - How Many Kropogs to Cape Cod?
5.plot: Rory begins her internship at one of Logan's father's newspapers. Emily and Richard fawn over Rory's boyfriend, but Lorelai is not as impressed.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E21 - Blame Booze and Melville
5.plot: Rory is surprised by the performance review she receives from Logan's father. Luke's plan to buy the Twickham house is threatened by a competing bid.

5.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S05E22 - A House Is Not a Home
5.plot: Lorelai rescues Rory after a night of reckless behavior. Shocked to hear her daughter's plans for the future, she turns to Luke for help.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E01 - New and Improved Lorelai
6.plot: Luke responds to Lorelai. Rory faces legal consequences. Angry with Rory, Richard and Emily, Lorelai cuts off ties with them.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E02 - Fight Face
6.plot: Rory winds up in a fight while performing community service. Lorelai gets a dog. Luke and Lorelai decide to renovate Lorelai's house.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E03 - The UnGraduate
6.plot: Rory takes a job at Emily's Daughters of the American Revolution office and serves as her grandmother's spy. Lorelai won't commit to a date.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E04 - Always a Godmother, Never a God
6.plot: Sookie hopes to reconcile the estranged Gilmore girls by asking both Lorelai and Rory to be godparents to her kids, but things don't go as planned.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E05 - We've Got Magic to Do
6.plot: After two separate confrontations with the Huntzbergers at a D.A.R. party, Richard and Emily realize Lorelai was right about their treatment of Rory.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E06 - Welcome to the Doll House
6.plot: After asking Logan about Rory's future plans, Richard admits it was a mistake to let Rory make rash decisions and discusses the matter with Lorelai.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E07 - Twenty-One is the Loneliest Number
6.plot: Both Lorelai and Rory are saddened that their estrangement will keep them from spending Rory's 21st birthday the way they had always planned.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E08 - Let Me Hear Your Balalaikas Ringing Out
6.plot: When her former boyfriend visits and reveals an amazing success, Rory begins rethinking the choices she's made with her life.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E09 - The Prodigal Daughter Returns
6.plot: After months of estrangement, Lorelai and Rory make their first move toward reconciliation. Luke gets a big surprise but conceals it from Lorelai.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E10 - He's Slippin’ ‘Em Bread... Dig?
6.plot: Rory's long-absent father reappears in her and Lorelai's lives, casting uncertainty on what this will mean for Lorelai's current relationship.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E11 - The Perfect Dress
6.plot: Wanting to get to know his newly discovered relative, Luke makes a visit. Lorelai sets a date but has a feeling something's not right.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E12 - Just Like Gwen and Gavin
6.plot: Lorelai finds out about Luke's secret, but not from Luke. She tries to be supportive, but Luke's reaction hurts her. Logan tries to win over Rory.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E13 - Friday Night's Alright for Fighting
6.plot: Luke gets to know April. Rory tries to get the school newspaper published after the staff quits. All four Gilmores vent their frustrations.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E14 - You've Been Gilmored
6.plot: Lorelai brings Luke to dinner with her parents. When Rory becomes the new editor of the school paper, her roommate kicks her out of their apartment.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E15 - A Vineyard Valentine
6.plot: Rory, Lorelai and their beaus spend Valentine's Day weekend on Martha's Vineyard. During their stay, Rory's boyfriend saves the day.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E16 - Bridesmaids Revisited
6.plot: Rory dazzles the crowd at a journalism panel, but the next day, she's devastated to learn how her boyfriend behaved during their breakup.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E17 - I'm OK, You're OK
6.plot: Rory forgives her beau. Luke's girlfriend is secretly upset when he spends a few days with April. Rory does some spying on her mother's behalf.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E18 - The Real Paul Anka
6.plot: Unhappy because Rory hasn't really forgiven him, Logan takes off with his friends. Rory runs into Luke and April at a bookstore in Philadelphia.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E19 - I Get A Sidekick Out of You
6.plot: After she and her mother scramble to accommodate an unexpected visitor, Lane takes a big step in her life. Lorelai gives in to self-pity.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E20 - Super Cool Party People
6.plot: When Luke plans a birthday party for April at the diner, Lorelai wants to help and is hurt that Luke thinks it's too soon for her to meet April.

6.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S06E21 - Driving Miss Gilmore
6.plot: Lorelai helps Emily while she's unable to see after minor eye surgery. Rory takes charge of Logan's recovery when he returns home.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E01 - The Long Morrow
7.plot: Lorelai is mortified when she wakes up with an unexpected bedfellow. Rory is puzzled by Logan's going-away present.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E02 - That's What You Get, Folks, For Makin' Whoopee
7.plot: Rory is upset when she has to cancel a long-planned trip to Asia, so Lorelai turns her house into an Asian-themed wonderland.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E03 - Lorelai's First Cotillion
7.plot: Lorelai realizes her parents aren't as terrible as she thought. Rory's long-distance relationship proves to be a struggle.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E04 - 'S Wonderful, 'S Marvelous
7.plot: Lorelai is having trouble fully committing to her current relationship. A relative comes to stay with Luke.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E05 - The Great Stink
7.plot: Rory is thrilled when her beau comes to town on business but realizes during a dinner with his colleagues that she has no connection to his new world.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E06 - Go, Bulldogs!
7.plot: Christopher treats Rory's college newspaper co-workers to lunch, but the meal ends abruptly when Rory insists they cover a breaking story.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E07 - French Twist
7.plot: Christopher and Lorelai take Gigi to visit Sherry. Rory's tenure as editor-in-chief of the university newspaper comes to an end.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E08 - Introducing Lorelai Planetarium
7.plot: Rory initially pretends to be thrilled about Lorelai's announcement, but later lets her mother know how upset she is when they're alone.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E09 - Knit, People, Knit!
7.plot: Christopher's well-intentioned gesture at Stars Hollow's knit-a-thon brings the event to an early end.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E10 - Merry Fisticuffs
7.plot: When Christopher witnesses a sweet moment between a couple, he becomes concerned about his partner's commitment to him.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E11 - Santa's Secret Stuff
7.plot: Luke asks Lorelai to write a character reference letter for his court case. Lorelai, Christopher and Rory have a late but extravagant Christmas.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E12 - To Whom It May Concern
7.plot: Sookie acts strangely. Luke attends his court case hearing. Lorelai is confronted about the character reference letter she wrote for Luke.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E13 - I'd Rather Be In Philadelphia
7.plot: During a family emergency, Lorelai can't reach Christopher. Meanwhile, Logan and Luke drop everything to support Rory, Lorelai, Richard and Emily.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E14 - Farewell, My Pet
7.plot: Rory has a crush on the teacher filling in for Richard. Christopher and Lorelai talk about their current relationship with each other.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E15 - I'm a Kayak, Hear Me Roar
7.plot: Lorelai helps Emily organize domestic affairs but has trouble revealing the current state of her love life. Rory attends a birthday dinner for Logan.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E16 - Will You Be My Lorelai Gilmore?
7.plot: Rory has an interview. Lorelai must settle a fight between Lane and her mother. Logan reveals a failure to Rory.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E18 - Hay Bale Maze
7.plot: Rory shows her boyfriend around Stars Hollow, while Lorelai worries he's too irresponsible. Lorelai and Luke admit they both made mistakes.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E19 - It's Just Like Riding a Bike
7.plot: After an awkward encounter, Lorelai and Luke start fighting, which Lorelai takes as a good sign. Rory gets a letter that impacts her future plans.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E20 - Lorelai? Lorelai?
7.plot: Rory has a scary dream about what lies ahead for her. A visitor discusses Rory's future with Lorelai. Lorelai pours her heart out on karaoke night.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E21 - Unto The Breach
7.plot: Emily and Richard host a graduation party for Rory. Lorelai and Christopher are relieved to find they can still be friends. Logan surprises Rory.

7.title: FR - Gilmore Girls - S07E22 - Bon Voyage
7.plot: In this series finale, Rory makes a sudden change in her summer plans, and Luke enlists everyone in Stars Hollow to throw her a farewell party.

1.title: FR - Une traque américaine : Oussama Ben Laden - S01E01 - A New Kind of Enemy
1.plot: In the wake of 9/11, CIA analysts trace the horrific attacks to al-Qaida and its leader, Osama bin Laden — and mount a daring effort to apprehend him.

1.title: FR - Une traque américaine : Oussama Ben Laden - S01E02 - Gloves Are Off
1.plot: Frustration grows when the trail goes cold after the Battle of Tora Bora. As al-Qaida continues its global attacks, bin Laden plots his next move.

1.title: FR - Une traque américaine : Oussama Ben Laden - S01E03 - Operation Neptune Spear
1.plot: Ten years after 9/11, a pivotal clue emerges in Pakistan. The president orders a highly classified — and risky — SEAL raid to take out bin Laden at last.

meta.plot: À partir d'images rares et de témoignages de membres de la CIA, cette série documentaire haletante retrace la traque effrénée d'Oussama Ben Laden.

1.title: FR - Fred et Rose West : Un cauchemar britannique - S01E01 - Fred
1.plot: Fred West is taken into custody and questioned about his missing daughter. After he initially denies everything, the horrifying truth starts to emerge.

1.title: FR - Fred et Rose West : Un cauchemar britannique - S01E02 - Rose
1.plot: As the investigation unfolds, the police learn more about the couple's dark, twisted relationship - and deduce that Fred couldn't have been acting alone.

1.title: FR - Fred et Rose West : Un cauchemar britannique - S01E03 - The Trial
1.plot: The search for bodies extends beyond Cromwell Street and the police uncover evidence which shows that Rose may be more involved than they ever suspected.

meta.plot: Des interrogatoires récemment trouvés et des témoignages de personnes concernées retracent l'histoire de Fred et Rose West, deux des tueurs les plus prolifiques du Royaume-Uni.
In 2017, Spain suffered two terrorist attacks perpetrated by young members of its community. How could this happen? This incisive series investigates.

1.title: EN - 800 Meters [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - A Group of Friends
1.plot: Chilling footage details how the young perpetrators were radicalized to become part of a terrorist movement and the planning of the attacks.

1.title: EN - 800 Meters [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Something Happened on La Rambla
1.plot: The emotional testimonies of survivors, victims' relatives and first responders chronicle the events that unfolded on that tragic day on La Rambla.

1.title: EN - 800 Meters [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Two Hours Later
1.plot: Police officers recount the search for the van driver and the next attack in Cambrils. The interviewees recall the peace protest held after the attacks.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E01 - The H Word
1.plot: Matt Murdock, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Danny Rand investigate criminals and fight injustice, unaware their paths are about to cross.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E02 - Mean Right Hook
1.plot: As a new conspiracy takes shape, Matt finds old habits are hard to break, Jessica gets in over her head, Luke tracks a lead, and Danny meets his match.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E03 - Worst Behavior
1.plot: Elektra's secrets are revealed. Danny changes his tactics. Matt gives Jessica some legal advice. Luke searches for the White Hat.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E04 - Royal Dragon
1.plot: As the Defenders get to know each other over dinner, they're greeted by a series of party crashers -- none of them friendly.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E05 - Take Shelter
1.plot: Elektra's loyalties are questioned, Colleen clashes with an old acquaintance, and Luke proves he knows how to take a hit.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E06 - Ashes, Ashes
1.plot: Stick offers up a theory, Danny finds himself sidelined, and Alexandra learns that it's not easy being the leader.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E07 - Fish in the Jailhouse
1.plot: Matt, Jessica and Luke embark on a desperate search. Colleen and Claire debate heroism. Elektra tries to recruit an all-important ally.

1.title: FR - Marvel's The Defenders - S01E08 - The Defenders
1.plot: As New York edges closer to disaster, Elektra sees what's beyond the wall, and the Defenders make a last-ditch effort to save the city.

meta.plot: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage et Iron Fist s'allient pour combattre leurs ennemis communs quand un sinistre complot menace New York de destruction.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E01 - Never Got Any Reports
1.plot: It’s Samy’s first day as an MEP assistant in the European Parliament. He has no idea what he’s doing, his boss is even more clueless, and he’s already tasked with drafting regulation amendments. But first he’ll have to learn what an amendment is.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E02 - The Invincible Armada
1.plot: After Samy’s amendment on shark finning sparks quarreling between the parties, he must seek the help of his difficult-to-please political adviser, Maurice. But when they go after the same woman, Samy could make his first political enemy.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E03 - Politics and Sausages
1.plot: Samy is scrambling on all fronts. He needs to resolve the shark finning issue, his love interest might belong to the worst possible party, and Maurice still hates him. Luckily, he can count on his boss, Michel... or can he?

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E04 - The World's Oldest Profession
1.plot: After struggling to win his first victory in parliament, Samy is pressured by Ingeborg to undo it all. Will he succumb or will he stand by his convictions? And how many times will he be duped by the same lobbyist? Rose takes a huge risk at work.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E05 - Demos Kratos
1.plot: Samy finds himself playing tour guide to a group of retired teachers, who decide to help him with his shark finning report. Can he get it passed or will Torsten get in the way? Meanwhile, Rose teaches Sharon about the Northern Ireland border issue.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E06 - I'm Sharky
1.plot: Samy, Rose, and Torsten organize a conference to raise awareness for shark finning. They invite a high-profile EU Commissioner as a celebrity speaker for the event, and she ends up breaking Samy’s heart.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E07 - Wild West Wing
1.plot: As Samy’s shark finning amendment gains support in parliament, a handsome American environmentalist arrives in Brussels for the campaign. When he and Rose hit it off, Samy finds himself feeling jealous.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E08 - The Stability Pact
1.plot: Samy and Rose get locked in at the office. After some liquor and questionable snacks, their usual sarcastic banter takes a flirtatious turn. Too bad Rose gets offered a job opportunity halfway around the world.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E09 - Strasbourg Across the Rhine
1.plot: The European Parliament is attending plenary sessions in Strasbourg, where Samy plans to table his shark finning amendment for voting. Ingeborg schemes to stop him, but he gets some unexpected help from Eamon. Rose causes a bomb scare.

1.title: FR - Parlement - S01E10 - There Was a Young Shark
1.plot: Ingeborg forces Michel to betray Samy in order to kill his amendment. But it’s voting day and Samy will stop at nothing to get it passed — he’s Samy the Shark after all. Can he secure a political victory and win over Rose?

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E01 - The Top Jobs Magic Circus
2.plot: Riding high off his finning report’s success, Samy returns for a fresh session of Parliament looking for a new MEP to work beneath. Hilarity ensues as he jockeys for the best position — unaware of the ripple effects of his words.

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E02 - CIA Stuff
2.plot: Samy’s new MEP, Valentine Cantel, struggles to learn the Parliamentary ropes as Torsten comes up with a crazy plan to detangle Samy’s MEP mess. Will the pair be able to find a new president in time—and will he be willing to hear Samy out?

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E03 - The President's New Clothes
2.plot: Valentine is eager to get to work, but when she announces a set of flashy new reforms, Samy is sent scrambling to figure out what they actually look like. Meanwhile, Michel is as clueless as ever as he settles into his new role.

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E04 - Penguins
2.plot: Samy and Valentine piece together a ragtag list for the Blue Deal team — now they just need to get everyone on board. For Samy, this may mean crossing a former ally. At the same time, Rose struggles to find her footing as a lobbyist.

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E05 - A Piece of the Action
2.plot: As negotiations for the Blue Deal draw nearer, Samy and Valentine play political hardball to keep the lobbyists and activists in line. Torsten embarks on a mission to fend off the cruise industry and lands himself in decidedly hot water.

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E06 - Reptilians
2.plot: Eamon jumps all in to get the Blue Deal across the line as Samy receives help from an unexpected source. Desperate to draw attention away from her performance at work, Rose decides to play matchmaker for her boss and enlists Torsten’s help.

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E07 - Vox Pop
2.plot: Left to his own devices, Michel goes off script in front of the media–with hilarious and disastrous results. Samy’s gamble with the Poles looks like it might finally pay off, but not before intern Dragan threatens to ruin it all.

2.title: FR - Parlement - S02E08 - The Forbidden City
2.plot: With the fate of the Blue Deal on the line, Samy turns to Michel for help. As the pair embark on a hilarious jaunt around Parliament, Samy comes to a realization about himself. Meanwhile, Rose unpacks her feelings to an unsuspecting audience.

The home of Dr Henry Jekyll, Edinburgh 1886. Robert Louis Stevenson presents his business card, armed with a manuscript. With the appearance of fiction but the substance of fact, the story lacks only an ending. Jekyll's dying because he can no longer control the changes and his last secret will die with him as he tosses a vital piece of paper into the fire. 

London 2007. The casket's opened up and Tom calls out, chained up, unable to move. But is it really Tom?

There are six floors hewn deep into the ancient building's foundations - hell is on the lowest floor. They are hiding a secret; the building needs to be a fortress - and a trap for a man who can rip out a lion's throat.

meta.plot: Mister Hyde est de retour ! Mais que les braves gens se rassurent, aujourd'hui, le docteur Jackman (Jekyll, pour les intimes) vit (presque) en harmonie avec son alter égo maléfique. 1.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S01E05 - Ghost Story (5)

1.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S01E07 - Who Burned Mr. Brinker's Store? (2)

At the show something goes wrong and the model spaceship is stolen. She can't return the costume because it was on sale. Gaby is heart broken when she doesn't get to meet Galaxy Girl. She becomes more worried when the team leaves to confront Calvin but is even more scared when she finds the space ship model in her toy chest.

2.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S02E02 - Am I Blue? (2)

Just as Alex confesses to the police that Gaby didn't steal the spaceship, The producer of Galaxy Girl rushes over to tell the police that he got a note from Galaxy Girl's #1 fans, and the police suspect Gaby again because she is Galaxy Girl's #1 fan.

2.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S02E04 - Am I Blue? (4)

2.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S02E06 - Get the Message (2)

2.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S02E07 - Get the Message (3)

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E04 - A Crime of Two Cities (4)

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E05 - Four Days of the Cockatoo (1)
3.plot: Gaby finds a bird in a dumpster while looking for cans to recycle for her school.  She makes a pact with her father to take care of the bird and keep it in her room.

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E06 - Four Days of the Cockatoo (2)
3.plot: Gaby finds a name tag on the bird and learns that its a palm cockatoo, and they nickname the bird Calypso. Casey still can't understand why she can't go home to her mother. Gaby decides to make some flyers for Calypso's real owner. Hawke finds one of them and makes a phony call pretending to be the bird's real owner. Just then Calvin arrives at Lenni's house and informs the team that palm cockatoos aren't permitted in the usa. The team realizes that Gaby is giving the bird to a smuggler,so they leave hoping to warn Gaby before it's too late.

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E07 - Four Days of the Cockatoo (3)
3.plot: Hector and Lenni are able to warn Alex and Gaby about the smugglers the retreat back to Lenni's apartment. Jamal and Tina learn that Palm Cockatoos are endangered species,so the team tries to contact the police but it doesn't work so they contact the fish and wild life service, an animal rights society. They tell Mr. Fernandez that they won't give the bird to anyone except the fish and wild life people. Hawke, disguised as a pregnant woman overhears them and has a new idea. Just then two agents from the wild life society arrive at the bodega but Gaby reads a message from Ghostwriter and realizes that they are imposters, but when she goes to save Calypso the van takes off with her inside.

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E08 - Four Days of the Cockatoo (4)

Gaby leaves a message for the team but before she can finish she is captured and put in a giant bird cage. The team learns of Gaby's whereabouts and meet up with the real agents from the animal rights society. They discover where Gaby is and heads straight for the kidnappers lair. Poulet and Hawke are captured and Gaby gives the bird to the agents so they can help restore its species.

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E09 - Attack of the Slime Monster (1)
3.plot: Casey is writing a scary story for a local contest about ""Gooey Gus: the Slime Monster"", a doll that spits out grape bubblegum. Alex and Gaby come to help, too, and Gaby writes about Alex and Jamal finding the Slime Monster seemingly alive in an alley, and then Alex, Gaby, and Casey find the Slime Monster in a crock pot.

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E10 - Attack of the Slime Monster (2)
3.plot: Jamal, Lenni, and Alex are graduating from middle school and Tina is hosting the party, while Jamal and Tina work on the prom committee. 3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E11 - Attack of the Slime Monster (3)
3.plot: Gooey Gus suddenly explodes in the sun and grows 6 feet tall in the story.  Suddenly, at the band practice, Tina tells Lenni that he really likes her.  If the gooey gum covers your skin, you are gone for good, so will Gaby and Casey make it?

3.title: FR - Ghostwriter - S03E12 - Attack of the Slime Monster (4)
3.plot: The team trys to come up with a conclusion.  Tina and Casey discover the Slime Monster's weakness, cold.  Just before the discover their plan, He attacks Lenni and the rest of the team!  Luckily, Tina escapes and Jamal and Tina melt the Slime Monster with vegtable oil.

meta.plot: Ghostwriter est une émission de télévision américaine créée par Liz Nealon et produite par le Children's Television Workshop et BBC One. Il a commencé à être diffusé sur PBS le 4 octobre 1992 et le dernier épisode a été diffusé le 13 février 1995. La série tourne autour d'un cercle très uni d'amis de Brooklyn qui résolvent des crimes et des mystères de quartier en équipe de jeunes détectives avec l'aide de un fantôme invisible nommé Ghostwriter. Ghostwriter ne peut communiquer avec les enfants qu'en manipulant le texte et les lettres qu'il peut trouver et en les utilisant pour former des mots et des phrases. La série a été tournée sur place à Fort Greene, Brooklyn.

Vingt ans après la destruction de la civilisation moderne, Joel, un survivant endurci, est engagé pour faire sortir Ellie, une jeune fille de 14 ans, d'une zone de quarantaine oppressante. Ce qui n'est au départ qu'un petit travail se transforme rapidement en un voyage brutal et époustouflant, alors que dans ce duo improbable, chacun dépend de l'autre pour sa survie.

meta.plot: Vanessa « Van » Helsing, descendante du grand Abraham Van Helsing, est ressuscitée dans un monde post-apocalyptique ravagé par des vampires assoiffés de sang. S'entourant de plusieurs alliés durant son périple, la jeune femme devra mener une véritable résistance pour permettre à la race humaine d'avoir une chance de subsister.

L'histoire se passe à l'intérieur d'un ordinateur. Bob est un Gardien qui se charge de maintenir la sécurité du système Mainframe dans lequel se trouve un virus du nom de Megabyte. Ce dernier cherche à tout prix à infiltrer le SuperOrdinateur, un autre système bien plus puissant et dont Bob est originaire, afin de l'infecter. Bob a également des alliés en la présence de Dot Matrix, son petit frère Enzo particulièrement casse-cou et toujours accompagné de son chien Frisket, et Phong le « vieux sage ». Ce ne sera pas de trop pour lutter contre les offensives de Megabyte, mais également pour prendre part aux jeux lancés par l'utilisateur du système, qui se manifestent sous forme d'un cube de couleur violette qui tombe du « ciel », et dans lesquels ils doivent à tout prix battre l'utilisateur : s'ils perdent la partie, ils seront effacés et provoqueront la destruction d'un secteur de Mainframe.

1.title: FR - ReBoot - S01E01 - The Tearing

The Read-Only Room at the Principle Office is too much like work for the young sprite, so he's tempted into tinkering with the system clock. Only instead of making himself twice as smart as everyone else in Mainframe, he accidentally makes everyone else half as smart! What's worse, he ends up trapped in a game cube with a bunch of his dumbed-down friends. Can Enzo best the user by himself and fix this mess?

meta.plot: Renversée par une voiture et pourtant sans séquelle, une jeune adolescente de 17 ans ne se souvient de rien. Ni d’où elle vient, ni qui elle est. Tout ce qu'elle possède, c'est un prénom étrange : Prométhée. Recueillie par ceux qui l’ont renversée, elle commence à avoir des visions violentes qui la connectent à une scène de crime dont le meurtrier est toujours en fuite. A-t-elle été témoin ? Est-elle impliquée dans ce meurtre ? Prométhée, comme tous les autres, voudrait savoir qui elle est. Surtout lorsqu’elle se découvre des capacités physiques étonnantes...

meta.plot: When Okita Kazuaki was starting out as a doctor, he was forced to resign from the hospital. He left his girlfriend Danjo Mifuyu behind and went to the US alone. 10 years go by and he comes back as a surgeon with outstanding skills to save his former teacher from illness. His teacher is none other than his ex-girlfriend’s father. In the time that Okita was away, Mifuyu had married his own good friend Masao, who is now the deputy director and the heir of the hospital. To make matters worse, this friend was the one who plotted to drive him out form the hospital 10 years ago. Okita has to face all sorts of ordeals to save his teacher. But he never gives up amid the swirl of love, desire, friendship, jealousy and pride. Okita may be awkward but deals with patients with all his heart. His way of life gets the people working at the hospital to start asking themselves what real healthcare is.

Kyle n'a pas de nombril, ce n'est pas un humain comme les autres : il a de capacités hors du commun, et sa nouvelle "famille" ne va pas tarder à s'en rendre compte.

He gets on the bad side of both Trager kids, Josh and Lori, and annoys Stephen, Nicole's husband. But one by one, Kyle influences them to accept him.

Still not willing to give them the benefit of the doubt, Kyle decides after his first day there never to return, but rethinks his decision when he finds out about his family’s financial dilemma. 1.plot: As the town's anger hits the boiling point, Daniel's family goes on alert. Foulkes presses the D.A. for a retrial. Ted Jr. & Tawney recover from disturbing encounters. Trey Willis searches for the missing George Melton. Daniel must decide his future.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E01 - Running with the Bull
2.plot: Daniel’s family fears he won’t recover from his injuries and his attackers will escape justice. Judy Dean shows Bobby some unexpected affection. Ted, Jr. hides a shameful secret from his wife. Sheriff Daggett investigates Daniel’s beating.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E02 - Sleeping Giants
2.plot: Amantha dreads the worst as she prepares for Daniel to awaken from his induced coma. Teddy’s business plans are thwarted by his dad, and he gets some unwelcome news from Tawney. Jared learns more about his older brother and the late Hanna Dean.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E03 - Charlie Darwin
2.plot: Still recovering from his injuries, Daniel makes a startling decision. Amantha is outraged by Daniel’s choice and hurt when Janet takes his side. Teddy asks Janet for help and ends up forced into an awkward situation with Tawney. Bobby Dean has an unexpected conversation with Sheriff Daggett. Jon Stern gains a valuable, but disturbing insight into a client's case and Daniel bends a few rules.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E04 - Donald the Normal
2.plot: A recovered Daniel explores Atlanta and enjoys a taste of big-city anonymity, while Amantha starts packing up her apartment. Tawney grows frustrated with Ted, Jr.’s ever-shifting moods, forcing him to seek understanding from an unexpected quarter.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E05 - Act as If
2.plot: Daniel meets Lezley, an unusual local entrepreneur who makes Daniel an unlikely offer.  Amantha struggles to adapt to a challenging new environment. Ted Jr. bonds with Tawney, only to learn she’s made a surprising decision. Ted Sr.'s patience is tested as he copes with the aftermath of Daniel’s disastrous new project. Daniel explores a little-known side of Paulie while Amantha reconnects with Jon Stern.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E06 - Mazel Tov
2.plot: Daniel heads out on a strange errand and mysteriously disappears. Meanwhile, the family surprises Janet with unexpected birthday presents.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E07 - Weird as You
2.plot: Daniel continues to seek answers. Stern meets with the DA. Sen. Foulkes undertakes a disreputable task, and Amantha and a coworker bond.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E08 - The Great Destroyer
2.plot: A reluctant Daniel seeks help, unsettling news leads to an intense debate at the Talbots and CJ Pickens bears some startling news.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E09 - ﻿Until You're Blue
2.plot: Recent events frustrate Ted Jr., while Ted Sr. attempts to protect the family. Meanwhile, Daniel is faced with a tough decision, and Amantha tries to sort some things out and lets off some steam.

2.title: FR - Rectify - S02E10 - Unhinged
2.plot: Daniel has a problem accepting Jon Stern's advice, while Tawney rethinks her options. Meanwhile, Ted, Jr. seeks a favor, and Amantha comes clean to Jon Stern.

meta.plot: Rectify raconte l'histoire de Daniel Holden, qui est libéré après 19 ans de prison, grâce à de nouvelles analyses ADN le disculpant. Il n'avait que 18 ans quand il fut condamné à mort pour le viol et le meurtre d'une jeune fille de 16 ans. Il retourne vivre auprès de sa famille, dans sa ville natale, où eut lieu le drame. Beaucoup d'habitants le croient néanmoins toujours coupable. Après avoir passé sa vie d'adulte à attendre la mort, il doit désormais réapprendre à vivre.
Un blackout total de 2 minutes et 17 secondes provoque le chaos à travers le monde. Pendant cette courte durée, chaque personne est confrontée à une vision du futur qui va changer sa vie à jamais...

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E01 - No More Good Days
1.plot: When the world's population is given a glimpse of their future due to a mysterious global event, it forces everyone to come to grips with whether their destinies can be fulfilled or avoided.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E02 - White to Play
1.plot: Demetri and Mark travel to Utah in search of a suspect who might be connected to the global blackout, while Olivia runs into the man from her vision.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E03 - 137 Sekunden
1.plot: A Nazi claims to have knowledge about the blackouts. Meanwhile, Demetri receives an anonymous tip about the future, and Aaron tries to get approval to have his daughter's body exhumed.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E04 - Black Swan
1.plot: Mark thinks Demetri is letting his fear take over his life, while Nicole reveals her shocking vision that involves a murder.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E05 - Gimme Some Truth
1.plot: Mark finds himself on the defensive during a Senate Intelligence Committee hearing. Janis wonders how her vision will affect her current romantic relationship, and Olivia receives an anonymous message.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E06 - Scary Monsters and Super Creeps
1.plot: Mark, Demetri and Wedeck try to connect Janis' attack with a separate attack made on them, and Olivia confronts Mark about his experience. Elsewhere, Demetri and Gough track down a clue from Mark's board, and Dylan goes missing from the hospital.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E07 - The Gift
1.plot: Mark, Demetri, Gough and MI-6 Agent Fiona Banks look into a Blue Hand club's possible connection to recent suicides. Elsewhere, Aaron gets a surprise visit from a former Army pal of his late daughter.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E08 - Playing Cards with Coyote
1.plot: Mark's romantic getaway with Olivia is cut short when he gets a tip that leads him to the tattooed assassin who appeared in his flashforward. Aaron learns the truth about his daughter's accident.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E09 - Believe
1.plot: While Bryce begins his search for the woman in his flashforward, Aaron becomes concerned over Tracy's odd behavior. Mark attempts to track down the person responsible for texting Olivia and outing his drinking during his flashforward vision, and Demetri's co-agents try to find the mysterious caller who forewarned him about his unfortunate fate.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E10 - A561984
1.plot: Against Wedeck's orders, Mark and Demetri travel to Hong Kong in search of the woman claiming to know details of Demetri's fate. Lloyd tries to come clean about his and Simon's involvement in the global blackout, and Zoey discovers the true meaning of her flashforward.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E11 - Revelation Zero (1)
1.plot: Mark must meet with a therapist to regain his badge after being suspended by the FBI; Demetri reluctantly teams with CIA agent Vogel to search for Lloyd; Janis learns family secrets about Simon.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E12 - Revelation Zero (2)
1.plot: A suspended Mark resumes his own investigation into Lloyd's disappearance. Simon attempts to hack into Lloyd's computer in search of clues, and Nicole speaks with a man who was transformed during the blackout in order to help her restore her faith and understand her horrific flashforward vision.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E13 - Blowback
1.plot: Aaron tries to figure out why a black-ops unit is looking for his daughter, while Mark questions Lloyd about a conversation that occurred during their flashforwards. Zoey tries to alter Demetri's fate.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E14 - Better Angels
1.plot: Demetri, Janis, Simon and Vogel go to Somalia to search for clues. Meanwhile, Bryce tells Nicole he has cancer, and Olivia tries to get her daughter to tell her what she saw in her flashforward.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E15 - Queen Sacrifice
1.plot: Mark and Vogel put a plan into action to uncover the FBI mole, which could end up alienating Mark from his co-workers. Meanwhile, in an effort to protect his family and his marriage, Mark moves out of the house, and Keiko continues her search in Los Angeles for Bryce.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E16 - Let No Man Put Asunder
1.plot: Demetri decides to put a rush on his wedding plans with Zoey when the captured FBI mole confirms the date of his prophesized murder. Meanwhile, Wedeck tries to help Aaron infiltrate Jericho in order to rescue Tracy.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E17 - The Garden of Forking Paths
1.plot: Mark and his team search for Demetri, while terror suspect Alda promises to give Zoey information on Demetri's whereabouts. Elsewhere, Olivia learns the identity of who sent her the text message about Mark's flashforward.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E18 - Goodbye Yellow Brick Road
1.plot: Olivia receives disturbing news from Gabriel; Aaron's life is in danger as he continues to search for his daughter in Afghanistan.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E19 - Course Correction
1.plot: Demetri and Agent Banks attempt to track down a killer as questions arise about the universe course-correcting itself, when people who thought they'd escaped their fates are found dead. Mark reluctantly agrees to help Simon find his sister, Annabelle, but discovers he's withholding the truth about her true circumstances.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E20 - The Negotiation
1.plot: Mark does everything in his power to protect Gabriel, who is the bridge between Dyson Frost and the Global Blackout. Aaron locates his daughter's captors and puts his life on the line in order to rescue her, while Simon comes face to face with the head of the nefarious organization that may be responsible for the blackout.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E21 - Countdown
1.plot: Mark continues his interrogation of Hellinger in a desperate attempt to find out when the next blackout will occur. Demetri must choose between helping Janis and Simon break into NLAP to stop the blackout from occurring, or turning the fugitive Simon in to the FBI. Elsewhere, Lloyd finds the common denominator that can help him solve the complex equation he was working on in his flashforward.

1.title: FR - FlashForward - S01E22 - Future Shock
1.plot: The day of the prophesized flashforwad date arrives as everyone waits to see if their predictions take place. Mark uncovers the date of the next blackout, and Simon, with Demetri, attempts to stop it from happening by breaking into the NLAP mainframe.
