1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Medical resident Liv Moore becomes a zombie and loses her ambition until she begins working at the city morgue to gain access to brains that give her sustenance and allow her to maintain her humanity. She also learns that her new diet enables her to experience a victim's memories that can be used to help solve the person's murder.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E02 - Brother, Can You Spare a Brain?
1.plot: After an artist is murdered, Liv not only picks up his visions, she picks up traces of his passion and begins to see things in a more inspired way. Meanwhile, Blaine connects with Liv, and Liv tries to connect with Major.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E03 - The Exterminator
1.plot: Liv's newest corpse is a sociopathic hitman, and she's apathetically shocked to discover that she no longer feels emotions. Meanwhile, Marcy turns up as a full zombie and Ravi hopes that he can restore her in the hopes that it will lead to a cure for Liv.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E04 - Liv and Let Clive
1.plot: After eating the brain of their newest John Doe, Liv gets a vision of Clive as a dirty cop working with a gang to find a rat in their organization. Meanwhile, Major gets a new roommate, and Blaine expands his business operation.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E05 - Flight of the Living Dead
1.plot: The newest brain at the morgue is personal for Liv: it's an adventurous girl that Liv voted out of her sorority house. While Liv and Clive try to determine if the girl was murdered, Major asks Clive for help finding Jerome.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E06 - Virtual Reality Bites
1.plot: Liv eats rotting brains to get a lead on the murder of an agoraphobic Internet troll and MMORPG player. Meanwhile, Major continues looking into Jerome's disappearance, and Eva makes the acquaintance of Meat Cute's owner.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E07 - Maternity Liv
1.plot: Lt. Suzuki dedicates all of the police resources to finding the killer of a rich white girl who died of exposure after an eight-month disappearance. The girl gives birth before she dies, and Liv soon starts having maternal feelings toward the baby and everyone else around her. Meanwhile, Major tries to find out more about Julien, and Liv and Lowell's relationship changes when he eats the wrong brain.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E08 - Dead Air
1.plot: Liv's newest brain is a talk show host who gives relationship advice, but Liv's overbearing shrinking of her friends soon irritates them. Meanwhile, Liv questions her relationship with Lowell, Blaine meets with Suzuki, and Major begins to realize the truth about zombies in Seattle.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E09 - Patriot Brains
1.plot: Means and opportunity coincide when Liv eats the brain of a murdered soldier... and the opportunity to shoot and kill Blaine arises. Meanwhile, Ravi nervously waits to see if the rat bite will turn him into a zombie, and Julien pays Major a visit.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E10 - Mr. Berserk
1.plot: Liv and Clive investigate the murder of a journalist working on a story linking psychotic episodes in a small number of consumers to the energy drink Max Rager. Liv goes straight to the top at Max Rager HQ and questions the man in charge, Vaughn Du Clark. Meanwhile, Ravi tries to help Major who continues to believe he's going crazy.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E11 - Astroburger
1.plot: When someone close to Major dies of an apparent suicide, Liv consumes the brains resulting in a mix of reality and paranoia. Clive questions Major and learns of a secret computer file that may contain important details in the investigation – and finding the killer.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E12 - Dead Rat, Live Rat, Brown Rat, White Rat
1.plot: Four teenagers hit Sebastian shortly after he becomes a zombie, and he kills one of them. When the body turns up, Liv eats the brain and tries to find out who is responsible. Meanwhile, Ravi and Peyton plan a trip to San Francisco, but Liv gets a visitor who interrupts their plans.

1.title: FR - iZombie - S01E13 - Blaine's World
1.plot: As Liv and Clive try to track down Cameron and determine his connection to Max Rager, Blaine interrogates Major about the missing brains.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E01 - Grumpy Old Liv
2.plot: Liv consumes the brains of a cantankerous old man to help gain insight into his death. After receiving an anonymous call on the tipster hotline, Liv and Detective Babineax stop by the residence of Byron Thistlewaite, to question the mysterious caller. Meanwhile, Ravi suspects that Major might be experiencing a side effect of the cure, and Liv pays Blaine a surprise visit.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E02 - Zombie Bro
2.plot: Liv and Detective Babineax investigate the murder of a hard-partying frat boy whose death shocks everyone. After consuming his brains, Liv attends a fraternity party in an attempt to search for clues, but ends up ruling the beer pong table instead. Still desperate to find the cure, Ravi takes matters into his own hands and brings Major along for the ride. Meanwhile, Blaine meets with Angus, a mysterious person from his past.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E03 - Real Dead Housewife of Seattle
2.plot: Liv eats the brains of a recently murdered trophy wife who was pushed to her death from the balcony of her stunning architectural home in the hills by a hired hit man. A Pinot Grigio-sipping, suddenly fashion obsessed Liv and Detective Babineaux begin questioning suspects in their search for the original brains behind this murder. Meanwhile, Liv and Ravi are surprised to learn that Peyton has returned to Seattle.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E04 - Even Cowgirls Get the Black and Blues
2.plot: While investigating a case, Liv eats the brains of a country-singing waitress. Detective Babineaux meets a female FBI agent who will be working out of their offices. Blaine tries to entice a former business associate to come back to the dark side. Meanwhile, Peyton’s return is messing up Ravi’s game, and Major continues his downward spiral.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E05 - Love & Basketball
2.plot: Liv, Detective Babineaux and Ravi investigate the mysterious death of a peewee basketball coach. Liv, consumed with overzealous coach brains, gives Major a much needed pep talk. Meanwhile, things get a little crazy when Blaine and Ravi are forced to work together to recreate the cure. Lastly, Detective Babineaux receives a surprise visit from Suzuki's widow Helen.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E06 - Max Wager
2.plot: Liv unwittingly crosses paths with the most dangerous man in Seattle while investigating the murder of degenerate gambler Harry. Detective Babineaux has a super-fan moment when he and Liv question NBA Hall of Famer Calvin Owens at Harry’s funeral. Meanwhile, Blaine’s father makes a huge discovery, and Ravi delivers some bad news. Lastly, Evan has a big secret to share with Liv, and Major continues to struggle.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E07 - Abra Cadaver
2.plot: Liv consumes the brains of a death-obsessed illusionist who was murdered in cold blood during a magicians’ convention in Seattle. As Liv and Detective Babineaux investigate the case, she uses her new skills to help narrow down the suspect pool. Meanwhile, Blaine gives Liv some interesting news, and Ravi makes a decision but things don’t end up going quite as planned. Lastly, Major continues to distance himself from Liv.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E08 - The Hurt Stalker
2.plot: Detective Babineaux arrives at the crime scene of a wedding planner who was shot to death, and is shocked to realize that he used to date the victim. To make matters worse, we learn that the murder victim was stalking Detective Babineaux, and that he is now the number one suspect in her murder. Liv and Ravi pose as an engaged couple in order to infiltrate the victim's wedding planning business. Meanwhile, Major is having a tough time dealing with Liv on stalker brains.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E09 - Cape Town
2.plot: Liv is called in on the case of a shop teacher who pursues criminals at night as a costumed vigilante... and turns up dead. Meanwhile, Major makes the acquaintance of a new zombie.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E10 - Method Head
2.plot: An actor is accidentally shot on the set of Liv's favorite TV show--Zombie High--and she convinces Clive to let her help in the investigation. Meanwhile, Vaughn devises a loyalty test for Major, and Dale connects Blaine to the Meat Cute massacre.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E11 - Fifty Shades of Grey Matter
2.plot: A librarian is murdered and the investigation soon reveals that she was going to release her first erotic novel. Meanwhile, Peyton is forced to step in when Clive and Dale arrest Blaine for murder, and Major is forced to give up his dog.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E12 - Physician, Heal Thy Selfie
2.plot: The three newest bodies in Seattle turn up decapitated, leaving Liv without brains to eat to solve their murders. While she helps Clive anyway, Liv hears about a new drug dealer in Seattle. Meanwhile, Peyton turns to Ravi for support and considers quitting her job, and Major is forced to prove his loyalty to Max Rager when Vaughn learns that someone Major declared a non-zombie... is.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E13 - The Whopper
2.plot: Liv, Ravi, and Major get a lead on the Utopium-tainted corpses when the man who may have killed them turns up dead. Meanwhile, Blaine discovers that his father left his money to his maid in case he died due to foul play, and Clive and Dale realize that Major is involved with Blaine.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E14 - Eternal Sunshine of the Caffeinated Mind
2.plot: While Liv and Clive investigate the murder of a coffee shop owner with an extremely sunny outlook on life, Ravi tests the new cure on a rat before administering it to Major. Meanwhile, Boss discovers who has been moving in on his turf.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E15 - He Blinded Me... With Science
2.plot: After a scientist is murdered, Liv and Babineaux are surprised to learn where she worked; Ravi gets a visit from Blaine at the morgue; Liv finds out something about Drake; Major is confronted by Vaughn du Clarke.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E16 - Pour Some Sugar, Zombie
2.plot: Liv consumes the brain of a recently murdered stripper and uncovers some extremely useful information. Meanwhile, Blaine isn’t quite himself lately, and Ravi makes a startling discovery. Lastly, Major and Ravi are helping Peyton move back in with Liv when she receives a surprising phone call.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E17 - Reflections of the Way Liv Used to Be
2.plot: Liv and Babineaux investigate the death of a highly competitive student; Liv becomes more like the girl she used to be after consuming the victim's brain; Blaine looks to Ravi for help.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E18 - Dead Beat
2.plot: Liv and Ravi are in need of help and find an unlikely ally in Blaine. Detective Babineaux and Dale Bozzio pursue a new lead on an old case. Meanwhile, when Major finds himself in a world of trouble, sleazebag Brant Stone comes to his rescue. Vaughn’s evil side reaches a whole new level of mean.

2.title: FR - iZombie - S02E19 - Salivation Army
2.plot: Working together on a mission, Liv, Detective Babineaux and Major crash Vaughn’s Super Max Rager party, where Rob Thomas performs a song from his solo career. Meanwhile, Blaine reaches out to Peyton for help, which does not sit well with Ravi.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E01 - Heaven Just Got a Little Bit Smoother
3.plot: Liv has discovered there are more zombies living in Seattle than she previously believed. In fact, there’s a private military contractor employing a small zombie army, and that army is preparing for the day humans learn of their existence. Major was exonerated for the crimes of the Chaos Killer, but is still considered a pariah. He manages to land a job with the one and only place that will hire him. Meanwhile, Blaine is accused of lying.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E02 - Zombie Knows Best
3.plot: When Liv, Clive and Ravi arrive at the scene to investigate a fatal car accident, they begin to suspect foul play was involved. Both starving, Liv and Major consume the brains of the accident victims, a well-meaning father and his angsty teenage daughter. Meanwhile, when Clive is brought in for questioning about a family that was murdered, he’s forced to reveal his past history with them. Lastly, Peyton extends an olive branch to Ravi, and Major hits a road block in his search for Natalie.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E03 - Eat, Pray, Liv
3.plot: To help Clive solve the murder of a lifestyle guru, Liv consumes his brain and takes on his zen approach to life. Ravi's old boss, Katty Kupps, is getting closer to discovering the truth while also getting closer to Ravi. Meanwhile, Blaine and Peyton continue their budding friendship, much to Ravi's dismay. Lastly, Major is struggling a bit at his new job.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E04 - Wag the Tongue Slowly
3.plot: Clive's patience is tested when Liv consumes the brain of a murder victim who had the reputation of being the ultimate office gossip. Meanwhile, Blaine and Peyton continue to grow closer as they wait to see if Ravi is able to reverse the effects of the cure. Lastly, Major is one step away from fulfilling a promise.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E05 - Spanking the Zombie
3.plot: When Liv consumes the brains of a dominatrix, her bossy and controlling personality makes everyone a little uncomfortable, especially Clive. Meanwhile, Blaine and Peyton have a heart-to-heart.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E06 - Some Like It Hot Mess
3.plot: To help Clive solve the murder of an irresponsible narcissist, Liv consumes her brain and literally becomes a hot mess. Meanwhile, Peyton learns some shocking news. Lastly, Ravi experiences a major setback.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E07 - Dirt Nap Time
3.plot: When Liv and Clive work together to solve the murder of a very charming, but womanizing, preschool teacher, things get interesting when they bring his jealous girlfriend Piper in for questioning. Meanwhile, Peyton is assigned a very interesting case. Lastly, Blaine finds himself in a bad situation.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E08 - Eat a Knievel
3.plot: Liv shares the brain of a former daredevil with her new boyfriend, and the experience brings them closer. Blaine is back to his old ways. Meanwhile, Ravi makes progress in his new research. Finally, a discovery is made that could put Major in grave danger.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E09 - Twenty-Sided, Die
3.plot: When a Dungeon Master is killed, Liv and Clive discover he was up to more than just playing in his mother's basement. Meanwhile, Blaine's experiment does not go as planned. Lastly, Ravi stumbles across some new information that could prove deadly.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E10 - Return of the Dead Guy
3.plot: Peyton and Liv find themselves on a surprising wild goose chase. Ravi is terrified when the zombie truth hunters' plans are revealed. Elsewhere, Major finds comfort in an unexpected - and perhaps unwelcome - friend.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E11 - Conspiracy Weary
3.plot: Liv and Blaine come to the rescue of one of their own. They consume the brains of a conspiracy theorist and paranoia ensues. Meanwhile, as they continue to search for conspiracy theories that may or may not exist, Liv researches Major's new friend. Finally, Ravi makes a surprising discovery of his own.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E12 - Looking for Mr. Goodbrain (1)
3.plot: When Liv consumes the brains of someone from Ravi's past, not only does it have her wanting to sleep with every guy in Seattle, she also begins having some very intimate visions of Ravi. Meanwhile, Major is faced with a huge decision.

3.title: FR - iZombie - S03E13 - Looking for Mr. Goodbrain (2)
3.plot: Liv uncovers the shocking truth about the virus and the far-reaching consequences of the vaccine. Majors exams his future as a human. Blaine makes a business proposal.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E01 - Are You Ready for Some Zombies?
4.plot: While investigating the murder of a Seattle Seahawk superfan, Liv has a surprising vision. Meanwhile, Major is assigned the task of mentoring young, homeless zombies, and Ravi is still carrying a torch for Peyton. Lastly, Blaine is dealing with a threat looming from his past.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E02 - Blue Bloody
4.plot: It’s a real-life game of clue for Liv after she eats the brains of a despicable dowager and must determine which one of her disgruntled servants killed her. Clive and Bozzio are struggling to maintain a healthy relationship. Meanwhile, circumstances place Major and Liv in opposition to one another.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E03 - Brainless in Seattle (1)
4.plot: Love is in the air after Liv eats the brains of a hopeless romantic, and she can’t stop herself from meddling in Clive’s relationship. Major and Liv continue to try to work through their differences. Meanwhile, Blaine is approached with an interesting offer.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E04 - Brainless in Seattle (2)
4.plot: Liv and Clive discover the murder they are investigating was the work of a serial killer. Meanwhile, Major enters dangerous territory.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E05 - Goon Struck
4.plot: While tracking the murder of a hockey player, Liv stumbles onto Chase Graves’ evil plan. Meanwhile, Major is forced to make a horrible decision. Lastly, Peyton tries to contain a volatile situation.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E06 - My Really Fair Lady
4.plot: Liv and Clive investigate the murder of a pretentious theater actor. Meanwhile, Ravi makes a huge sacrifice for Peyton. Lastly, Blaine makes a startling discovery.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E07 - Don't Hate the Player, Hate the Brain
4.plot: After consuming the brain of a bachelor playboy, Liv heads to a club to meet up with Clive and Ravi. Meanwhile, Major is assigned an enormous task. Lastly, Clive is still struggling with the arrangement he’s made with Bozzio.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E08 - Chivalry is Dead
4.plot: Liv consumes the brain of a murdered live-action role-playing knight in order to solve his murder; Peyton uncovers a truth about Liv; Major embarks on a mission.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E09 - Mac-Liv-Moore
4.plot: There's a zombie serial killer on the loose and new Seattle is on lockdown. Liv is trapped in the morgue on white rapper brain and Clive and Ravi are playing Dungeons & Dragons. Meanwhile, Blaine concocts his most sinister plan to date. Lastly, Major is on the hunt for the killer.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E10 - Yipee Ki Brain, Motherscratcher
4.plot: When Liv consumes the brain of a vice detective who doesn't play by the rules, her newfound recklessness gets her into trouble. Meanwhile, Major is coming really close to discovering Liv's secret.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E11 - Insane in the Germ Brain
4.plot: Liv does Clive a solid and agrees to consume germaphobe brain during flu season. Ravi continues his role as surrogate father to Isobel. Major finally gets to the bottom of things, and Chase continues to spiral out of control. Lastly, Peyton struggles with a very important decision.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E12 - You've Got to Hide Your Liv Away
4.plot: While Major whisks Liv out of Seattle for her own protection, Ravi eats the brains of a narcissist to help Clive investigate Brother Love for murder.

4.title: FR - iZombie - S04E13 - And He Shall Be a Good Man
4.plot: The outside world further isolates Seattle while Peyton, Ravi, Clive and Major race to save Liv from execution for her work as Renegade.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E01 - Thug Death
5.plot: While investigating a murder case with no body and no brain to eat, the only evidence Liv and Clive have to work with is a grainy video and a little bit of blood found at the crime scene. Meanwhile, Blaine is up to his old tricks.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E02 - Dead Lift
5.plot: Liv, on fitness guru brains, and Clive continue investigating a murder with no body and no evidence. Meanwhile, Peyton approaches councilman Zed with a request but doesn’t get the answer she was hoping for. Lastly, Liv surprises Major with a thoughtful gesture just when he needs it the most.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E03 - Five, Six, Seven, Ate!
5.plot: While investigating the deaths of Gulliver and Nancy, the dynamic duo of Seattle's winning dance team, Liv and Ravi go undercover as dance partners to size up the other contestants aka the prime suspects. Meanwhile, Peyton confronts Major after she's told that one of his soldiers was out of line during a routine lice check at the school. Lastly, Clive and Bozzio receive a shocking surprise during Lamaze class.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E04 - Dot Zom
5.plot: Liv, Clive and Ravi investigate the suspicious death of Cornell Piercey, the head of Piercey Corp, a successful traffic app company. Melissa Schultz, Cornell's ex-girlfriend, is now running the company, makes an interesting reveal to Liv and Clive. Meanwhile, Peyton is focusing on maintaining positive zombie PR in the city. Lastly, Blaine is intrigued when he meets Al Bronson of Bluster Magazine, as she is not at all what he was expecting.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E05 - Death Moves Pretty Fast
5.plot: While investigating the death of independently wealthy, 19-year-old, Harris Miller, Liv, on brain à la Ferris Bueller, attempts to cheer up Ravi who has been spiraling after learning some unfortunate news. Meanwhile, after a nasty fall at the crime scene, Clive is forced to continue his part of the investigation via FaceTime. Lastly, things are suddenly going from bad to worse for Blaine.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E06 - The Scratchmaker
5.plot: After consuming the brain of the ultimate matchmaker, Liv is determined to find the perfect match for Major. Meanwhile, Blaine will stoop to any level to protect himself. Lastly, Don E contemplates an interesting offer.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E07 - Filleted to Rest
5.plot: While investigating the murder of Eleanor Barba, a chef at a high-end restaurant, Liv consumes her brain and becomes an unrelenting perfectionist who knows just how to break a person to their very core. Meanwhile, Major is on a mission to find out who is betraying the commander.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E08 - Death of a Car Salesman
5.plot: Liv and Ravi each consume the brain of a very dislikable car salesman and inherit his competitive nature.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E09 - The Fresh Princess
5.plot: Liv and Clive investigate the murder of Miss Teen Seattle beauty pageant contestant, Laurie-Beth Spano, who went into anaphylactic shock onstage in 1999 and ended up in a coma. At the time, police arrested rival contender Velma Charlet for spiking Laurie-Beth's makeup and she was given a four-year sentence. In present day, Laurie-Beth has passed away and Clive has arrested Velma, for her murder. Velma claims to be innocent and Liv consumes Laurie-Beth's brain in hopes of tracking down the murderer.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E10 - Night and the Zombie City
5.plot: While investigating the murder of private eye Mick Chisel, who was stabbed in the head with an ice pick, Liv consumes Chisel’s brain in hopes of breaking down how this gruesome murder took place.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E11 - Killer Queen
5.plot: Liv and Clive investigate the death of an old school drag queen which leads Liv to eat and shift into the queen’s brain. Meanwhile, Ravi reaches out to Major with an interesting request.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E12 - Bye, Zombies
5.plot: While Major faces a changing of the tide in Seattle, Liv, Clive and Ravi undertake a mission impossible in Atlanta to retrieve the final zombie cure.

5.title: FR - iZombie - S05E13 - All's Well That Ends Well
5.plot: As Liv, Ravi and Clive race to finalize the cure, Peyton faces a showdown with Blaine, and Major takes a bold gamble to save Seattle once and for all.

meta.plot: Olivia Moore, surnommée Liv, une étudiante transformée en zombie lors d'une soirée qui a très mal tourné, travaille en tant que médecin légiste afin de pouvoir profiter du festin que représentent pour elle les cervelles des défunts. A chaque bouchée, elle hérite des souvenirs de la personne. Cherchant désespérément un sens à sa vie, elle se rend compte qu'avec l'aide du détective Clive Babinaux, elle peut résoudre les affaires de meurtres et calmer ainsi les voix qui la tourmentent dans sa tête...

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E01 - Vote for Me
1.plot: It's Election Day, and Antoinette hopes to finish her campaign on a high note. But when a video of her teen daughter goes viral, things get complicated.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E02 - Every Woman
1.plot: The excitement of Antoinette's first day on the job quickly turns to frustration, as Governor Harper and his staff sideline her.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E03 - Lay of the Land
1.plot: The family moves into the lieutenant governor's mansion, which is haunted by the past in more ways than one. Antoinette visits a county fair.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E04 - Little White Lies
1.plot: Antoinette fights for the governor's attention. When Lola's Olympic dreams don't match up to reality, the family divides over whether to tell her.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E05 - Jar of Hearts
1.plot: After being forced into another disastrous public appearance, Antoinette seeks other ways to make an impact. Shamika stands up to the governor's staff.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E06 - Getting Adjusted
1.plot: Antoinette faces crises on multiple fronts, as she tries to convince the governor to move the pipeline and wavers on how to handle Michael's note.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E07 - Taking Charge
1.plot: A trio of pipeline activists hold Antoinette's feet to the fire, while a heart-to-heart with Michael leaves her hot and bothered.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E08 - Standing on Business
1.plot: With her friends uniting behind her, Antoinette puts it all on the line at a contentious press conference with the governor.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E09 - Thoughts & Prayers
1.plot: As the governor's staff scrambles to hide his status from Antoinette, Basil and Shamika go on an undercover mission to learn the truth.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E10 - Pardon Me
1.plot: Antoinette's excitement at getting pardon power is dampened when her family starts asking for favors. Lola uses her mom's fame as leverage at school.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E11 - Black Excellence
1.plot: Antoinette tries to ally with three state senators — if she can only get Henry out of the way. Basil gets off to a rough start at the police academy.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E12 - Hot Mike
1.plot: It's chaos at the mansion when a national news show drops in to interview Antoinette — and Lola attempts to sabotage it.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E13 - Take a Number
1.plot: Shamika and Danny try to extract a confession from Lola. A conspiracy-addled constituent causes trouble at the office.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E14 - This Means War
1.plot: At a retreat for Southern governors, Antoinette struggles to win over her traditionalist colleagues. Back at home, Jed goes on the offensive.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E15 - Deaf Threats
1.plot: Antoinette's pipeline victory makes her a target for some unusual activism. Jed tries to lure Shamika into changing allegiances.

1.title: FR - She the People - S01E16 - State of Emergency
1.plot: With the governorship on the line, Antoinette and her colleagues are called to testify in a chaotic State Senate hearing.

meta.plot: Alors qu'elle tente de se distinguer en politique, la première lieutenante-gouverneure noire du Mississippi doit gérer sa famille farfelue et triompher d'un patron rétrograde.

Au XXVe siècle, la Terre fait partie de l’Union Planétaire : une civilisation étendue, avancée et surtout pacifique, possédant une flotte de plus de trois mille navires. Parmi eux, l'Orville, un vaisseau d'exploration, dirigé par l’officier Ed Mercer, déterminé à prouver sa valeur et à écrire un nouveau chapitre dans sa vie, épaulé par son équipage excentrique. Tous ensemble, ils vont vivre des aventures fascinantes et parfois dangereuses, rythmées par des relations personnelles tumultueuses.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E01 - Old Wounds
1.plot: It's 2417, and the Planetary Union promotes Ed Mercer to Captain of the exploratory vessel The U.S.S. Orville. Ed's enthusiasm for his new position is dampened when his ex-wife, Kelly Grayson, is assigned to be his First Officer. While on their first routine mission, the Orville crew is ambushed by the Krill, a vicious alien race, who are bent on stealing a device that can cause time to accelerate.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E02 - Command Performance
1.plot: When Ed and Kelly are tricked by a hologram of a ship in distress and find themselves prisoners in a replica of their former home, Alara must step up in her first command of the Orville and attempt a heroic rescue. Meanwhile, Bortus and Klyden receive some happy, yet unexpected news.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E03 - About a Girl
1.plot: The Orville crew is divided between cultures when Bortus and Klyden debate if their newly born offspring should receive a controversial surgery.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E04 - If the Stars Should Appear
1.plot: Ed and the Orville crew encounter a massive vessel adrift in space, which is in danger of colliding with a star. While some of the crew set out to help the ship's inhabitants, Bortus, Gordon, and John stay behind and fend off a Krill attack on another Union ship

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E05 - Pria
1.plot: After the crew saves a stranded ship and its attractive captain, Ed becomes smitten with the Orville’s new guest, while Kelly suspects all is not what it seems. Meanwhile, Gordon attempts to teach Isaac the art of pulling off a practical joke.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E06 - Krill
1.plot: After the Orville crew defeats a Krill attack on a brand-new colony, the Union sends Ed and Gordon on a dangerous undercover mission to infiltrate a Krill ship and obtain a copy of the Krill bible, the "Anhkana," to better understand the enemy.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E07 - Majority Rule
1.plot: When two Union anthropologists go missing on a planet similar to 21st century Earth, Ed sends a team led by Kelly to find them, but the mission quickly goes awry when they realize the society’s government is completely based on a public voting system to determine punishment.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E08 - Into the Fold
1.plot: Ed and the crew set out to save Dr. Finn, her two sons and Isaac after their shuttle gets thrown into uncharted space and they crash-land on a moon that is light years from the Orville.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E09 - Cupid's Dagger
1.plot: The Orville is called to mediate a peace treaty between two warring cultures, but tensions run even higher between Ed and Kelly when a familiar face boards the ship. Meanwhile Yaphit declares his love for Dr. Finn with surprising results.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E11 - New Dimensions
1.plot: Kelly discovers that Lt. John Lamarr is smarter than he lets on. So, she pushes Ed to consider him for a key leadership position on the ship after The Orville gets damaged by a mysterious spatial anomaly causing harrowing effects to all things living.

1.title: FR - The Orville - S01E12 - Mad Idolatry
1.plot: Ed and Kelly consider the possibility of reforging their relationship, but Kelly soon crash-lands on a planet in another universe with Isaac and Gordon.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E01 - Ja'loja
2.plot: As The Orville heads towards Moclus for Bortus' special once-a-year ceremony, Ed discovers Kelly has moved on and has started dating. Meanwhile, Gordon asks for John's help in getting game, and Claire turns to Isaac for parenting advice.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E02 - Primal Urges
2.plot: Ed and the crew race to save a small group of survivors on a planet about to be destroyed by its sun. Meanwhile, Bortus and Klyden start marriage counseling when Bortus' obsession with the ship's simulation room gets out of hand.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E03 - Home
2.plot: Ed, Gordon and Alara visit Alara's home planet of Xelayah.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E04 - Nothing Left on Earth Excepting Fishes
2.plot: Ed finds himself behind enemy lines when he crash-lands on a mysterious planet. Meanwhile, Kelly questions why Gordon wants to take the Command Test.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E05 - All the World is Birthday Cake
2.plot: The Orville makes First Contact and a new crew member joins the ship.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E06 - A Happy Refrain
2.plot: The Orville crew is surprised when Claire's personal life takes an unexpected turn, and Gordon makes an unusual grooming suggestion to Bortus.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E07 - Deflectors
2.plot: One of Bortus's old lovers is assigned to help upgrade the ships defences and makes a surprising admission to Talla.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E08 - Identity (1)
2.plot: Ed and the crew travel to Isaac's home planet, Kaylon.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E09 - Identity (2)
2.plot: The Kaylons take control of the Orville with the intention of destroying all biological lifeforms.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E10 - Blood of Patriots
2.plot: Ed must initiate peace talks with the Krill.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E11 - Lasting Impressions
2.plot: The Orville crew members open a time capsule from 2015.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E12 - Sanctuary
2.plot: Ed discovers that Moclans aboard The Orville are harboring a secret.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E13 - Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
2.plot: A time distortion affects Ed and Kelly's relationship.

2.title: FR - The Orville - S02E14 - The Road Not Taken
2.plot: The crew must contend with the disastrous fallout from Kelly's decision.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E01 - Electric Sheep
3.plot: The Orville crew deals with the interpersonal aftermath of the battle against the Kaylon.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E02 - Shadow Realms
3.plot: The Orville explores a mysterious region of space.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E03 - Mortality Paradox
3.plot: The Orville crew makes a new discovery.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E04 - Gently Falling Rain
3.plot: The Orville crew leads a Union delegation to sign a peace treaty with the Krill.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E05 - A Tale of Two Topas
3.plot: Tensions between Kelly and the Moclans result when she helps Topa prepare for the Union Point entrance exam.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E06 - Twice in a Lifetime
3.plot: The crew must rescue Gordon from a distant yet familiar world.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E07 - From Unknown Graves
3.plot: The Orville discovers a Kaylon with a very special ability.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E08 - Midnight Blue
3.plot: The crew visit Haveena's sanctuary world and embark on a journey that may leave the Union more vulnerable.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E09 - Domino
3.plot: The creation of a powerful new weapon puts the Orville crew — and the entire Union — in a political and ethical quandary.

3.title: FR - The Orville - S03E10 - Future Unknown
3.plot: A celebration is underway aboard the ship.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The residents of Chester's Mill find themselves trapped under an enormous, transparent dome.  Panic escalates as resources dwindle rapidly.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E02 - The Fire
1.plot: Following Duke's death, his house catches fire, forcing the town to rally together to form a bucket brigade. Elsewhere, Junior ambushes Barbie, while Dodee and Phil pick up a military frequency.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E03 - Manhunt
1.plot: When a former deputy goes rogue, Big Jim recruits Barbie to join the manhunt to keep the town safe. Meanwhile, Junior is determined to escape the Dome by going underground.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E04 - Outbreak
1.plot: The people of Chester's Mill panicked state when a meningitis outbreak hits the community, threatening the already scarce supply of drugs. Meanwhile, Julia continues to seek answers to her husband's disappearance

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E05 - Blue on Blue
1.plot: The Chester's Mill residents receive an unexpected visit from their loved ones on the other side. Meanwhile, the community braces for a threat from outside the Dome.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E06 - The Endless Thirst
1.plot: When the town begins to run low on water, the residents of Chester's Mill begin to fight for the remaining resources. Meanwhile, Julia discovers a strange connection that two of the town's residents have with the Dome.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E07 - Imperfect Circles
1.plot: Big Jim takes matters into his own hands when he feels his authority slipping away, and the Dome displays its power when a life is taken just as a newborn arrives.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E08 - Thicker Than Water
1.plot: Junior stands up to his father and is shattered when he discovers the truth about his mother's past. Meanwhile, Julia learns firsthand the powers of the "mini dome."

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E09 - The Fourth Hand
1.plot: Barbie and Big Jim realize their lives are more intertwined than they knew when a mysterious woman makes an appearance in Chester's Mill.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E10 - Let the Games Begin
1.plot: Julia uncovers the truth about her husband's disappearance and unravels some of Chester's Mill's darkest secrets. Meanwhile, Maxine shows Barbie how she plans to take control of the town.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E11 - Speak of the Devil
1.plot: Big Jim turns the town against Barbie when the truth about his past is revealed. Meanwhile, Maxine makes it personal when she confronts Barbie’s closest ally.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E12 - Exigent Circumstances
1.plot: While the manhunt for Barbie continues, Big Jim gets the residents of Chester’s Mill riled up and the town demands justice for all of Barbie’s supposed crimes. Meanwhile, Joe and Norrie must find a new hiding place for the mini dome.

1.title: FR - Under the Dome - S01E13 - Curtains
1.plot: Secrets of the Dome are revealed and Big Jim is determined to put an end to Barbie once and for all. Meanwhile, Junior, Angie, Joe and Norrie discover who the Monarch is after receiving a shocking visit from a familiar face.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E01 - Heads Will Roll
2.plot: Barbie's life is in Big Jim's hands; the dome becomes magnetized; Julia tries to save the life of a mysterious girl who may have clues about the origin of the dome.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E02 - Infestation
2.plot: When Rebecca discovers an infestation of butterfly eggs on the crops, Barbie risks his life to help her save the town's food supply.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E03 - Force Majeure
2.plot: Big Jim conducts a census to see how long the town can survive on dwindling resources; acid rain threatens everyone.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E04 - Revelation
2.plot: Rebecca and Big Jim consider extreme measures as the conditions worsen in Chester's Mill; clues about Melanie's connection to the dome are revealed.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E05 - Reconciliation
2.plot: After Big Jim and Rebecca's plan left the town divided, Julia takes over as the leader of Chester's Mill; Norrie and Joe help Melanie find more clues.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E06 - In the Dark
2.plot: A cave-in severs Barbie and Sam's path back to Chester's Mill during their investigation of a mysterious tunnel; a dust storm rages through the town, as Big Jim and Julia face off in a power struggle.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E07 - Going Home
2.plot: As Barbie descends further into the mysterious tunnel in hope of finding Sam, he comes across a world filled with unanswered questions.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E08 - Awakening
2.plot: Barbie turns to his father for help contacting Julia but realizes that he may not be trustworthy; Big Jim declares himself sheriff of Chester's Mill.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E09 - The Red Door
2.plot: Barbie is apprehended by mysterious men and relentlessly interrogated about the Dome; Big Jim forms a deal that could permanently seal the fate of the Chester's Mill residents.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E10 - The Fall
2.plot: Big Jim finally learns what happened to his wife, Pauline; Chester's Mill faces a new threat -- climate change.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E11 - Black Ice
2.plot: Rebecca and Sam try to save Chester's Mill residents as temperatures plunge; Barbie puts his life at risk to help Julia after a terrible accident.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E12 - Turn
2.plot: The latest threat intensifies, leaving Chester's Mill residents at risk of being crushed to death; Melanie's health declines as the egg's fate remains uncertain.

2.title: FR - Under the Dome - S02E13 - Go Now
2.plot: Just as the walls start to close in on those trapped in Chester's Mill, a possible exit from the dome is revealed.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E01 - Move On
3.plot: A year after the dome disappears, Barbie, Joe, and the other townspeople gather for a memorial. A year earlier, Julia and Junior try to rescue Barbie and the others, but run afoul of Big Jim.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E02 - But I'm Not
3.plot: Barbie investigates Ben's claim that something strange is going on in Chester's Mill, but Eva surprises him with unexpected news. Meanwhile, Norrie and Hunter grow closer, and Christine advises Joe to move on.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E03 - Redux
3.plot: The residents of Chester’s Mill try to move on with their lives in the aftermath of their mysterious experience in the tunnels beneath town. Meanwhile, Big Jim suspects new residents Christine and Eva are keeping secrets concerning the Dome.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E04 - The Kinship
3.plot: Under the guise of helping Chester’s Mill rebuild, Christine urges the townspeople towards specific individuals and projects that remind them of their experience in the tunnels. Also, Julia and Big Jim make shocking discoveries that reveal a new threat within the Dome.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E05 - Alaska
3.plot: Big Jim and Julia form a tentative alliance to search for proof that will discredit Christine, which leads them to new information about the Dome’s capabilities. Meanwhile, when tensions run high in town and threaten Christine’s leadership, she puts a plan in play that has deadly consequences.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E06 - Caged
3.plot: When Big Jim is captured by Aktaion, the dangerous private corporation that’s descended on Chester’s Mill to harness the Dome’s energy capabilities, he’s forced to manipulate Christine for information about her agenda. Also, when Joe and Norrie question the town’s new rules, they find themselves in a dangerous face-off with the increasingly unstable residents.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E07 - Ejecta
3.plot: As the world outside the Dome is rocked by a catastrophic meteor shower, unexpected alliances form inside the barrier. Eva tries to indoctrinate Barbie deeper into The Kinship and Big Jim and Julia turn to one another while isolated on Bird Island outside of town. Also, Joe is forced to accept help from Sam, the man who killed his sister.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E08 - Breaking Point
3.plot: Big Jim, Julia, Joe, Norrie and Hunter join together to form a resistance against Christine, who is mobilizing residents to work on a massive excavation project in the caves underneath the town. Also, Hunter uses his tech skills to contact the outside world.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E09 - Plan B
3.plot: Big Jim and Julia devise plans to end Christine’s control over the town by initiating a life-or-death plot involving Barbie and Eva, while Joe and Norrie conduct research to better understand the Dome’s ultimate agenda. Meanwhile, Hunter finds more information about the true head of Aktaion, the nefarious private corporation that wants to harness the Dome’s energy.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E10 - Legacy
3.plot: The Resistance, the citizens not under Christine’s control, join forces with an unexpected ally: Hektor Martin, the nefarious head of Aktaion. Despite Hektor revealing more about the Dome’s origins and helping to strike back at it, Big Jim and Julia still worry he will betray them. Meanwhile, Hunter receives encrypted files that give disturbing insights into the final effect the Dome will have on the infected townspeople.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E11 - Love is a Battlefield
3.plot: Members of The Resistance race to release their loved ones from Christine’s influence before she reaches her end game for the Dome. While Barbie risks everything in an attempt to free Eva from the Kinship, Big Jim and Julia are enlisted by Hektor, the head of Aktaion, to test a possible cure for infected townspeople. Also, Joe chooses to work with Christine after she shares some shocking information about the entity behind the Dome.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E12 - Incandescence
3.plot: When the Dome’s calcification process accelerates, Chester’s Mill has 24 hours before the barrier’s breakdown will suffocate everyone inside. While the new deadline puts added pressure on Joe to bring the Dome down, Barbie and Julia race to save his child from The Kinship. Also, Big Jim tries to manage the increasingly volatile Hektor, who is adamant that infected townspeople never escape the Dome.

3.title: FR - Under the Dome - S03E13 - The Enemy Within
3.plot: Series Finale: As the Dome in Chester's Mill comes down, the Resistance makes a final attempt to protect the outside world from the infected townspeople in the Kinship and their new queen.

meta.plot: D'après le roman du même nom de Stephen King, cette émission suit les habitants de Chester's Mill, une petite ville des États-Unis où les événements exceptionnels sont rares. Mais un jour, un dôme invisible apparaît et englobe toute la ville. Les habitants sont pris au piège et ne peuvent plus sortir de la ville, et personne ne peut y entrer. Ils doivent dorénavant se soutenir mutuellement pour traverser cette épreuve, mais l'isolement du monde extérieur mettra à rude épreuve la communauté.

À Fortitude, une petite ville au cœur de l'Arctique jusqu'ici tranquille, les habitants sont secoués par le meurtre violent d'un scientifique britannique. Le shérif local Dan Anderssen mène l'enquête avec le détective anglais Milton Caldwell.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: In the remote Arctic town of Fortitude, two children make a remarkable find, while the discovery of a horrific crime brings a new arrival to the island that complicates Sheriff Dan Anderssen’s investigation.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E02 - Episode 2

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Dan and Frank go in search of a suspect; however, Dan's feelings for Elena are threatening to overwhelm him. Morton, meanwhile, uncovers a new piece of evidence.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Following Dan's loss of control, Morton takes over the murder investigation. Elsewhere, Elena's mysterious past is about to catch up with her.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Shock waves reverberate around Fortitude as the killer is revealed, while Morton tunes his attention to the death of a scientist on the island months earlier.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E06 - Episode 6

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E07 - Episode 7

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: While Frank takes the law into his own hands, DCI Morton closes in on the truth about Pettigrew's death. Vincent and Natalie also make a discovery.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: DCI Morton pursues Henry Tyson into the Arctic wilderness in search of the truth, while worrying test results force Governor Odegard to take drastic action.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: In the penultimate episode, the truth about Billy Pettigrew is revealed. In the lab, Natalie and Vincent probe the cause of the disturbing events in Fortitude.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: The chilling thriller concludes with a dramatic and emotional finale. Vincent faces a life-threatening situation, while Dan must make a devastating decision.

1.title: FR - Fortitude - S01E12 -
FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E01 - Nimue

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E02 - Cursed
1.plot: Shaken and alone, Nimue presses ahead on her quest, as flashbacks reveal a harrowing encounter years ago that changed the course of her life.

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E03 - Alone
1.plot: Waking in an abbey, Nimue finds herself surrounded by strangers and forced to tend to Red Paladins. Arthur sets out on an adventure of his own.

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E04 - The Red Lake
1.plot: On her way to Gramaire, Nimue learns of a thriving Fey resistance. Merlin butters up Lord Rugen. Iris grows suspicious of Morgana.

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E05 - The Joining
1.plot: Morgana urges Nimue to use the sword for leverage, Father Carden faces a bitter humiliation, and Uther loses patience with Merlin.

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E06 - Festa and Moreii

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E07 - Bring Us In Good Ale
1.plot: While Nimue, Morgana and Kaze seek refuge in an ancient web of tunnels, Arthur and Gawain fend off a siege led by the Weeping Monk.

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E08 - The Fey Queen
1.plot: With Red Paladins closing in on the Fey hideout, Nimue hatches a bold plan to buy time and secure an escape for her people.

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E09 - Poisons
1.plot: Nimue weighs a fateful decision, Uther takes a defiant step, and Gawain discovers not all is what it seems within the Red Paladin camp.

1.title: FR - Cursed : La rebelle - S01E10 - The Sacrifice
1.plot: With the future of the Fey hanging in the balance and enemies closing in from all sides, Nimue sets in motion the final pieces of her plan.

meta.plot: Alors qu'une armée sanguinaire cherche à anéantir la magie, une jeune femme dotée de pouvoirs secrets affronte son destin pour sauver son peuple, épée à la main.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E01 - You'd Know What to Do
1.plot: After the battle of Acre, we join the Knights Templar in Paris where Landry, a veteran of the Holy Wars, fears that the Order has lost its way. When the blood of a brother is shed, Landry and the Templars are forced to take up their swords again.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E02 - Find Us the Grail
1.plot: Landry and Parsifal search for a killer. The unexpected arrival of Pope Boniface in Paris threatens De Nogaret's carefully laid plans.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E03 - The Black Wolf and the White Wolf
1.plot: On the Pope's orders, Landry and Tancrede travel to investigate the Holy Grail's whereabouts.  Meanwhile, the plotting behind the royal wedding becomes deadly.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E04 - He Who Discovers His Own Self, Discovers God
1.plot: A pagan helps Landry search his past. Gawain conducts a murder investigation. Princess Isabella is betrayed.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E05 - Hard Blows Will Banish The Sin
1.plot: Tensions are high during Isabella’s wedding preparations, and fearing an attack, King Philip asks Landry and the Knights Templar for their help in protecting the palace.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E06 - The Pilgrimage of Chains
1.plot: Landry is kidnapped and tortured by a mysterious group; a Knight is expelled from the Templars; De Nogaret builds an army; Princess Isabella discovers who betrayed her.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E07 - And Certainly Not The Cripple
1.plot: Landry and Gawain meet a mysterious woman who claims she can lead them to the Grail; Joan hears of an attack on Navarre; De Nogaret devises a way to improve his standing with King Philip.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E08 - IV
1.plot: The Paris Temple of the Knights Templar is under siege; De Nogaret plants doubt in King Philip's mind; Queen Joan must decide what is best for Navarre.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E09 - Fiat!
1.plot: Landry seeks the help of Jacques de Molay, the Temple Grand Master; Queen Joan plots her escape.

1.title: FR - Knightfall - S01E10 - Do You See the Blue?
1.plot: Vastly outnumbered, the Templar Knights must fight for their lives in a battle with the Red Knights.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E01 - God's Executioners
2.plot: Banished from the Knights Templar after the discovery of his affair with Queen Joan, Landry must work to redeem himself under the watchful eye of a mysterious veteran of the Crusades. King Philip formulates a plan to take action against the Templars, while dealing with the return of his erratic, eldest son, Prince Louis.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E02 - The Devil Inside
2.plot: Now back in the Knights Templar Order as an Initiate, Landry continues his training under the harsh guidance of Talus, the battle-hardened Initiate master. DeNogaret implores King Philip to build a legal case against the Knights, seeking the aid of a former Templar to help carry out his plan. Prince Louis is tasked with a shocking secret mission.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E03 - Faith
2.plot: After suffering a casualty, the Knights Templar prepare to exact revenge.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E04 - Equal Before God
2.plot: A mysterious knight arrives at Chartres Temple and brings the Knights Templar devastating news. Louis struggles to produce an heir, creating a rift between he and his wife. King Philip sends Gawain on a mission where he comes face to face with his former Templar brothers.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E05 - Road To Chartres
2.plot: Landry reunites with his daughter, only to be separated once again. Growing impatient with DeNogaret’s legal strategy, King Philip prepares his army for war. Margaret discovers one of Prince Louis’ dark secrets.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E06 - Blood Drenched Stone
2.plot: King Philip launches a massive attack on the Chartres Temple, igniting a battle that will determine the fate of the Knights Templar.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E07 - Death Awaits
2.plot: Captured and brought back to Paris, the Knights Templar must stand trial for heresy.

2.title: FR - Knightfall - S02E08 - While I Breathe, I Trust the Cross
2.plot: The death of the Knights Templar Order is imminent as Landry and his Templar brothers are sentenced to burn at the stake.

meta.plot: Au Moyen Âge, l'ordre du Temple est l'ordre militaire le plus puissant, le plus riche et mystérieux. Parmi ses missions, la protection de la si précieuse relique du Christianisme - le Graal Saint - et la préservation d'immenses secrets jalousement gardés. De leurs relations complexes avec le Roi de France à la trahison qui va provoquer la chute des Templiers, focus sur cette fraternité légendaire de moines guerriers...

1.title: FR - Sirens - S01E01 - Exile
1.plot: Furious that her sister Simone won't return her calls, Devon heads to an island enclave to find her — and into the clutches of her controlling boss.

1.title: FR - Sirens - S01E02 - Talons
1.plot: Stymied by Michaela, Devon makes a bold move to remain in Simone's orbit. Simone and Michaela's bond is tested as secrets begin to surface.

1.title: FR - Sirens - S01E03 - Monster
1.plot: Devon gains deeper insight into Michaela's unique magnetism. With Ethan out of reach, Simone finds herself on Peter's trail instead.

1.title: FR - Sirens - S01E04 - Persephone
1.plot: The chaos Devon left behind in Buffalo catches up with her. Simone must decide her own future. Michaela investigates Peter's phone.

1.title: FR - Sirens - S01E05 - Siren Song
1.plot: As the gala kicks off, the conflict between Michaela and Simone comes to a head. Peter has a realization. Devon considers her options.

meta.plot: Inquiète de voir sa sœur sous la coupe de sa patronne milliardaire, une femme un peu paumée cherche à comprendre ce qu'il se passe dans une luxueuse propriété de front de mer.
Global sports and entertainment superstars Jake and Logan Paul are pulling back the curtain for their latest venture: a family reality TV show.

1.title: EN - Paul American [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After conquering internet stardom and taking on sports entertainment, Jake and Logan Paul venture into unfamiliar territory: a family reality show.

1.title: EN - Paul American [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: While preparing to defend his WWE championship belt, Logan learns he's going to be a dad, and Jake trains for his most hardcore boxing matchup yet.

1.title: EN - Paul American [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: After his fight against Mike Tyson is postponed, Jake and his team regroup to find a new opponent … with only seven weeks' notice. Meanwhile, Logan and Nina head to Italy for their babymoon and to search for potential wedding venues.

1.title: EN - Paul American [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Jake invites Greg on an ayahuasca trip to work through the family’s complicated past. Logan grapples with downtime while on baby watch with Nina.

1.title: EN - Paul American [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7

1.title: EN - Paul American [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: While Logan and Nina settle into their new roles as dad and mom, an ankle injury throws Jake’s fight with Mike Tyson into jeopardy – and forces him to reckon with everything he’s worked for.

meta.plot: When Hampton is released from prison, his long-awaited family reunion doesn't quite go as he hoped. In his absence, Hampton's wife and sons formed an unconventional family unit, and his return spins their world into chaos.

1.title: EN - Government Cheese [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Gospel of Kenny Sharp

1.title: EN - Government Cheese [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Two Doors
1.plot: Astoria enjoys a night out on the town, and Hampton gets sidetracked.

1.title: EN - Government Cheese [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Long Road Home
1.plot: The Chambers kids embark on a quest, while Hampton kills two birds with one stone.

1.title: EN - Government Cheese [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Father Facts, Figures, and Failures
1.plot: Hampton coaxes Harrison into some father-son bonding at Lake Piru.

1.title: EN - Government Cheese [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Parable of Drawing in the Net
1.plot: On day two of the fishing trip, Hampton faces some unexpected consequences.

1.title: EN - Government Cheese [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Woman on the Roof
1.plot: During a rare moment of solitude, Astoria attempts to work on her design portfolio.

1.title: EN - Government Cheese [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - An Evening with Abraham Cohen
1.plot: Hampton makes a difficult decision. Astoria takes another leap of faith.

meta.plot: Alessandro Cattelan searches for happiness through interviews and unique experiences with celebrity guests like Paolo Sorrentino and Roberto Baggio.

1.title: EN - Alessandro Cattelan: One Simple Question [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - How do you find happiness?
1.plot: Alessandro begins his search with soccer legend Roberto Baggio, who's also a practicing Buddhist and a maker and collector of rather unusual objects.

1.title: EN - Alessandro Cattelan: One Simple Question [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Does having faith make us happy?
1.plot: Alessandro tests his beliefs with filmmaker Paolo Sorrentino. Which religion is best? If he goes bungee jumping, will his life pass before him?

1.title: EN - Alessandro Cattelan: One Simple Question [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Is there happiness in pain?
1.plot: Alessandro plays golf with Gianluca Vialli, an ex-soccer player who had to reconsider his mortality when he was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.

1.title: EN - Alessandro Cattelan: One Simple Question [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Does love make us happy?
1.plot: Alessandro and comedian Geppi Cucciari attend a Catholic camp with engaged couples to see if love is the answer. Then, Ale hangs out with his porn pals.

1.title: EN - Alessandro Cattelan: One Simple Question [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - What else could I want to be happy?
1.plot: To find out what's it like to have everything you want at your fingertips, Alessandro and Francesco Mandelli spend the night in a high-end supermarket.

1.title: EN - Alessandro Cattelan: One Simple Question [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Can happiness be a choice?
1.plot: After a lecture from happiness expert Mo Gawdat, Alessandro gets a fleeting moment of it in the most unexpected place.

meta.plot: In this documentary series, Aitana reveals intimate moments and reflects on her journey from regular teen to international pop sensation.

1.title: EN - Aitana: Metamorphosis [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Success
1.plot: Aitana shares childhood memories as she experiences fame in her hometown. In Los Angeles, she and Sebastián Yatra reveal the truth behind "Akureyri."

1.title: EN - Aitana: Metamorphosis [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Fear
1.plot: After rejecting a proposal from her team, Aitana opens up about her fears and health anxiety. In Mexico, she discusses how astrology influences her life.

1.title: EN - Aitana: Metamorphosis [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Identity
1.plot: A gig with Nicki Nicole leads to a birthday celebration with Aitana's friends and parents, who reflect on how "Operación Triunfo" impacted her life.

1.title: EN - Aitana: Metamorphosis [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Home
1.plot: Aitana returns to her high school to reminisce about simpler times. Struggling with press intrusion, she looks for an escape after her breakup.

1.title: EN - Aitana: Metamorphosis [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Create
1.plot: Enjoying her first summer single in Ibiza with friends, Aitana takes inspiration from recent experiences to LA and works on her most personal album yet.

1.title: EN - Aitana: Metamorphosis [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Perfection
1.plot: After the Bernabéu concerts are canceled, Aitana picks herself up in her new home in Miami — but she soon feels lonelier and more vulnerable than ever.

meta.plot: An aspiring stand-up comedian turns her struggles into heartfelt humor as she balances work and relationships while caring for her aging father.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Time Is A Butcher's Knife
1.plot: Frustrated by work and her father's whimsy, Le-le channels her struggles into stand-up comedy — but things take a turn following an unexpected diagnosis.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Most Difficult Person, Me
1.plot: Kuang-chi's carefree nature makes Le-le wish he were like other dads, but his support becomes invaluable when she faces a tough time at work.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - When Did We Fall Out Of Love?
1.plot: As Le-le revisits her whirlwind romance with Chang Kai, she reflects on the nature of relationships with her best friends and her father.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Reserved Seat
1.plot: When Le-le uncovers a devastating secret about her mother's disappearance, she reflects on their final moments together before she left.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - No Other Choice
1.plot: After losing a longtime cycling buddy, Kuang-chi considers the fleeting nature of life. Her father's latest check-up leaves Le-le with a tough decision.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Delirium
1.plot: At the hospital, Le-le tries to find out what caused her dad's sudden change in behavior. Later, Chang Kai reaches out with an unexpected question.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Rain That Won't Stop Anytime Soon
1.plot: Le-le spends more time with Kuang-chi, and her work at the convenience store and comedy career suffer setbacks as her list of responsibilities grows.

1.title: EN - Forget You Not [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - If You Forget, I Will Remember It All For You
1.plot: Exhausted from caregiving, Le-le breaks down in front of Kuang-chi. But his love and her friends' support help her bounce back.

meta.plot: Formée dès son plus jeune âge par son père apothicaire, Mao Mao est un jour vendue comme servante au palais de l'empereur. Prisonnière dans les arcanes du pouvoir, elle attire l’attention de Jinshi, un séduisant haut fonctionnaire qui la promeut lorsqu’il découvre son talent pour confectionner des potions. Désormais goûteuse, Mao Mao met ses connaissances au service des gens du palais pour les soigner, mais aussi pour déjouer les mystères et les complots qui se trament...

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E01 - Maomao
1.plot: After being kidnapped and forced to work as a servant in the rear palace, former apothecary Maomao inadvertently draws the attention of the higher ranks when she investigates what's causing the emperor's infant heirs to fall mysteriously ill.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E02 - Chilly Apothecary
1.plot: Maomao tries to settle into her promotion to lady-in-waiting and food taster, but struggles to fend off both boredom and the overly-familiar Jinshi. That is, until she gets an assignment of her dreams: to concoct an aphrodisiac.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E03 - The Unsettling Matter of the Spirit
1.plot: Tasked with investigating a ghostly woman dancing nightly on the palace walls, Maomao finds a sleepwalking Concubine Fuyou. But with no medicinal cure for sleepwalking, she's forced to dig deeper to find the real reason behind Fuyou's affliction.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E04 - The Threat
1.plot: Under direct orders from the emperor himself, Maomao tries to care for an ailing Concubine Lihua, but finds her work impeded by Lihua's own ladies-in-waiting.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E05 - Covert Operations
1.plot: A eunuch stricken by a curse comes begging for aid. Meanwhile, the rear palace buzzes with excitement as everyone prepares for the upcoming garden party, and Gyokuyou's ladies-in-waiting aren't about to let Maomao get away without dressing her up.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E06 - The Garden Party
1.plot: Maomao does her best to navigate the complex social situations at the garden party, including meeting the other Upper First rank concubines. But once she settles down to do her work as a food-taster, she discovers a surprise in a bowl of soup.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E07 - Homecoming
1.plot: Gaoshun goes to Maomao to get her help in resolving the events of the garden party. Later, Xiaolan explains the purpose of the hairpins Maomao was gifted, and Maomao makes a deal with Lihaku in order to finally visit home.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E08 - Wheat Stalks
1.plot: Maomao's peaceful morning at home is interrupted when she's called in to investigate an apparent double suicide at one of the local brothels.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E09 - Suicide or Murder?
1.plot: An older acquaintance of Jinshi's dies while drinking at a party. A servant's body turns up in a moat. Both deaths are written off as self-inflicted, but Maomao's keen observations tell her that there's more to both stories.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E10 - Honey
1.plot: A tea party hosted by Lady Gyokuyou puts the politics of the rear palace at the forefront, and Maomao learns something new about Lady Lishu. His true intentions unclear, Jinshi sends Maomao to work for Lady Ah-Duo.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E11 - Reducing Two to One
1.plot: Maomao confronts Fengming about the dark secret she's been hiding from her noble Lady Ah-Duo.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E12 - The Eunuch and the Courtesan
1.plot: Discovering that Maomao's kidnappers were connected to Fengming's family, Jinshi is faced with a choice between keeping Maomao in the rear palace where he can be near her or releasing her from her service.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E13 - Serving in the Outer Court
1.plot: To Maomao's surprise, Jinshi brings her directly to his house instead of taking her back to the rear palace, and tells her she's to work in the outer court. Not only is there much to learn, it seems there's many eyes on her as the new hire.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E14 - The New Pure Consort
1.plot: Ah-Duo's replacement has arrived in the rear palace, and Maomao is assigned to give a certain lecture to all four high concubines. Later, Maomao helps Lihaku investigate a warehouse explosion.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E15 - Raw Fish
1.plot: Gaoshun requests Maomao's help in solving an apparent poisoning case. Meanwhile, Jinshi deals with an unwelcome visitor who's taken to lingering in his office.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E16 - Lead
1.plot: A shack, a chest of drawers, and a fishbowl are all that a talented metalworker leaves to his three sons upon his death. Maomao is assigned to investigate how these strange inheritances all fit together.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E17 - A Jaunt Around Town
1.plot: Covering up Jinshi's otherworldly beauty is no easy task, but after Maomao takes the challenge head-on, she's surprised when she's also asked to don the disguise of a noblewoman and escort "Jinka" outside the palace.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E18 - Lakan
1.plot: Back at home, Maomao visits an annex building at the Verdigris House that hides one of the brothel's secrets. Lakan continues to antagonize Jinshi as his connection to Maomao becomes clear.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E19 - Chance or Something More
1.plot: A discussion with Lihaku about recent events leads Maomao to realize that the mysteries she's helped to solve are connected. As the final piece of the puzzle falls into place, she rushes to stop impending disaster.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E20 - Thornapple
1.plot: Maomao was able to stop the assassination attempt, but was heavily injured in the process. However, the injuries aren't enough to stop her curiosity, driving her to confront the culprit behind the incident.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E21 - How to Buy Out a Contract
1.plot: Back to work at the rear palace, Maomao listens to Guen talk about his family's business. Meanwhile, Lihaku hears a rumor that whips him into action.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E22 - Blue Roses
1.plot: Lakan challenges Jinshi to produce blue roses to present at the upcoming garden party, forcing Jinshi to turn once again to Maomao for her help.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E23 - Balsam and Woodsorrel
1.plot: No longer willing to keep running away from Lakan, Maomao decides to face off against him. She challenges him on his own turf, in a chess match.

1.title: FR - Les Carnets de l'Apothicaire - S01E24 - Jinshi and Maomao
1.plot: Lakan must now choose a courtesan to buy out. As a high-ranking military official, he can afford to freely choose, even from one of the Three Princesses. Who will he choose? Who does Maomao really want him to choose?

meta.plot: Twin sisters, whose similarities end with their looks, swap identities amid personal struggles — embarking on a journey to rediscover love and life.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Mi-ji, Yet Unknown
1.plot: Lee Ho-su returns home and runs into Yu Mi-ji, who's flailing through life. He convinces her to visit her twin, Yu Mi-rae, who is quietly suffering.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Review and Reassess
1.plot: Mi-ji finds Mi-rae's corporate job dull— until she accepts a difficult project. Meanwhile, Mi-rae coasts through farm life, butting heads with her boss.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Knock, Knock! Please Open Your Heart
1.plot: Mi-ji stops at nothing to persuade the restaurant owner to sell her shop. Meanwhile, Ho-su deals with being iced out after angering his boss.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - My Nemesis
1.plot: Deflated by unemployment, Ho-su searches for his next move. Meanwhile, Mi-ji sets up a crucial meeting between her company and the landlord.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Alone with You
1.plot: Ho-su's sudden revelation leaves Mi-ji unsure about their dynamic. Meanwhile, Mi-rae struggles over swirling rumors about her and Han Se-jin.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Silent, Ever-Present Fool
1.plot: Park Ji-yun increasingly pursues Ho-su, who's still processing Mi-ji's drunken confession. After abruptly quitting her job, Mi-rae becomes despondent.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Child Underneath It All
1.plot: Ho-su makes a surprise visit to Mi-rae, demanding answers. But when an incident draws Mi-ji back to their hometown, their web of lies deepens.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - An Unconventional Whole
1.plot: Now aware of each other's feelings, Mi-ji and Ho-su begin an awkward romance. Later, a shocking appearance at work leaves Mi-ji stunned.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Back Again, Once More
1.plot: Mi-ji and Mi-rae swap back places—forcing Mi-ji to temporarily move in with Ho-su. Mi-rae returns to her company, only to confront her past yet again.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Reading You
1.plot: With her motivation reignited, Mi-rae decides to fight back. While job hunting in Seoul, Mi-ji and Ho-su uncover the truth about Kim Ro-sa.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - At the End of the Sentence
1.plot: Ho-su's health takes a sudden turn, forcing him to reevaluate his relationship with Mi-ji. Meanwhile, Mi-rae takes a bold step toward the future.

1.title: EN - Our Unwritten Seoul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The End is a New Beginning
1.plot: Mi-ji and Mi-rae make it through a difficult chapter, finding new purpose on the other side—and confronting new challenges, both alone and together.
